name: RUNFORESTRUN Springendal
description: The RUNFORESTRUN Springendal takes place on Saturday, September 23, and runs through the rolling Springendal near Ootmarsum in Twente.

name: Damloop by night 2026
description: The Damloop by night is a unique evening run of 5 miles (8 km) that starts in Amsterdam and finishes in Zaandam. This run is known for its festive atmosphere with great beats and light effects, making it a non-stop party for all participants. The event combines athletic challenge with a lively ambiance, ideal for runners who enjoy a special experience.
course_highlights: Evening run of 5 miles (8 km)
Start in Amsterdam, finish in Zaandam
Festive atmosphere with music and light effects
additional: The Damloop by night is a non-stop party with beats and light acts. There is a special registration procedure for fast runners who finished in the top 3 of the previous edition. Additional products such as the official On Running shirt can also be ordered. The organization pays attention to safety and prevention of overheating among runners. The event includes various race distances, virtual options, and a festive closing. The 8 km race is characterized by a celebratory atmosphere and starts and finishes at the Olympic Stadium.

name: Run & Roast Eindhoven
location: Museumpark VONK, Eindhoven, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Run & Roast Eindhoven takes place on Saturday, September 19, and offers participants a choice of a 5 or 10 kilometer running race, as well as a 1 kilometer kids run for primary school children. The course is flat, fast, and well-paved, with start and finish at Museumpark VONK in the renovated Prehistoric Village in the Genneper Parks. After running, participants can enjoy a delicious plant-based burger from Beyond Meat, music, and a friendly atmosphere with food trucks. There are attractive prizes for the fastest runners and special discount offers for participants.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course of 5 or 10 kilometers through Genneper Parks
Start and finish at Museumpark VONK, in the renovated Prehistoric Village
Well-paved route with one or two laps
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day of the event from 15:00 at Brasserie Vonk. A plant-based Beyond Meat burger is included with registration. Discount coupons for All4running and Virtuoos nutritional supplements are available for participants. Prize winners will receive items such as Karhu running shoes, Shokz earphones, and supplement packages. There will be music and a friendly atmosphere with food trucks after the finish. Flat course, start and finish at Museumpark VONK, including burger, music, food trucks, and kids run.

name: 11e Kwintelooyen Run
price_range: 10,00 euro voor kidsrun; 17,50 euro voor 5, 10 en 15 km

description: The 11th edition of the Kwintelooyen Run takes place on Saturday, September 19, 2026, in the beautiful nature reserve of the Utrecht Hill Ridge near Rhenen. This running event offers four distances: a kids run of 1 km, and the 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km routes that are entirely on natural terrain. The run supports charities that work for children and young people with disabilities. Participants receive an exclusive Puma running shirt and a medal at the finish, making the event sporty and festive.
course_highlights: Course entirely on natural terrain: forest paths, sandy trails, single trails, and semi-paved sections
Beautiful climbs and panoramic views of the Utrecht Hill Ridge
Quiet and traffic-free routes without asphalt, cobblestones, or traffic lights
additional: The kids run starts at 11:00 AM, the 5 km at 12:00 PM, the 10 km at 1:30 PM, and the 15 km at 2:00 PM. Participants in the 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km receive an exclusive Puma running shirt when picking up their race number. Every runner gets a medal at the finish. Registration with a discounted rate is open until September 13, after which late registration is possible until September 18 as long as start numbers are available. The event supports two charities: Stichting Netwerk voor Jou and Stichting De Wijde Mantel Q-Dreams. Registration until September 13, 2026, with a discount; late registration possible; medals and sports shirts for participants; location in Rhenen on the Utrecht Hill Ridge.

name: Werkhoven Loopt 2026
description: Werkhoven Loopt is a friendly and sporty running event in the Kromme Rijn region, held annually on the third Saturday of September. The 11th edition in 2026 offers running opportunities for young and old, with distances of 1 and 2 km for children and 5 and 10 km for adults. The event is accessible to both recreational and competitive runners and is known for its lively and welcoming atmosphere. The organization works with enthusiastic volunteers to make it an unforgettable day.
course_highlights: Running through the beautiful Kromme Rijn region
Distances for children (1 and 2 km) and adults (5 and 10 km)
Friendly atmosphere with activities at the Brink
additional: Race numbers can be collected between 15:00 and 17:15. A warm-up is scheduled at 16:25. The event is suitable for all ages and levels, with a festive atmosphere and various activities at the Horecaplein de Brink. Distances: 1 km (kids run), 2 km, 5 km, 10 km; pre-registration recommended; the event takes place at De Brink 5 in Werkhoven.

name: Woellustrun
location: Duintjerlaan and Sterrenboschlaan, Wildervank, Groningen, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname aan de Jeugd run (500 en 1000 meter) kost € 2,50.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname aan de Woellustrun (5 en 10 km) kost € 7,50.

description: The Woellust Run is a fun and accessible running race in Groningen, with distances for both youth and adults. The 2.5-kilometer course runs zigzag through the neighborhood with no less than 30 turns and many enthusiastic supporters along the route. Youth can participate in the 500 and 1000 meter races, while adults can choose between 5 or 10 kilometers. Attractive prizes are available, including prize money for the top 3 finishers in the 5 and 10 km races and a special prize for setting a new course record.
course_highlights: Course of 2.5 km with 30 turns
Run through the neighborhood with many supporters
Youth races of 500 m and 1000 m, adults 5 and 10 km
additional: Registering on the day of the run incurs an additional fee of € 2.50 per registration. Minimum age for youth 500 m is 4-9 years, for 1000 m 4-11 years, and for 5 and 10 km at least 10 years. The award ceremony for the youth race is at 14:30, and for the 5 and 10 km races at 16:00. There is prize money for the top three finishers in the 5 and 10 km races and a special Primera course record prize for new records on 5 and 10 km. The course starts at the intersection of Duintjerlaan and Sterrenboschlaan. Registration is open. Prizes for the top three and course records.

name: 4 Mijl van Assen

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De Univé Kidsrun wordt georganiseerd voor alle basisschoolleerlingen en deelname is GRATIS!

description: The 4 Miles of Assen is an annual running race held in the Marsdijk neighborhood in Assen, starting and finishing at Anne Frank Square. The ninth edition on September 19, 2026, combines sport with a lively festival, including music, attractions, a fair, and a sports market. The run is suitable for young and old, with various categories such as the main distance of 4 miles, a College Run, and a free Univé Kidsrun for elementary school children. The event also marks the start of the Assen Sports Week and is an important event within the AssenRuns running circuit.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Anne Frank Square in the Marsdijk neighborhood
Course through the northernmost district of Assen
Includes special segments for frame runners (2 miles and 4 miles)
additional: The main distance of 4 Miles has a single start at 14:00, with the front start lane reserved for the fastest runners. The Univé Kidsrun starts at 11:55 with a group warm-up and is free, including a kids' shirt and medal (while supplies last). Clinics are also offered for various groups to prepare for the 4 Miles. On race day, there is a festival with music, attractions, a fair, and a sports market at Anne Frank Park. Registration is currently closed; the event includes running races, a festival, Kids Runs, College Run, clinics, and a sports market.

name: Mini Marathon Zeewolde

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Tot 17 september is de inschrijving gratis.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Daarna bedraagt het inschrijfgeld 5,50 euro per deelnemer.

description: The Mini Marathon Zeewolde is an accessible running event held annually, allowing participants of various ages to compete in distances of 1.1 km, 2.1 km, and 4.2 km. The event has a friendly atmosphere and supports the Conor Cares foundation, which fights against childhood cancer. The start groups are divided by age, and there is an award ceremony for the fastest runners in each category. Registration is free until September 17, after which the registration fee is 5.50 euros per participant.
course_highlights: Distances of 1.1 km, 2.1 km, and 4.2 km
Start groups divided by age
Friendly atmosphere with activities at the Kerkplein
additional: Award ceremony around 14:45 for 1.1 km and at 15:15 for 2.1 km and 4.2 km. There is a relay category with prizes for the fastest team divided into three age categories. After the finish, there is plenty to see and do at the Kerkplein. Distances of 1.1 km, 2.1 km, and 4.2 km, including start groups by age, fundraising for childhood cancer, free registration until September 17, then 5.50 euros.

name: Condensloop

description: The Condensloop takes place on Saturday, September 19, 2026, in Leeuwarden, starting from Merodestraat at the FrieslandCampina Condensfabriek. The race offers various distances: 1 km Kidsrun/FrameRunners, 2.8 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. The routes lead towards Camminghaburen and the Groene Ster. After the race, each participant receives a bag with products from Friesland Campina, Dr. Oetker, and Royal Koopmans. The Condensloop is an excellent preparation for the Amsterdam or Eindhoven Marathon, and participation is at your own risk.
course_highlights: Start at the FrieslandCampina Condensfabriek
Routes towards Camminghaburen and the Groene Ster
Various distances from 1 km to half marathon
additional: Race numbers have integrated chips, so a separate chip is not needed. Race numbers can be collected on Thursday, September 17, from 18:30 to 20:30 at AV Lionitas. Registration is only possible online via iDEAL, no on-site registration. Refreshment stations are indicated on the routes. GPX files for all distances are available for download to load into sports watches. Routes via afstandmeten.nl, chip timing, refreshment stations, changing facilities, no showers, prizes for records and categories, medals for Kidsrun.

name: Open NK trappenloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Aanmelden verplicht • gratis  • voor iedereen tussen 10-16 jaar •

description: The Open Dutch Championship Stair Climbing in Appelscha is an exciting stair climbing race especially for young people aged 10 to 16 years. Participants run as fast as possible up the stairs of the Bosbergtoren, focusing on speed and fitness. The race takes place during the festive Bloom Week and offers a unique opportunity to conquer the Bosberg and test your fitness. In addition to the stair climb, there is a free fitness test on the parking lot of restaurant De Bosberg. Participation is free, but registration is mandatory via Loopsportvereniging Invictus.
course_highlights: Stair climbing of the Bosbergtoren
Start from Boerestreek towards the Bosbergtoren
Viewpoint at the top of the Bosberg
additional: Participants gather between 11:15 and 11:30 AM on Boerestreek. A free fitness test is available on the parking lot of restaurant De Bosberg. Participation is at your own risk. Start time at 12:00 PM, participation for young people mandatory via registration, event location: Bosbergtoren in Appelscha

name: Run2day Bosloop Veenhuizen
description: The Run2day Bosloop in Veenhuizen is a friendly and small-scale running race that takes place four times a year. The routes run through the forests and heathlands of Veenhuizen, with distances of 3, 5, and 10 kilometers, each with its own course. The start is at the sports hall on Kerklaan, which also offers changing and shower facilities. The race is suitable for young and old and attracts an average of 40 to 100 participants per edition.
course_highlights: Routes through forests and heathlands of Veenhuizen
Distances of 3, 5, and 10 kilometers with their own courses
Start and facilities at sports hall Kerklaan Veenhuizen
additional: Registration can be done on-site from 9:00 to 10:15 AM or in advance via a registration form on the website until Thursday before the event. Timing is recorded and results are available online within 2 days. A laptop with registered times is available in the canteen of the sports hall. The race takes place four times a year, with pre-registration via the website or on the day itself. The event is small-scale and suitable for all ages.

name: Bolloop Lunetten
description: Bolloop Lunetten is a running event in the Utrecht neighborhood of Lunetten, organized by Bewoners Overleg Lunetten together with Utrecht Atletiek. The event is part of the Wijkdag and offers a 1 km Kidsrun for children up to 12 years old, and 5 km and 10 km distances for older participants. The 10 km is accessible from 16 years old, while everyone from 4 years old can participate in the other distances. It is a classic street race without fuss, ideal for families, recreational runners, and anyone who wants to run close to home. The event has been a fixture in the Lunetten calendar for several years and celebrates a jubilee this year.
course_highlights: Street race in the Utrecht neighborhood of Lunetten
Distances: 1 km Kidsrun, 5 km and 10 km
Accessible for participants from 4 years old (10 km from 16 years old)
additional: Registration is via Inschrijven.nl. The event offers a safe and organized environment for participants. Typical weather in September is mild with about 19°C and little precipitation. Straßenlauf, Distanzen: 5 km, 10 km, Kidsrun, Anmeldung via Inschrijven.nl

name: ‘kLEEF Run
description: The ‘kLEEF Run & Walk 2026 is a running event organized by Atletiekvereniging Veluwe in Apeldoorn. The event offers a sporty and friendly atmosphere for both runners and walkers. The start and finish take place at Sportpark Orderbos, a well-known location with good facilities. The run is suitable for various levels and ages, allowing participants to enjoy a beautiful route in the surroundings.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos in Apeldoorn
Route through the natural environment of the Veluwe
Suitable for both runners and walkers
additional: The organization offers changing rooms and shower facilities at CSV for AV Veluwe members during training and competition days. The sports park is easily accessible by public transport and car. There is no specific information about start times, pricing, or registration available on the pages. Registration includes a start number, training courses, and a reflective vest; location at Sportpark Orderbos, Apeldoorn.

name: Vallei Trailrun
location: Openluchttheater Helderse Vallei, Den Helder, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
organizer: SV Noordkop en Stichting Vredesbeweging PAX Nederland
price_range: € 2,50 extra bij ter plaatse inschrijven, gratis voor jeugd tot en met 12 jaar

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis deelname voor kinderen tot en met 12 jaar

description: The Helderse Vallei Trailrun 2026 is a charming trail run that celebrates its sixth edition this year, in memory of Ineke Smit, one of the founders of this trail. The focus is on enjoying the natural environment and running on as many unpaved paths as possible, without timing or performance pressure. The routes start at the open-air theater of the Helderse Vallei in Den Helder and offer various distances for seniors and children. Along the way, refreshment stations with water and fruit are available, and the organization collaborates with Stichting Vredesbeweging PAX Nederland for a peace collection.
course_highlights: Trail run over as many unpaved paths as possible
Refreshment stations with water and fruit along the route
Start and finish at the open-air theater of the Helderse Vallei
additional: Registration can be done in advance via inschrijven.nl or on the day of the race at the visitors' center of the Helderse Vallei from 09:30 AM. There is no timing or registration during the run. The organization collaborates with Stichting Vredesbeweging PAX Nederland and a donation box is available for contributions to PAX. Trail run over unpaved paths, beach, and dunes, no timing, routes start between 10:00 and 11:00 AM, with refreshment stations with water and fruit.

name: Nijmegen-Rotterdam
description: The Nijmegen-Rotterdam is the longest continuous walking event in the Netherlands, covering a distance of 160 km. The event starts on Saturday, September 19, 2026, at 11:00 AM in Nijmegen and ends on Sunday, September 20 in Rotterdam. The route has been renewed since 2022 and is improved each year, featuring six hospitality stops and various refreshment stations along the way. The organization ensures a safe and well-organized walking experience, including first aid and foot care, and participants receive a diploma and a special souvenir upon successful completion.
course_highlights: 160 km continuous walking route from Nijmegen to Rotterdam
Six hospitality stops and multiple free refreshment stations along the route
Route renewed in 2022 and improved annually
additional: Start is in group from Sporthal De Boog in Nijmegen. Registration is possible from 9:30 to 10:30 AM. During nighttime hours, wearing a reflective vest is mandatory, which can be rented or purchased at the start. An experienced first aid and foot care team is present. A meal is served approximately 60 km into the route. Cancellations will be refunded minus €5 administrative fee. Discounts are available for members of associations and other clubs. 160 km route, starting in Nijmegen, finishing in Rotterdam, including hospitality stops, refreshment stations, meal, first aid, reflective vests, and flashlights recommended.

name: Run for Care
location: Krimpen aan de Lek, South Holland, Netherlands
description: On Saturday, September 19, 2026, the very first Run for Care will take place in the recreational area Krimpenerhout, near Krimpen aan de Lek. It is a sponsored run of 5 or 10 kilometers for runners and walkers, where it’s not about the fastest time, but about the biggest heart. Participants can join individually or as a team and raise sponsorship money for aid and hope in Eastern Europe and Central Asia. Besides the run, there will be a lively fair at thrift store De Groene Weg, so family and friends can also enjoy the day.
course_highlights: Sponsored run of 5 or 10 kilometers in recreational area Krimpenerhout
Start at 13:00, participation individually or as a team
Lively fair at thrift store De Groene Weg on the same day
additional: Participants can register as individuals or as a team and start a personal action page to collect sponsorship money. The event is organized in honor of the 40th anniversary of OostEuropa Zending / Christian Care East West in Krimpen aan de Lek. Running and walking, participants from 16 years old, registration until September 16, including a fair with activities for all ages.

name: Bertusloop
description: The Bertusloop is organized every third Sunday of the month, except for July and August. This recreational fun run

name: NN Dam tot Damloop 2026

price_tiers.distance: The Virtual 40th NN Dam tot Damloop

description: The NN Dam tot Damloop is the biggest running event in the Netherlands, starting in Amsterdam and finishing in Zaandam. The 10-mile race takes you through the unique IJ Tunnel and past lively music and cheers in Amsterdam-Noord. In 2026, this event celebrates its 40th edition with a festive program and an unforgettable finish on Peperstraat in Zaandam. After crossing the finish line, you can relax in Dam tot Dam Park during the Finish Festival.
course_highlights: Start on Prins Hendrikkade in Amsterdam
Run through the IJ Tunnel between the city center and Amsterdam-Noord
Finish on Peperstraat in Zaandam with a community festival on Zuiddijk
additional: Registration starts in phases: members of Le Champion can register from April 6 to April 17, after which regular registration opens on April 18. A Premium Business Package is available for teams. The Business Run is popular among companies with more than 25,000 participants. A free BackStory starting number is available. After the finish, there is a Finish Festival in Dam tot Dam Park. Participants can choose from multiple distances, virtual options, and special anniversary activities. The event has a festive and supportive atmosphere with music and merchandise available.

name: Misty Lakes Trail
description: The Misty Lakes Trail is a challenging trail run taking place on Sunday, September 20, 2026, in the beautiful forests around Lieshout, Gerwen, Nuenen, Geldrop, Mierlo, and Stiphout. The routes start and finish in Gerwen (Nuenen) and consist of more than 90% unpaved paths with short climbs and winding single tracks. The trail passes by many beautiful ponds and heath areas, known for their natural beauty and the mysterious morning mist. The different distances offer a nice challenge for every level, with a renewed 36 km route and a 55 km route that climbs the 'Roof of Brabant', the Gulbergen.
course_highlights: More than 90% unpaved paths
Winding single tracks and short climbs
Visit to the 'Roof of Brabant', the over 60-meter-high Gulbergen
additional: The start and finish location is ’t Huysven De Huikert 35, 5674 RG Nuenen. There is a stand from partner NNormal where trail runners can test trail shoes. On site, there is also a pop-up store with trail gear. The event is organized by Runnersclub Lieshout. There is an option to transfer start numbers via Inschrijven.nl and a resale platform. A friendly atmosphere with a terrace, BBQ, and activities for children at the finish between 11:30 and 15:30. Trail run on unpaved paths with marking and GPX files, start and finish in Gerwen (Nuenen), facilities such as changing rooms, showers, and first aid, and a free start for participants.

name: LOS Dokkum
distance_verbose: 50 km, Marathon, Halve marathon, 13.4 km, 6.7 km
organizer: Stichting Promotie Dokkum en stichting Ik ben Wil
description: LOS Dokkum is a unique 12-hour running and walking event in Tolhuispark in Dokkum. Every hour, the start signal sounds for a round of 6.7 kilometers of running or 3.9 kilometers of walking. The challenge is to determine how long you can keep going and to answer the question again and again: shall I do another lap? The event combines sportiness with a friendly atmosphere in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: Round of 6.7 kilometers of running per hour
Walking route of 3.9 kilometers through Tolhuispark
Start signal every hour for 12 hours
additional: The event takes place in Tolhuispark. Participants can choose between running and walking. The start signal sounds again every hour, giving a unique dynamic to the event. The event supports good causes and is organized by volunteers and local entrepreneurs. It is accessible for teams and children, and is part of an annual recurring initiative.

name: Preston Palace Almelo Allee Run
description: The Preston Palace Almelo Allee Run is a charming running event in the green surroundings of the Gravenallee in Almelo. The event offers distances for both beginner and experienced runners, including a new 2-kilometer youth and beginner run. The start and finish are at the ice rink opposite the sports park, with a course along wide avenues and a popular, atmospheric environment. It promises a sporty and convivial day for athletes, supporters, and visitors of all ages.
course_highlights: Course along wide avenues in the green Gravenallee
Start and finish at the ice rink opposite the sports park
Atmospheric environment with participation of Huize Almelo
additional: Distances for all ages and levels, including a new 2-kilometer youth and beginner run. Start and finish at Ice Rink Almelo, Sluiskade Zuidzijde 195, 7607XT Almelo. Event runs from 10:30 to 13:00. Routes through rural areas, possibility for training at athletics club SISU, participation for all ages, focus on health and community.

name: Freedom Run - Libertyloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16.09 km, 8 km, 3000 meter, 1.6 km
description: Freedom Run - Liberty Loop is a recreational run taking place in Geldrop to celebrate 80 years of liberation. The race offers four running distances named after well-known veterans, and a half marathon. Additionally, there is a free Kidsrun for primary school children and various walking routes along war monuments and streets named after resistance fighters. The event emphasizes celebrating freedom together and offers a unique combination of sport and history.
course_highlights: Four running distances named after veterans: 4, 8, 10 miles and half marathon
Walking routes along war monuments and streets of resistance fighters in Geldrop
Free Kidsrun for primary school children with 1/2 and 1 mile distances
additional: Start times vary per distance: walking starts between 9:00 and 10:00 AM, Kidsrun at 10:15 AM, running between 10:45 and 11:15 AM. Walking and running routes are available as GPX files. Participation is at own risk and free for children up to and including 15 years old when walking. Registration opens from May 5 via the website. Participants can choose from various distances, including 3 km, 1.6 km, 8 km, 10 miles, and a half marathon. The event takes place at the Weeffabriek in Geldrop and starts on September 20, 2026. Registration opens on May 5, 2026.

name: Rondjes van Pijn
description: Round of Pijn is an endurance race organized by the Pijnacker Ice Association, held on Sunday, September 20, 2026, at the Tinteltent in Pijnacker. The race consists of repeating laps of 4.2 kilometers, starting every half hour, with a maximum of ten laps. Participants can set their own pace, with a faster lap providing more rest time before the next start. The event targets both youth and adults and emphasizes endurance over speed.
course_highlights: Repeating laps of 4.2 km every half hour
Maximum of ten laps possible
Course in and around the Tinteltent, Pijnacker
additional: Participation is at your own risk; participants are responsible for training and insurance. The course is shared with recreational runners, and traffic controllers are present at some challenging spots. Dogs are welcome on parts of the course. Repeating laps of 4.2 km, maximum distance of approximately 42 km, registration via website, dogs welcome on parts of the course, safety and responsibility are emphasized.

name: Maasheggenloop
description: The Maasheggen Run, organized by Atletiek Vereniging Sporting Boxmeer, takes place on September 20, 2026, in the beautiful Maasheggen area, the oldest cultural landscape in the Netherlands. The race offers suitable distances for all ages and levels, from the Bambinoloop for the youngest children to the Half Marathon for advanced runners. The routes pass through a unique and natural environment, with cash prizes for breaking the course record on the Half Marathon and 10 kilometers. The atmosphere is sporty and accessible, with fun memories for all youth participants and trophies for the podium places.
course_highlights: Running in the oldest cultural landscape of the Netherlands, the Maasheggen area
Distances ranging from 250 meters for the youngest children to a half marathon
Cash prizes for breaking the course record on the 10 km and half marathon
additional: Start times per distance vary from 09:45 AM for the Bambinoloop to 11:00 AM for the 5 kilometers. Award ceremonies take place shortly after each distance. All youth participants receive a fun souvenir and trophies are awarded for the podium places. There is a cash prize of 100 euros for breaking the course record on the Half Marathon and 10 kilometers. Distances suitable for all ages, course records, registration via website, catering and first aid available.

name: Molenbroekloop
price_range: gratis voor GAC-leden, anders niet vermeld

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Vanaf 1 augustus t/m 17 september via www.inschrijven.nl

description: On Sunday, September 20, 2026, GAC Gemert organizes the annual Bouwgroep van Schijndel Molenbroekrun. The race consists of multiple rounds of 2.5 kilometers through the Molenbroek neighborhood, where participants can choose from distances of 1.1 km (youth), 2.5 km (juniors), 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km, and 10 km. Start and finish are at the GAC Gemert athletics track. There are awards for the best men and women in the 5 km and 10 km races, and for the best boys and girls in the youth runs. The organization contributes to sustainability by using reusable bib numbers that must be returned after the race.
course_highlights: Round of 2.5 km through the Molenbroek neighborhood
Start and finish at the GAC Gemert athletics track
Distances range from 1.1 km (youth) to 10 km
additional: Participants receive reusable bib numbers that must be returned after the race. Participation is free for GAC members. Registration is also possible on race day between 9:00 and 10:30 in the clubhouse at the athletics track. Distances from 2.5 km to 10 km, youth runs, start and finish at the athletics track, sustainable bib numbers.

name: Rotterdam Half
description: The Rotterdam Half Marathon takes place on Sunday, September 20, 2026, starting at 09:00 at the Maassilo in Rotterdam. The 21.1-kilometer route passes through the authentic Rotterdam-Zuid, along iconic locations such as Katendrecht, the SS Rotterdam, the port area, and ends spectacularly inside Rotterdam Ahoy. The course is fast, flat, and officially certified, ideal for runners aiming for a quick time. After the finish, there is a festive afterparty with a DJ and various facilities for participants and supporters.
course_highlights: Start at the Maassilo and loop through Katendrecht past the SS Rotterdam
Through the port area with quays, cranes, and skyline views
Finish inside Rotterdam Ahoy with light shows and afterparty
additional: Participants gather in waiting areas and start in 7 waves of 1000 runners each, every 5 minutes a wave between 09:00 and 09:30. Bib pickup is available on Saturday at Run2Day or on Sunday morning between 07:00 and 08:00 at Ahoy. Luggage can be dropped off for free with a luggage tag at a drop-off point in Ahoy. There is a finish celebration with breakfast, free coffee between 09:00 and 10:00, flower sales, and an afterparty with DJ All Hans On Deck. The minimum age is 18 years. There is no tracking app available for this edition. The race features multiple waves starting from 09:00, with registration possible via Run2Day Rotterdam. The course is available for GPX download, and there is a festive finish with a food court and afterparty. Travel tips are provided for metro and parking.

name: StoneCityRun
description: The DYKA StoneCityRun is a festive running event in Steenwijk taking place on September 20, 2026. Participants run over historic city walls, through Rams Woerthe park, and the center of Steenwijk, with lots of spectators and entertainment along the course. There are various distances for young and old, experienced and inexperienced, including special segments such as the G-Run for people with disabilities and a walking tour. The event stands for inclusivity and conviviality, starting at Theater de Meenthe and finishing at the Market.
course_highlights: Run over the historic city walls of Steenwijk
Through Rams Woerthe park and the center of Steenwijk
Finish at the lively Market in Steenwijk
additional: After registration closes, it is possible to pick up a blank start number at the start location De Meenthe on September 20 from 13:00, without timing registration. For children under 6 years old, supervision is mandatory, and guardians of children or people with disabilities may run for free. There are changing rooms and showers at the start location, and parking is available. The rollator run is specially for seniors, and the G-Run is inclusive with supervision and aids permitted. Participants can choose from different distances, including 0.6 km, 1.5 km, 3 km, 5 km, and 10 km. The event also offers walks and special runs for people with disabilities, with parking, changing rooms, and showers available. Registration closes on September 1, 2026.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De inschrijfkosten zijn € 9,50 per afstand bij de voorinschrijving

description: The Ten of 't Aogje is a running event in Princenhage, Breda, taking place on September 20, 2026. The race offers competitive runs over 5 and 10 kilometers, with a fun family run as an additional component. Bib numbers are sent in advance via email, and there is an award ceremony immediately after each race at the Haagsemarkt. The event attracts many participants and has a maximum capacity per distance.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km competitive runs through Princenhage
Award ceremony immediately after each race at the Haagsemarkt
Fun family run as an additional component
additional: Bib numbers are sent via email with additional information. There are two pickup times for bib numbers. The award ceremony takes place immediately after each race at the Haagsemarkt. There is a maximum number of participants per distance. Registration for 2025 is closed; pre-registration for 2026 is possible until September 13, 2026. The event takes place in Princenhage, Breda, and includes multiple race distances with award ceremonies after each race.

name: Misty Lakes Trail
description: The Misty Lakes Trail is a challenging trail run taking place on Sunday, September 20, 2026, in Gerwen (Nuenen). The routes pass through beautiful forests with many ponds and heath areas, with more than 90% of the course consisting of unpaved paths. The trail is characterized by short climbs, winding single tracks, and the ascent of the 'Roof of Brabant', the Gulbergen. The various distances offer a nice challenge for every level, with a scenic finish location where visitors can cheer on the runners.
course_highlights: More than 90% unpaved paths through forests and past ponds
Winding single tracks and short climbs
Ascent of the over 60-meter-high Gulbergen, the 'Roof of Brabant'
additional: The start and finish location is at ’t Huysven, De Huikert 35, 5674 RG Nuenen. There is a stand by partner NNormal where trail runners can test trail shoes. A pop-up store with trail gear is also present on the site. There is an option to transfer race numbers via Inschrijven.nl and a resale platform. The Misty Lakes Trail running shirt is still available for purchase at the secretariat on the day itself, in limited quantities. Visitors can cheer on the runners between 11:30 and 15:30 near the finish line while enjoying a drink and BBQ. The routes are marked with orange ribbons, GPX files are available, and facilities such as changing rooms, showers, and first aid are provided.

name: Mierdentrail
description: The Mierdse Trail offers a unique trail running experience with a network of scenic singletracks, suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. The course winds through the wooded area between Hooge Mierde, Lage Mierde, and Poppel in Belgium, with almost entirely unpaved terrain. The route includes technical sections and natural obstacles, making every kilometer challenging and varied. The trail is part of the Brabantse Trailserie and is known for having the largest number of singletrack meters within the series.
course_highlights: 99.9% unpaved terrain with singletracks
Wooded area between Hooge Mierde, Lage Mierde, and Poppel (Belgium)
Technical sections and natural obstacles
additional: The Mierdse Trail has the most singletrack meters within the Brabantse Trailserie, providing a varied and challenging course. When registering for multiple trails within the Brabantse Trailserie, there are bonus offers with free T-shirts and buffs. Teams of 5 can register, with the fifth participant free. Trail run through wooded areas with unpaved paths and singletracks, various distances, technical sections, and natural obstacles.

name: 1 v.d. 4 loop Zuiderpark
location: Zuiderpark, Den Haag, South Holland, Netherlands
description: One of the four circuit races is a running event organized by the Hague Road Runners in Zuiderpark in The Hague. The event is part of a circuit with multiple races and will celebrate its 40th anniversary in 2026. The race offers a friendly and sporty atmosphere for runners of various levels and ages. The course runs through the beautiful Zuiderpark and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Course through the green Zuiderpark in The Hague
Suitable for different levels and ages
Part of a circuit with multiple running events
additional: The start of the Sparta run is at 11:00 AM. There is a beginner's course that runs from 09:30 to 10:30 AM on the same day. The event is part of a circuit with multiple races and celebrates its 40th anniversary (40 years of 1 of the 4 runs). Registration is possible on-site; the event is organized by Haag Atletiek, Sparta, De Koplopers, and HRR; typical Dutch autumn weather is expected.

name: Rooise Crosslopen 1e
description: The Rooise Cross Running 1st is a cross-country race taking place on Sunday, September 20, 2026, in Sint-Oedenrode. The event offers various categories divided by age groups, including pupils, juniors, and seniors, with distances up to 7.9 km. Pre-registration is possible until September 19, 2026. The race is suitable for runners of various ages and levels and takes place in a natural environment in Brabant.
course_highlights: Cross-country race with various distances up to 7.9 km
Categories for pupils, juniors, and seniors
Natural environment in Sint-Oedenrode, Brabant
additional: Pre-registration is possible until September 19, 2026. Participants can choose an event from the listed age categories and distances. Visit the organizer's website for the most recent information. Registration is possible until September 19, 2026.

name: Vooruitgangloop
location: Oude Veerdam recreatiegebied, Zuidland, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Vooruitgang Run is a running event taking place in the beautiful recreational area Oude Veerdam near Zuidland. The first edition is organized by IJsclub Vooruitgang and offers a scenic run through a green and natural area. The start and finish are at the ice rink, with good accessibility by bike and public transport. The event is suitable for young and old, featuring a kids run and a 10 km race, supported by a warm-up and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through the green recreational area Oude Veerdam
Start and finish at the ice rink of IJsclub Vooruitgang
Beautiful route with views of the Bernisse and natural surroundings
additional: Registration on site is not possible. The area opens at 10:00 AM for picking up race numbers. Warm-up at 10:50 AM provided by GrapeFine sports. The 1 km kids run starts at 11:00 AM from the area of the whisper boat. The 10 km race starts at 11:45 AM with the starting signal given by alderman Hamerslag. The course is cleared at 1:15 PM by the cleanup team; all runners must be within the area by then. The canteen and the area close at 2:30 PM. There is no facility for showering or changing. Parking is free on a large parking lot 100 meters away at the Bernisse recreation area. Bicycles can be parked at the ice club premises. The ice rink is opposite the bus stop Stationsweg, line 106. Start at 11:00 AM; location in Zuidland, near Oude Veerdam recreation area; parking information and accessibility via bus stop and parking lots; volunteers needed for organization.

name: Nispen 'Borteldonk'
price_range: daglicentie mogelijk, geen expliciete prijs vermeld
description: The BWF Round of ‘Peet’s Bloemenshop’ Borteldonk is a cycling race held on a 4.4-kilometer course in Nispen and Borteldonk. The course consists entirely of paved roads and runs via Zonnelandstraat, Oude Turfvaartsestraat, Vierhoevenstraat, and Nispenseweg, with riders turning left. The start and finish are located at Zonnelandstraat 6. The event is organized by Stichting Sportfrinten, and more information is available on their website.
course_highlights: Course length of 4,400 meters
Fully paved roads
Start and finish at Zonnelandstraat 6
additional: The registration desk is at Hoeve Zonneland, Zonnelandstraat 6, 4709 RA Nispen. Zonnelandstraat is easily accessible via the first roundabout of the N262 towards Essen, but it is better to use the second roundabout to stay outside the course. Registration is digital and closes no later than 18:00 on race day; same-day registration is not possible. The registration fee for BWF races is €8, the day license is €5, and transponder rental is €2. Season license holders have their own race number for the entire season. Cycling race with registration via the website, location in Nispen and the Borteldonk hamlet, various categories, and a broad audience.

name: Zombies are Coming 180km
description: Zombies are Coming is a unique 180-kilometer ultramarathon from Amsterdam to Groningen, where participants must maintain a constant speed of 7.5 km/h to finish within 24 hours. Participants carry everything themselves and run without a crew, while being chased by a 'zombie horde' that eliminates them if they fall behind the pace. It is not a race against other runners, but a personal challenge to reach the finish and stay ahead of the zombies.
course_highlights: 180 kilometers from Amsterdam to Groningen
Constant speed of 7.5 km/h required
Rolling cutoff: those overtaken by the zombie horde must stop
additional: Participants must carry everything themselves; no crew is allowed. The race has a rolling cutoff where anyone overtaken by the zombie horde (moving at 7.5 km/h) must stop. Return travel is arranged by the participants themselves, but there is a zombie vehicle that can assist in reaching a public transport point. Route in the Netherlands, in darkness and light, with public water points, no aid stations or volunteers on site.

name: Martini Marathon
price_range: 4,22 euro voor sololopers, 21,10 euro voor estafetteteams
description: The Martini Marathon in Groningen is a unique marathon on the athletics track, organized by Groningen Atletiek. The race takes place on Friday evening, September 25, 2026, and offers both a solo marathon of 42.195 meters and a relay for teams of 3 to 5 runners. The relay consists of distances of 2,195 meters and four times 10,000 meters, ensuring a challenging and fast running experience. The atmosphere is friendly with catering along the way and after the event, and all participants receive a medal. The winners receive the prestigious Martini Bokaal.
course_highlights: Marathon on the athletics track Stadspark Groningen
Relay with distances of 2,195 m and 4×10,000 m
Maximum of 60 participants on the track at the same time
additional: Maximum of 60 runners on the track at the same time, with a reserve list for additional registrations. The maximum time to complete the marathon is 5 hours and 15 minutes. Catering is available during and after the event. Start and finish are at the athletics track Stadspark Groningen, which also offers changing and baggage storage. The organization is handled by Alex Jager on behalf of Groningen Atletiek. Track race with solo and relay variants, registration opens on 01-01-2026, maximum participant numbers and time limits apply.

description: The Nedmag Moonlight Walk in Veendam is a atmospheric evening walk of approximately 6 kilometers that takes place by moonlight. The event is not a race, but a relaxed walk where participants can enjoy various performances and special experiences along the route. The route is accessible to almost everyone, including wheelchair users, and offers a unique way to experience Veendam. The proceeds from the walk go to a good cause, this year the Margarethe Hardenberg Cultural Center.
course_highlights: Approximately 6 km long walk
Various performances and fun acts along the way
Accessible for wheelchair users
additional: Start location is Museumplein Veendam. Registration is possible from 19:00 to 19:30, and the walk can start between 19:30 and 20:30. Registration is also possible on the evening itself with cash or PIN payment. The route ends again at Museumplein. Dogs are allowed if leashed and owners bring their own cleanup materials. There are no official toilet facilities along the route, but toilets at businesses/cafes can sometimes be used. The route is surprisingly different, no race, suitable for almost everyone, entertainment and support for a good cause.

name: Bruggenloop 100

name: Damwâldrin
description: The Damwâldrin is a running race held in the picturesque village of Damwâld. The route takes participants through the beautiful nature.

name: De 5 van Bavel

price_tiers.distance: Hofkens HIG 10km Trimloop en Chiropractie La Flamme 5km wedstrijd

description: The 5 of Bavel is an annual running event in ’t Klooster, Bavel, celebrating its 10th anniversary in 2026. The event offers a fun and sporty day for young and old with various distances, including a 5 km race, a 10 km trim run, and a kids run. The start and finish are centrally located on Kloosterstraat at Café-zaal ’t Karrewiel. The 5 of Bavel also supports a good cause, namely research into neuroendocrine tumors (NET).
course_highlights: 5 km race and 10 km trim run with multiple laps through the village
Kids run of about 500 meters with start and finish in Kloosterstraat
Start and finish at Café-zaal ’t Karrewiel in Kloosterstraat
additional: Registration and pick-up of start numbers from 13:00 on race day at ’t Klooster. The Berenboot kids run starts at 16:00, followed by the 5 km race at 16:15 and the 10 km trim run at 17:00. Prizes for the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place finishers in each run are awarded immediately afterward. The running event includes various components, volunteers, and traffic controllers; part of the Bavelse fair; registration via website and on-site.

name: Run for Hope
location: Dordrecht Biesbosch, Dordrecht, South Holland, Netherlands
description: Run for Hope is an inspiring running race taking place on September 26, 2026, in the Dordtse Biesbosch. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, or 21.1 kilometers and run to raise money for clients of De Hoop, who receive support in rebuilding their lives. The run is centered around hope and solidarity, with runners encouraged by supporters and collectively contributing to a social cause. The event combines athleticism with meaningful support for others.
course_highlights: Running through the scenic environment of Dordtse Biesbosch
Choice of three distances: 5, 10, and 21.1 kilometers
A run with a social purpose and lots of support along the course
additional: The proceeds from the run are used to support clients of De Hoop in reintegrating into society. The goal is to raise a total of 75,000 euros. The organization emphasizes the importance of solidarity and experiencing fulfillment during the run. Distances of 5, 10, and 21.1 km; charity fundraising; scenic run through Dordrecht Biesbosch.

name: Spanderswoud Trailrun
location: s-Graveland, Gooise Meren, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Spanderswoud Trailrun is a relaxed trail run through the beautiful Spanderswoud and surrounding natural areas in the Gooi. The routes of 10, 20, and 30 km take you over winding forest paths, singletracks, and open heathlands, without a competitive element or time pressure. The start and finish are at the visitor center of Natuurmonumenten on Landgoed Boekesteyn in ’s-Graveland. There are refreshment stations along the way, and after the race, you can enjoy a snack and drink at Café-Restaurant Brambergen.
course_highlights: Fully marked routes of 10 and 20 km, 30 km partly via GPX
Varied terrain with singletracks, forest paths, and heathlands
Start and finish at the visitor center of Natuurmonumenten on Landgoed Boekesteyn
additional: Start times for 10 and 20 km are between 09:00 and 11:30 in five time blocks; participants choose their own start time. There are two refreshment stations (approximately at 5 km and at the finish; longer distances have an extra station). First aid is available at start/finish. The 30 km route requires experience with GPX navigation. There is no timing or cups at refreshment stations; participants are advised to bring their own cup or order an EpicTrails softcup. Parking is available; carpooling is recommended. Part of the registration fee goes to nature organizations. Trail routes follow forest paths, sandy stretches, and narrow trails; no competitive element; start times during registration; GPX data for long distances; finisher medal; no cups, own cup or softcup recommended.

name: Crob Run
description: The Crob Run is a running event in Haaften taking place on September 26, 2026. It offers a beautiful run over the dikes around Haaften and through nature along the Waal River, suitable for young and old. There are various distances, including kids runs for children aged 5 to 12, and 5 km and 10 km for adults. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere with music, food stalls, and a bar, and part of the proceeds go to a good cause.
course_highlights: Run over the dikes around Haaften
Beautiful nature along the Waal River
Friendly atmosphere with DJ, food stalls, and terrace
additional: Kids runs start between 14:00 and 14:30, and the 5 km and 10 km races start together at 15:30. There is a refreshment station with water on the 5 km and 10 km routes, and fruit and extra water are available at the finish. Changing rooms are available for men and women. The event area is open until 18:00 with a DJ, food stalls, bar, and terrace. First aid is available in the building of the Burcht van Haeften. There is no registration deadline, but the event is full once capacity is reached. There is a time limit of 1 hour and 30 minutes for the 5 km and 10 km races. Parking is free around the Burcht van Haeften; cycling and carpooling are recommended. Participants can enjoy a festive atmosphere with music, food trucks, and a medal referencing the mill and the blue heron in Haaften. The event supports charities such as ROPA run and is wheelchair accessible with adapted sanitary facilities.

name: Hill Repeat Madness: 4-uurs trailrunchallenge
location: Landgoed Gulbergen, Nuenen, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Hill Repeat Madness is a challenging 4-hour trail running challenge taking place at Landgoed Gulbergen in Nuenen. This trail run challenges runners to test their endurance and speed on a varied course in a natural environment. The event is organized by Trailrunners Brabant, known for their passion for trail running and creating a sporty and friendly atmosphere. The race is ideal for trail runners who enjoy an intensive and dynamic running experience.
course_highlights: Trail run at Landgoed Gulbergen with natural surroundings
4-hour challenge focusing on endurance and speed
Varied course suitable for trail running
additional: Participants can register via WeTicket. The event takes place at 't Dak van Brabant in Nuenen, with a route of approximately 2.5 km per lap, including elevation changes. There are no facilities for showering or changing, and volunteers can sign up for support.

name: BEAT Running Festival
description: The BEAT Running Festival on September 26, 2026, in the Amsterdamse Bos is a unique knockout running event where participants run 1 km laps with an increasing pace. The race revolves around keeping up with an official pacer; those who fall behind are eliminated until only one man and one woman remain. In addition to the exciting race, there is a festival with food, drinks, challenges, and a community zone, making the event more than just a running race. The winners receive a sports trip worth €2,000.
course_highlights: 1 km laps with increasing pace per lap
Pace is set by an official pacer
Knockout format until one man and one woman remain
additional: The race starts with a pace of 6:30 min/km and accelerates each lap by 15 seconds per km to a minimum pace of 3:30 min/km. After each lap, there is a short rest zone where runners wait until the pacer departs again. Eliminated participants remain part of the festival as supporters. There is a Challenge Zone and Community Zone with activities, merchandise, and activations. Knockout race with 1 km laps, increasing pace, festival experience, food & drinks, challenge and community zones, located in Amsterdamse Bos.

name: Mission Run
description: The MissionRun 2026 takes place on Saturday, September 26, in Scherpenzeel and offers running and walking routes of 5, 10, and 20 km, including a half marathon for participants aged 18 and older. The course runs through the scenic countryside of Scherpenzeel, over forest paths and quiet country roads, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational participants and walkers. The proceeds of the event go entirely to International Justice Mission, supporting the Muskathlon of Anne & Dianne. The start and finish are at Oud Willaer 74, with time registration via MyLaps for the running distances.
course_highlights: Scenic countryside of Scherpenzeel with forest paths and country roads
Varied course on the border of the Gelderse Vallei and the Veluwe
Routes of 5 km (1 lap), 10 km (2 laps), and half marathon (4 laps)
additional: Time registration for running via MyLaps. Bib pickup from 09:30. Walking can still be registered on the day. The 10 km route consists of 2 laps, and the half marathon consists of 4 laps of the same course. The half marathon is only accessible for participants aged 18 and older. Parking is available at De Breelaan 6, 3925 HX Scherpenzeel. Terrain: city course, registration via MyLaps, registration until September 24 for running, on the day registration for walking.

name: 42e Halve van Katwijk
location: Duinplein, Katwijk aan Zee, Katwijk, South Holland, Netherlands
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The 42nd edition of the Half Marathon of Katwijk will take place on September 26, 2026, and is a popular running and walking festival along the coast. The event is known for its sporty and festive character, with a beautiful course that starts and finishes at the Duinplein in front of the lighthouse on Katwijkse Boulevard. The Half Marathon of Katwijk offers various distances for runners, walkers, and children, attracting many participants each year who enjoy the unique environment and lively atmosphere. The organizers are continuously working to improve the event and provide everyone with an unforgettable day.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Duinplein, directly in front of the lighthouse on Katwijkse Boulevard
Refreshment stations at Vriezenwei, Panbos, and Wassenaarse Slag
Various courses with available GPX files, including special Kidsrun routes
additional: Start and finish village at Duinplein with changing rooms, toilets, activities, and massage. No on-the-day registration possible. Parking garage at the Boulevard and alternative parking garages nearby. No secured bicycle storage available. Business run with its own start block, group photo, souvenir, and networking drinks afterwards. GPX files of all routes available. The event also includes a Kidsrun and Business Run; registration is popular and often closes early due to high demand.

description: The Zevenheuvelentrail & Dutch Trail Running Championships take place in the wooded and hilly surroundings around Nijmegen. The trail offers challenging routes with steep climbs, difficult descents, and unpaved paths through natural areas such as the Nijmegen Uplands and Landgoed van Jurgens. The Dutch Trail Running Championships consist of a short trail of 28 kilometers and a long trail of 56 kilometers, where athletes with an Atletiekunie license compete for the Dutch title. The organization ensures a festive event with aid stations and a professional approach.
course_highlights: Hilly forests around Nijmegen with steep climbs and challenging descents
Unpaved, narrow paths through natural areas such as the Nijmegen Uplands and Landgoed van Jurgens
Routes ranging from 7 to 56 kilometers with up to more than 1000 meters of elevation gain on the longest distance
additional: Start of the Dutch Long Trail 56 km at 09:00, start of the Dutch Short Trail 28 km at 12:30. Hydration stations along the route with unlimited supplies, including water, Maurten sports drink, and nutrition. Start waves with phased start, start pen opens 5 minutes before start, bib with wave indication. Transfer of bibs possible until September 25 at 18:00. Aid stations with various snacks and Maurten gels/bars on longer distances. Registration until September 12, 2026; participation requires a license or day license from Atletiekunie or hardlopen.nl.

name: BergermeerRun 2026
description: De BergermeerRun 2026 is een sportief en gezellig evenement in de wijk Alkmaar, geschikt voor jong en oud. Of je nu snel wilt lopen of gewoon mee wilt doen, iedereen is welkom om samen met vrienden en familie de finish te bereiken. Langs het parcours zorgen supporters, muziek en vrijwilligers voor een energieke sfeer. Het evenement ondersteunt dit jaar Stichting Leergeld Alkmaar en biedt een veilige loopervaring met goed bewaakte routes en EHBO-posten.
course_highlights: Veilig parcours met duidelijke route-aanduidingen
Ondersteuning door supporters, muziek en vrijwilligers langs het parcours
Maximaal 500 deelnemers voor een intieme en gezellige sfeer
additional: Tickets zijn ook te koop op het veld voor aanvang van het event met een toeslag van €2,50 per ticket. Er is plek voor maximaal 500 deelnemers. Het evenement vindt plaats op Burendag en stimuleert buurtactiviteiten en saamhorigheid. Race in Alkmaar met categorieën voor kids en volwassenen, inschrijving sluit op 25 september 2026, ter plaatse registratie mogelijk.

name: Rijk Zwaan Loop
price_range: twee tarieven voor alle afstanden, vroegboekkorting tot 8 september 2026
description: The Rijk Zwaan Run is a running race and recreational run in 's-Gravenzande, celebrating its 25th edition in 2026. The day begins with the Kidsloop at 1:00 PM, followed by various distances including a renewed 5 km and 10 km course. This year, there is also a new walking tour with distances of 7, 14, and 21 kilometers, with proceeds going to Team Westland. The organization invites runners of all levels to participate in this festive and sporty day.
course_highlights: Renewed course for 5 km and 10 km starting in Langestraat
Drinks stations along the route and refreshments after the finish with fruit, vegetables, sports drinks, and water
Walking tour with route description and coffee stop, proceeds for Team Westland
additional: Kidsloop starts at 1:00 PM with a maximum of 450 participants. Race numbers are issued in advance for early registration. For the 5 km and 10 km, SAW chips are used for time registration. Changing can be done at ISW College, at your own risk. After the finish, there is refreshment with fruit, vegetables, sports drinks, and water. The Kidsloop has separate categories per primary school group and age. The walking tour is at your own risk and includes a coffee stop along the route. Kidsloop starts at 1:00 PM, maximum 450 children, location at Sand-Ambachtstraat and ISW College, no on-site registration.

name: Roldertoren Run
description: The Roldertorenrun is a running event in and around Rolde featuring three distances: half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km. The half marathon takes you through the beautiful Drenthe landscape with heath fields, burial mounds, streams, and old cart tracks, ending at the Jacobus Church. The 10 km is suitable for experienced runners and partly runs over the Balloërveld and the Wandelspoor. The 5 km is a fast, fully paved route with views of the Balloërveld and a single track back to the finish at the tower. The start and finish are at the Roldertoren.
course_highlights: Route over the Balloërveld with purple heath fields and burial mounds
Varied terrain of paved and unpaved paths with single tracks and old cart tracks
Views of the Roldertoren and finish at the Jacobus Church
additional: Race bibs will be sent by mail. Participation is at own risk. Start and finish at the Roldertoren. Cancellation possible with refund minus administrative costs up to 1 month before the event. No pets or strollers allowed during the race. Registration for the race is closed; participants will receive their race bib by post. The event emphasizes the experience and natural beauty of the surroundings.

name: Schoklandloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld bedraagt € 7,50, dit is inclusief een aandenken aan de Schoklandloop, tijdsregistratie en een consumptie bij Restaurant Schokland

description: The Schokland Run is a unique running race organized by AV NOP in collaboration with Het Flevo-landschap and Museum Schokland. The race takes place on the beautiful UNESCO World Heritage Site Schokland and combines nature, culture, and sport on a challenging course. The 10 km route runs across the entire island of Schokland, while the 5 km route goes over the South Island via the management shed of Het Flevo-landschap. Start and finish are at Middelbuurt 2 in Schokland. Participants receive a keepsake, timing registration, and a refreshment at Restaurant Schokland.
course_highlights: 10 km route over the entire island of Schokland
5 km route over the South Island via the management shed of Het Flevo-landschap

name: Gelderse Poort Ultra
location: Hotel Restaurant Oortjeshekken, Ooij, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: The Gelderse Poort Ultra is a challenging 50-kilometer trail race that concludes the Dutch Ultra Series with distinction. The route passes through the beautiful floodplains around Nijmegen, the forests towards Berg and Dal, and the characteristic farmland in between. With between 700 and 1000 meters of elevation gain, technical paths, and a varied landscape of clog paths, heather, and forests, this ultra offers a unique nature experience. The start is at Hotel Restaurant Oortjeshekken in Ooij, where participants can enjoy a tasteful dinner afterwards and have the option to stay overnight.
course_highlights: Route through floodplains around Nijmegen and forests towards Berg and Dal
Between 700 and 1000 meters of elevation gain with many hills
Technical paths, clog paths, heather, and woodland landscape
additional: Start location is Hotel Restaurant Oortjeshekken in Ooij, which offers an à la carte restaurant and overnight accommodations. Participants navigate using a GPX file via their own watch or phone. There are 3 to 4 aid stations along the route, but no cups are available, so bring your own race cup or flasks. The time limit is 8 hours, with a finish before 17:00. Bib pickup is available from 08:30 at the race secretariat. The start location is at Hotel Restaurant Oortjeshekken in Ooij, with options for overnight stay and dinner. The route features 700-1000 meters of elevation gain, technical paths, and a time limit of 8 hours for the 50 km distance.

The course passes along open heathlands, fields, and forests towards Speuld, Huinen, and Garderen, with historic sheepfolds as landmarks and refreshment posts. The routes are approximately 99% off-road and are clearly marked, with luxury refreshment posts along the way. There is a special Kids Trail for children with a medal and access to the swimming pool.

description: The Jasperloop is a monthly running race held in the beautiful forest area near Keelven in Someren. The run is accessible to everyone, young and old, and offers a 2.5 km loop over semi-paved and sandy paths. Participants can decide how many laps they run, with a maximum of six. The start is at 10:00 AM and registration is available from 9:30 AM at the start location. The Jasperloop is a friendly and accessible run that has been organized for many years.

Semi-paved and sandy paths
Maximum of 6 laps, self-determined during the run

Parking is available at bosrandweg 6, 5711 RJ Someren, with clear signage from the provincial road. The run is organized every last Sunday of the month, except in December. The Jasperloop includes various distances and is characterized by a friendly atmosphere with family and training runs. Other events such as training sessions and fireworks are also organized around the race.

name: Sport 2000 Sparta Westvlietloop op zondag 27 september 2026
location: Sportpark Westvliet, Voorburg, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Sport 2000 Sparta Westvliet Run is a running race organized by AV Sparta in Voorburg, held on Sunday, September 27, 2026. The race offers various distances, including youth runs of 1 km and 2.5 km, and adult runs of 5 km and 10 km. The start takes place from the athletics track at Sportpark Westvliet. The course passes through a diverse area with routes along Westvlietweg, Schrepelpad, a bicycle bridge, the ADO stadium, and bike tunnels, with the 10 km runners completing two laps. The organization invites both members and non-members to participate and get to know the club.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the athletics track of AV Sparta at Sportpark Westvliet
Course along Westvlietweg, Schrepelpad, bicycle bridge, and ADO stadium
10 km runners complete two laps, 5 km runners one lap
additional: The race is made possible by Sport 2000 at Julianaplein in Voorburg. There are youth runs of 1 km and 2.5 km and adult runs of 5 km and 10 km. The organization hopes for participation from both members and non-members to introduce them to AV Sparta. The location is Groene Zoom 20, 2491 EH The Hague. The race is held on and around the athletics track at Sportpark Westvliet, with routes over Westvlietweg, Schrepelpad, bicycle bridge, ADO stadium, and bike tunnels.

name: Runway Run for KiKa - Twente Airport
organizer: Stichting Runway Run voor Run for KiKa
description: The Runway Run for KiKa at Twente Airport is a unique running event held on the runway of a former airbase. Participants experience a special combination of sport, experience, and meaning as they run on the asphalt surrounded by airplanes and music. The event offers various distances, including a Kidsrun, 5 km, and 10 km, and is a great opportunity to come together in action against childhood cancer. The flat courses are ideal for both beginner and experienced runners who want to push their limits.

Very flat course, perfect for record attempts
Timing provided by myLaps
additional: After finishing, participants receive a medal and something to quench their thirst. There is an opportunity for a drink or snack at Vliegveld Twenthe Event Location. There is a business team competition with a ranking and a prize for the winning team. Start and finish are at Vliegveld Twenthe Event Location. Run on the runway of an airport, distances: Kidsrun, 5 km, 10 km

name: 100 Bruggenloop
description: The 100 Bridges Walk in Leiden is a unique walking and running event where participants cross 100 bridges, ranging from centuries-old stone arch bridges to modern bridges in Singelpark. The route passes along rivers, canals, drawbridges, and moats, and goes through the most beautiful spots of the historic city center, including the oldest university in the Netherlands, Hortus Botanicus, and various monuments. The walk takes place on Saturday, September 26, 2026, and the running race on Sunday, September 27, 2026. There are different distances available, so both recreational walkers and runners can participate.
course_highlights: 100 bridges over rivers, canals, drawbridges, and moats
Along historic sites such as the oldest university and Hortus Botanicus
Route through Singelpark, harbors, city gates, and distinctive architecture
additional: Walkers start on Saturday between 08:00 and 11:00 AM from Van der Werfpark. Runners start on Sunday from 08:00 AM at the City Hall Square/Vismarkt. There is a time limit for walking until 16:15 and for running until 11:15. There is catering along the route, stamp stations, first aid, and a commemorative medal. Dogs are allowed if on a leash, except in Hortus Botanicus. Children up to 12 years old may participate only under supervision. The city is not closed; the route goes over sidewalks and pedestrian areas. Same-day registration is possible with an additional fee of €2.00. The event provides practical information about registration, times, and facilities. The route includes various surfaces such as gravel, shells, brick, cobblestones, wood, concrete, and asphalt, and is accessible for people with disabilities.

name: Marathonblokken - Run Your City
description: Marathonblokken is a series of running trainings organized by Hardloopnetwerk in collaboration with PUMA, aimed at preparing runners for their marathon. The trainings take place in various cities such as Amsterdam, Soest, and Utrecht, where participants run together at marathon pace and half marathon pace. During the sessions, participants can test PUMA shoes and try sports nutrition. The event offers an energetic and social atmosphere, ideal for both beginner and experienced marathon runners looking to improve their performance.
course_highlights: Training at marathon pace and half marathon pace on car-free and safe routes
Rounds around Sloterplas in Amsterdam, forested bike paths at Soesterduinen, and car-free loops on Het Lint in Utrecht
Opportunity to test PUMA running shoes and use sports nutrition during the trainings
additional: Each training has a limited number of spots (150 for Amsterdam and Soest, 300 for Utrecht). There are facilities for changing and showering at the locations. During the Utrecht training, there are water points, gels to test, and the possibility to place your own bottles. The trainings are intended as preparation for the spring marathon and offer a social and motivating environment. Trainings take place at various locations in the Netherlands, including facilities such as changing rooms and showers; the event combines sports, testing running products, and social activities.

The route passes iconic locations such as the Posbank and the Emmapiramide, with the challenging 'Wall of Aalbers' as a special segment in the standings. The Posbankloop is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners and is known for its festive finish with many spectators.

The start/finish is located close to Velp station, easily accessible by train and bike. This anniversary edition includes a walking tour and children's clinics, taking place in Velp on September 27, 2026.

name: Bavoloop Rijsbergen 2026
description: The Bavoloop in Rijsbergen is a popular village race with a rich tradition that celebrates its 37th edition in 2026. There is a varied program with three main distances, a relay for teams, a kids' run with medal, and a walker run, with live entertainment and spectators along the course creating a festive atmosphere.

The half marathon of 21.1 km takes you along green edges, parks, and nature reserves of the Green Heart over a nearly car-free course. In addition to running, you can also participate with relay teams, skate, bike, walk, and even with a leashed dog. The start and finish are at Sunset Beach Bar on the Zegerplas, where a lively atmosphere and an afterparty for participants and spectators are provided.
course_highlights: Nearly car-free course along green edges and nature reserves of the Green Heart
Routes through parks and the Zegersloot area
Start and finish at Sunset Beach Bar on the Zegerplas

Start times are for walking 21 km at 08:30, half marathon 21.1 km at 10:00, 10 km at 10:30, and 5 km at 11:00. Limited parking space; cycling is recommended. There are no changing rooms or showers, but a guarded bag drop without continuous supervision. Water stations at 13 km and water at the finish. Always wear your bib on the chest. Participants can choose their own distance and pace, making the event suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Pacers are available at various paces to support everyone.

name: Tilburg Ten Miles
description: The Tilburg Ten Miles is the most gezellig running event in Central Brabant and has been held annually since 1988. The event attracts thousands of recreational runners and top athletes who run through decorated streets of Tilburg, cheered on by enthusiastic spectators and live music. With distances of 16.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km, there is a suitable challenge for every runner. The atmosphere is festive, and the route offers a beautiful mix of urban environment and characteristic locations.
course_highlights: Run through decorated streets of Tilburg with enthusiastic spectators
Varied course through the heart of Tilburg with wide streets and characteristic locations
Live music and a festive atmosphere along the route
additional: Race numbers must be collected in advance at the Koepelhal on Saturday or Sunday. When registering before August 23, 2026, a race number with name, medal engraving, and a limited edition running shirt are included. There is a Run Against Cancer action where participants can create a campaign page and receive a special shirt with a donation of 500 euros or more. Multiple distances including walk and kids' runs; participation possible until August 16; special race numbers and merchandise; the event supports charities such as KWF.

description: The HooilandRUN is a friendly running race in and around the 't Hooiland neighborhood in Lichtenvoorde, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, children and adults. The course consists of a mix of semi-paved walking paths and paved surfaces, with rolling paths and two climbs. The race offers various distances, including 1 km and 2 km for children, and 5 km and 10 km for adults. The organization provides chip timing, water stations, and prizes for the fastest runners.

Rolling paths with two climbs (viaduct and butterfly bridge)
Rounds of 1 km for short distances and 5 km for long distances

Medals for all children, cups for the top three children in each short distance, and for the top three men and women in each adult distance. The race takes place on a course with various surfaces and climbs, held at Wijkgebouw de Schoppe. There are no shower facilities.

name: MaatGarant Run Bke Marathon
description: The MaatGarant Run Bike Marathon is an accessible and sporty event where teams of 2 to 4 participants collectively cover a marathon distance of 42.195 km. Each team member runs approximately 10 kilometers, while the rest cycle, making it ideal for anyone with a reasonable level of fitness. The event, organized by AV Spirit in Oud-Beijerland, focuses on teamwork, having fun, and team building, without emphasizing winning. The marathon takes place on Sunday, September 27, 2026, and offers a friendly and personal atmosphere, similar to the RopaRun but smaller and closer to home.

Distance of 42.195 km divided among team members
Start and finish at the event grounds of AV Spirit in Oud-Beijerland

Prizes are awarded for teams finishing in 5th, 10th, and 15th place, not only for the top three. There is ample parking at the start/finish location. Team building, accessible, sporty, and gezellig, suitable for groups and companies.

The course is traffic-free, start and finish at the clubhouse, on-site registration, and possible different start times for the half marathon.

The courses pass through both Old and New Zoetermeer, including the former Floriade site and the Balij Forest. Additionally, there are Geuzen walking tours with distances from 6 to 25 kilometers, organized by Road Runners Zoetermeer and Sportief Wandelgroep Zoetermeer.

Nautical character and unique island environment

description: The Euromast Stair Climb is a unique sporting challenge where participants climb the 589 steps of the iconic Euromast in Rotterdam. The second edition on September 27, 2026, offers an unforgettable experience with official timing, an exclusive medal, and a spectacular view of the city. The race is suitable for both athletes aiming for a personal best and anyone who wants to take on the challenge. Afterwards, there is the opportunity to relax in the Brasserie, and friends and family can also enjoy the Euromast with a discount code.
course_highlights: Climbing 589 steps, 96 meters high
Multiple start waves for smooth flow
Spectacular view over Rotterdam from the platform

location: Land van Cuijk, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Raamvallei Duomarathon is a unique duo event where teams of two participants together cover the marathon course of over 42 kilometers on a single bike. One partner runs while the other cycles, with free exchange options. The route takes you through the beautiful Land of Cuijk, along the Raam River and past various characteristic locations such as Landgoed de Barendonk, forests, meadows, and historic mills. The event emphasizes cooperation, fun, and experience, without timing or competition classification. Along the way, participants can enjoy regional snacks, drinks, and live music, culminating in a festive finish with a red carpet and a traditional Brabant sausage roll.
course_highlights: Route of over 42 km along the Raamvallei with forests, meadows, and historic locations
Start and finish at Landgoed de Barendonk
Refreshment stations with regional snacks, drinks, and live music
additional: The Duomarathon has no timing or competition classification; it focuses on sporting achievement and enjoyment. There are refreshment stations approximately every 5-7 km, 'snack spots' with local delicacies, and music. A special 'smuggling route' is available for supporters to visit multiple points along the course. About 80 volunteers support the organization and guidance. The finish is festive with a red carpet, archway, champagne, and a traditional Brabant sausage roll. The route passes through forests and meadows, with culinary treats, festive anniversary decorations, supporters, and volunteers involved.
