description: The MSV Spijkenisse Family Run is a fun and accessible running event for young and old, with special attention to children. The Family Run of 1 mile (1.6 km) is ideal for children up to and including 13 years old, who may be accompanied by an adult. In addition, there are challenging distances such as the 5 km run and the 1/4 marathon, which pass through beautiful natural areas and along recognizable spots such as the white church in Simonshaven. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and involvement with the charity, the Goofy Team of the Erasmus MC Sophia Children's Hospital.
course_highlights: 1 mile Family Run through neighborhood streets, bridges, and dike
5 km route through forests and past meadows with finish at Sporthal Den Oert
1/4 marathon along nature and the white church in Simonshaven
additional: Children up to and including 13 years old can participate in the 1 mile Family Run for free, but registration is required. A maximum of one guardian per child is allowed. Buggies and strollers are not permitted on the course. Group registration is possible for groups of 2 or more people. The award ceremony is at 15:00 in Sporthal Den Oert. Kidsrun is free for children aged 6 to 13; charitable causes are supported; the event takes place in the vicinity of Sporthal Den Oert and Simonshaven.

name: Running Junkies Trailrun
description: The Running Junkies Trailrun is a challenging trail running event in 's-Hertogenbosch, featuring two distances of 8 and 16 kilometers. The route takes you through natural and varied terrains, ideal for trail running enthusiasts looking to push their limits. The event offers a sporty and friendly atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners. Registration can be done via an external website, and the start takes place on Sunday, October 4, 2026.
course_highlights: Trail run through natural and varied terrains
Distances of 8 km and 16 km
Organized in 's-Hertogenbosch
additional: Registration closes on October 3, 2026. There are two distances: 8 km and 16 km. Registration is via an external website (inschrijven.nl). The event takes place on October 4, 2026; suitable for runners of different levels.

name: Sri Chinmoy 6 uursloop
description: The Sri Chinmoy 6-hour race takes place on Sunday, October 4, 2026, for the 20th time in the Amsterdam Forest, Amstelveen. This ultramarathon of six hours tests your limits on a beautiful and mostly unpaved course of 2.2 km per lap with a small hill. The organization ensures a friendly atmosphere, well-planned organization, and a strong field of participants, making it one of the most enjoyable ultras of the year. The start is at the paved open space 'De Uitkijk' opposite hockey club Hurley. During the race, there is a food and drink station at each lap with various snacks and beverages.
course_highlights: Lap of 2226.42 meters (2.2 km), mostly unpaved
Small hill halfway through the lap
Food and drink station at each lap with water, cola, sports drinks, soup, gingerbread, candy, fruit, bread, cheese, and chips
additional: There is a changing room available, but no shower facilities. Laps and distances are tracked by the organization. The start location is easily accessible by car and public transport, with parking options at hockey club Hurley. The race is held on October 4, 2026, in Amstelveen, with a maximum of 100 participants. Registration is possible until January 27, 2026, with options for full or half marathon participation. Parking is free at hockey club Hurley.

description: The AV Spirit Wintercup is an accessible recreational running and walking event in Lelystad, taking place on the first Sunday of each month from October to March. Everyone can participate, young or old, running or walking. The 2026-2027 season starts on October 4 with new routes for the 5 and 10 kilometers. There is a ranking for the 5 and 10 kilometers, with the best four out of five performances counting, and there are special KidsRuns with themes and medals. The Wintercup combines sportiness with conviviality and is accessible to everyone, including non-members.
course_highlights: New routes for 5 and 10 kilometers in the 2026-2027 season
Start and finish at the AV Spirit athletics track with an 8-lane track and athletics facilities
Ranking over five races with awards afterwards
additional: Digital time registration via RaceResult.com. Business run for companies and organizations. KidsRun with themes and treats, lemonade afterwards, and a medal for children who participate at least five times. Results and rankings are published online after each run. Terrain through wooded surroundings, registration in advance and on the day, medals for participants, themed KidsRuns

description: The Zeeland Walking Marathon is a popular event that brings together thousands of walkers each year for a beautiful 42.195-kilometer trek from Burgh-Haamstede to Zoutelande. The route passes through dunes, along the beach, and offers a unique combination of nature and sportiness. The Coastal Marathon itself is known as the most beautiful and toughest marathon in the Netherlands, with challenging climbs, wind, and stunning sea views. The Ladiesrun provides an accessible running experience for women with distances of 5 and 10 kilometers, starting and finishing in Zoutelande. The event is a sporting highlight in Zeeland with a festive atmosphere and a hero's welcome at the finish.
course_highlights: Course over dunes, beach, and with sea views
Start in Burgh-Haamstede and finish in Zoutelande
Challenging climbs and wind as natural elements
additional: Race numbers are sent by mail in mid-September. Race numbers with a foreign address can be picked up in advance in Zoutelande. The walking marathon starts between 7:00 and 8:30 a.m. without a group start; bus transportation from Zoutelande to Burgh-Haamstede departs promptly at 6:30 a.m. The finish closes at 6:00 p.m. The Ladiesrun starts at 5:40 p.m., timing stops at 7:45 p.m. Parking is arranged with signs, and paid parking applies in some areas. The 42 km course starts in Burgh-Haamstede and finishes in Zoutelande. Registration opens on January 1. Transportation and parking information, on-route refreshments, and a time limit of 6:00 p.m. are provided.

name: Baanloop Najaar
description: The Baanloop Autumn offers the opportunity to run a 5000-meter race on a track, with participants encouraged by a coach.

name: NightRun Borne
description: On Friday, October 9, 2026, the first edition of the NightRun Borne will take place, a festive evening run through the center of Borne. Participants run or walk a route of approximately 7 kilometers, with an option for 5 kilometers, passing through shops and special buildings that open their doors especially for the event. The NightRun Borne is not a competition; there is no timing registration and everyone is a winner. The event focuses on experience, enjoyment, and shared fun in a magical atmosphere full of light and energy.
course_highlights: Route of about 7 km with an option for 5 km
Run through shops and special buildings
Atmospheric evening with lighting and festive atmosphere
additional: Start at Kulturhus, De Haven 1, Borne. Rolling start in small groups for smooth flow. Runners start at 19:15, walkers start at 19:30. Part of the proceeds go to the charity Stelvio for Life. No official timing or results; registration details not specified; proceeds partly go to Stelvio for Life.

name: Janlouterloop
description: The Janlouterloop is an annual running event in the Vlaardingse Broekpolder, organized in memory of Jan Louter, a passionate runner and coach who passed away in 2024 from pancreatic cancer. The run offers participants a choice of three running distances (5, 10, and 15 kilometers) and a 10-kilometer walk. The event is organized by AV Fortuna and supports the charity 'Support Casper', part of the Foundation Surviving with Pancreatic Cancer. The Janlouterloop combines sportiness with camaraderie and nature experience in a unique polder environment.
course_highlights: Course through the Vlaardingse Broekpolder with the 'Janlouterlaan', a favorite natural spot of Jan Louter
Choice of 5, 10, and 15 kilometers running and a 10-kilometer walk
Refreshments along the route, changing and shower facilities, and a beautiful medal
additional: The proceeds of the event go to the charity 'Support Casper', part of the Foundation Surviving with Pancreatic Cancer. There are changing and shower facilities and refreshments along the route. The run takes place in the Broekpolder, a unique nature reserve in Vlaardingen. Terrain in Vlaardingse Broekpolder, registration via contact form, proceeds go to cancer support.

name: ASML Marathon Eindhoven
description: The ASML Marathon Eindhoven is the largest two-day sporting event in North Brabant, taking place annually in the second weekend of October. The event offers a wide range of running distances, including the marathon, half marathon, quarter marathon, and various other runs for young and old. The course is flat, wide, and atmospheric with a finish in the center of Eindhoven, ensuring fast times and a unique experience. The city is fully dedicated to sports, innovation, and connection, with enthusiastic supporters along the route. This makes the ASML Marathon Eindhoven a festive and internationally recognized running event.
course_highlights: Flat and wide course with finish in the center of Eindhoven
Atmospheric and enthusiastic cheering along the route
Route passing iconic locations in the city
additional: Participants receive a unique medal. A limited edition running shirt is available. There are special actions for 'Run against cancer' where participants can raise funds and receive a unique shirt. Registration numbers for Dutch participants are available until September 1. The finish is at the lively Vestdijk in the center of Eindhoven. Two-day event with registrations for various distances, start and finish in the center of Eindhoven, including urban walk and children's activities.

name: 1 MIJL IN LINE
location: Lange Biesakkersweg, Numansdorp, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The 7th edition of the Mile in Line is organized by Atletiekvereniging Cromstrijen on Saturday, October 10, 2026. It is a unique race over 1,609 meters in a straight line on the Lange Biesakkersweg, halfway between Klaaswaal and Numansdorp. Participants can enjoy a fast and straight route with a nice trophy for each participant and prizes for the winners. Registration is open until October 9 via inschrijven.nl, with the possibility of late registration on the day itself from 4:00 PM.
course_highlights: 1,609 meters straight line on the Lange Biesakkersweg
Start halfway between Klaaswaal and Numansdorp
Fast and clear route
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 4:00 PM on the Lange Biesakkersweg at the junction near kilometer marker 3.0. Each participant receives a nice trophy as a memento. The race takes place on flat terrain along the Lange Biesakkersweg, with registration possible via inschrijven.nl. The event starts at 4:00 PM and is part of regional festivities, with facilities for participants and spectators.

name: 10e Oosterhoutse Trail
description: The Oosterhoutse Trail celebrates its 10th anniversary edition on Saturday, October 10, 2026. This unique trail running event has been offering beautiful routes and challenging unpaved paths in a friendly atmosphere for ten years. Participants can choose from three different distances, suitable for various levels. Especially for this anniversary edition, the first 100 registrants will receive an exclusive anniversary shirt. After the race, the celebration will be jointly commemorated with a festive closing event.
course_highlights: Beautiful and varied unpaved paths
Challenging and diverse course
Stunning trail routes in the vicinity of Oosterhout
additional: The first 100 registrants will receive a free exclusive anniversary shirt. Afterward, there will be a joint celebration to mark 10 years of Oosterhoutse Trail. Trail running, multiple distances, anniversary shirt for the first 100 registrants, celebration after the race.

name: Veluwepoortloop - najaarseditie 2026
description: The Veluwepoort Run is a road running event in Nijkerk that takes place annually, with a fall edition on October 10, 2026. Participants can choose from distances of 5 km and 10 km. The event is organized by AV Nijkerk and combines athletic challenge with a playful element, allowing participants to compete to become the 'ruler of Nijkerk'. The race takes place on a Saturday and offers a great opportunity to meet running friends and achieve personal goals.
course_highlights: Road race in Nijkerk
Distances of 5 km and 10 km
Organized by AV Nijkerk
additional: The event includes a game element called 'Run Risk' where participants can compete to become the ruler of Nijkerk. Currently, no start numbers are available. Participants can register in advance via the website, and the event takes place in the rural outskirts of Nijkerk. There is no information about registration fees or pricing schedule.

name: DECAloop Utrecht
description: The DECAloop Utrecht is a challenging running race taking place in Utrecht on October 10, 2026. The race covers a distance of 67 kilometers and starts at 08:00 AM. The event offers a unique opportunity for long-distance runners to test their endurance in a scenic environment. Registration is simple via an online form, and the price is very attractive for this distance.
course_highlights: Long distance of 67 kilometers
Starts at 08:00 AM
Organized in the city of Utrecht
additional: Registration is via a Google Docs form. The price is €20.00 for the entire 67 km distance. The price per kilometer is approximately €0.30. The race may be combined with other trail events in the region, such as the DECAloop Backyard Ultra and Utrechtse Heuvelrug Ultra Trail.

name: Mijn City Run Ede
description: My City Run Ede is a unique running event taking place in the center of Ede on October 10, 2026. The race consists of a fast and spectacular 1-kilometer course through the city center, with an accessible program for young and old, including kids runs, a family run, and a business run. The day concludes with a final where the fastest recreational runners compete against (inter)national top athletes. The event combines sportiness with a festive atmosphere and is accessible to everyone, including athletes with disabilities.
course_highlights: 1 kilometer course through the center of Ede
Start at the Town Hall Square, finish at the Old Church
Route passes Achterdoelen, Maanderplein, and Museumplein
additional: The event features a movement square with information and testing stations. There are various qualification rounds for fast runners and youth, followed by a final with elite athletes. There is a corporate ranking where the four fastest times per company are summed. The course is accessible for athletes with disabilities, including participants with a running frame. Toilets are available at the start/finish. There is no cloakroom; participants are advised to leave valuables at home or hand them over to spectators. Late registration is limited. The event is open to all ages with registration via the website, including a movement square and prizes.

name: LoveLife Run Amsterdam
description: LoveLife Run Amsterdam is a special running event taking place on October 10th at the Olympic Stadium. Tough (former) cancer patients run together with their loved ones and caregivers 5 or 10 kilometers to raise funds for groundbreaking cancer research. Everyone is welcome to participate or support participants, even if you have not had cancer yourself. The event combines a sporting challenge with a powerful message of hope and involvement.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the iconic Olympic Stadium Amsterdam
Distances of 5 km and 10 km for participants and loved ones
Group warm-up and finish with a cheer moment
additional: Participants receive a LoveLife Run sports shirt and a medal. There is a 12-week training program guided by specialized trainers. After the run, there is a joint cheer moment. The event recommends using public transport or cycling due to crowds and parking costs around the Olympic Stadium. The event is open to everyone, including (former) cancer patients, their families, friends, and caregivers. It focuses on recovery, self-confidence, and community spirit, with a special emphasis on support and fundraising for cancer research.

name: Hernense Stratenloop
description: The Hernense Street Run is a small-scale, recreational running race held in the picturesque village of Hernen. On Saturday, October 10, 2026, the 17th edition will take place with four distances: 600 meters, 1200 meters, 5 kilometers, and 10 kilometers. The routes pass through the village and the beautiful countryside, along the medieval castle, the grain mill, the Hernense forest, and the rural Leur. The event is suitable for young and old and offers a sporty and friendly afternoon with a warm atmosphere and many spectators along the route.
course_highlights: Running past the medieval castle of Hernen
Route through the rural Leur and the Hernense forest
Renewed 10 km route with beautiful views and a refreshment station halfway
additional: Start numbers and chips are provided free of charge and can be collected up to half an hour before the start at the registration desk in meeting center De Mijlpaal. There is a water station along the route at the mill, and after the finish, participants receive fruit and water. First aid is available. Changing rooms and showers are available in De Mijlpaal. Prize ceremonies take place at 14:30 for the youth distances and at 16:15 for the 5 km and 10 km. The best resident of Hernen receives a special prize. Participants can register from April 2026, with on-site registration on the day of the race. The event takes place on October 10, 2026, at 'De Mijlpaal' in Hernen.

name: Noordduinloop

The Noordduinloop, held on October 10, 2026, offers a great atmosphere for both avid runners and recreational participants who want to enjoy running outdoors. The races are suitable for all ages with various distances, from kids runs to 10 km. The circuit encourages participation through a ranking based on the best four results.
course_highlights: Varied courses with dune paths and beach sections
Suitable for all ages with kids runs and 10 km distances
Unique running series along the Dutch coast
additional: Start times per distance: 500m Kidsrun at 09:30, 1 km Kidsrun at 09:35, 2 km Kidsrun at 09:45, 5 km and 10 km at 10:00. Rankings are kept for all distances, separated for girls/women and boys/men, based on the best four results of the circuit. Varied courses with dune paths and beach sections, rankings are maintained, multiple race categories including youth and adults.

name: PrattenburgRun
description: The PrattenburgRun is a running race held on Landgoed Prattenburg in Veenendaal. The 11th edition will take place on Saturday, October 10, 2026, and attracts a wide audience of running enthusiasts. There are three distances: 5 km and 10 km, which are marked, and a challenging trail run of 15 km with approximately 178 elevation meters, where participants receive a GPX file for navigation. The proceeds from the registration fee are used to protect young deciduous trees on the estate.
course_highlights: 5 and 10 km routes are marked
Trail run of 15 km with about 178 elevation meters
Trail route is unmarked, navigation via GPX file
additional: Participation is limited to 250 runners. A trail cup is available for €2,- at registration or on the day itself (payment via QR code). Parking is available at the 'Groene Entree' at the start of Cuneraweg, then a 10-minute walk to the castle. Bicycle parking is available on the castle grounds. The 15 km trail run is unmarked in the forest, with a GPX file available. Parking at 'Groene Entree'. Proceeds go to forest conservation and climate-resilient trees.

description: The Venoseloop is an annual running race held on the second Saturday of October in Vollenhove. The race offers distances of 5 and 10 kilometers and starts at 11:00 AM from holiday park 't Akkertien. The route takes you through the beautiful nature surrounding Vollenhove, allowing participants to enjoy the scenery while running. The Venoseloop is known for its welcoming atmosphere and good organization, with facilities such as changing rooms, showers, first aid, and timing registration with the IPICO chip system.
course_highlights: Start and finish at holiday park 't Akkertien
Routes of 5 and 10 kilometers through the nature around Vollenhove
Beautiful natural environment with well-marked paths
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Friday evening, October 9th from 19:30 to 20:30 or on race day from 09:00 to 10:30 at the start location. There is ample parking, changing rooms, and showers available. During the race, first aid is available on the route and at the start/finish. Timing is done with the IPICO chip system; chips are distributed with the bib number and must be returned after the race. The award ceremony is based on gross finish times. name: Run2Day Vlinderloop
location: Korfbal Vereniging Victum, Houten, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: The Run2Day Butterfly Run in Houten is a monthly performance run held on the second Saturday of September through May. The route takes you through the outskirts of Houten, passing by Castle Heemstede and the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal, offering a beautiful mix of nature and culture. The run features various distances, from 5.2 km to the half marathon, and is suitable for both youth and adults. The start is at Korfbal Vereniging Victum, and the atmosphere is friendly and sporty, with an emphasis on running together and having fun.

Route along the Kromme Rijn and through Amelisweerd
Almost entirely paved course with clear route signs and arrows
additional: There is a SAMSAMLOOP of 2500 meters where you run together with another person and finish together. There is also a team run with 4 runners finishing together. Bibs can be picked up from 4:00 PM on the day of the run. Late registration is possible digitally until 6:00 PM on the day of the run, as long as the maximum number of participants has not been reached. Water stations are available along the course, and there is a warm-up for the different distances. The run is not completely car-free but is well marked with route signs and arrows. Monthly organized performance run with various distances, suitable for recreational and competitive runners.

description: The MHB Overbetuweloop is the running event of the Betuwe, held in Elst on Sunday, October 11, 2026. The event offers five distances, including the challenging MHB 5 km and Rabobank 10 km, both certified by the Athletics Union. There are special KidsRuns of 400 m, 800 m, and a new teen run of 1300 m for children. The course takes you through the picturesque center of Elst and the beautiful countryside along the Linge, suitable for the whole family. The start times are moved earlier to prevent running during the hottest hours of the day.

The 5 km and 10 km races start simultaneously with an extra wide starting area and space for performance runners at the front. Electronic timing is used. Children aged 4-7 may run the 400 m KidsRun with a parent/guardian. Medals are included for children; adults can order a medal during registration for €2.50. A warm-up for the KidsRun is provided by Dansstudio Kerima. In case of extreme heat, additional cooling measures are arranged. The course is certified by the Athletics Union, with medals and prizes for top finishers, sustainable medal options, start and finish locations in Elst, registration open until June 20, help sought for volunteers, sports clinics, and facilities such as first aid and physiotherapy.

name: Kranenbroeker Bosloop
distance_verbose: 10 km, 8.5 km, 6.5 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km
description: The Kranenbroeker Forest Run is an annual running series held in the beautiful natural area of Kranenbroek in Echt. The races are organized by Recreatiesport Vereniging Kranenbroek and are accessible to everyone, from beginner runners to competitive athletes. The course runs over well-maintained forest paths and country roads, allowing participants to track their performance over multiple runs. The start and finish are at the same location, and various distances are available, ranging from 1 km for children to approximately 10.5 km for adults.
course_highlights: Course over well-maintained forest paths and country roads
Distances range from 1 km to about 10.5 km with colored arrows per distance
Start and finish at the same place near the shelter in the Kranenbroek nature reserve
additional: Registration is possible until 10:00 AM at the shelter near the entrance of the Kranenbroek nature reserve (Leenderstraat 1). A warm-up session begins at 10:00 AM. The 1 km kids' run starts at 10:15 AM, with the other distances starting at 10:30 AM. Each distance has its own color for the arrows on the course and the start numbers. The proceeds from the last Forest Run in April will go to a good cause. Participation is at your own risk. After the race, a Limburgian pie will be raffled among participants. Registration closes at 10:15 AM, with start and finish near the shelter, and a joint warm-up at 10:00 AM. The proceeds go to charities such as Team Para Atletiek.

name: Napoleon-Mijlenloop
price_range: gratis voor kinderen tot 12 jaar en framerunners, anders niet vermeld
description: The Napoleon Miles Run takes place on October 11 in Den Helder and offers a unique running experience through a historic area with forts and defensive works from the time of Napoleon. Participants can choose from distances of 5 or 10 English miles (8 or 16 km), and there is also a special youth run of 1.3 or 2.6 km. The route follows the Helder line and features an impressive setting of fortifications, bunkers, and the historic line dike. This run is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners and is known as one of the most enjoyable runs in the Netherlands.
course_highlights: Route over the Helder line along old forts and defensive works
Impressive setting with fortifications, bunkers, and historic line dike
Distances from 1.3 km to 16 km, suitable for all levels
additional: Registration can be done in advance via inschrijven.nl or on-site. The run can be recreational or timed, and is open to everyone from seasoned runners to beginners. Pre-registration via inschrijven.nl, course along historic sites, pasta party after the race.

name: Spelderholtloop
description: The Spelderholt Run takes place on Sunday, October 11, 2026, at Parc Spelderholt, Beekbergen. This running race is suitable for everyone, young and old, with or without disabilities. The start and finish are on the grounds of Parc Spelderholt, with the shorter distances (500 meters and 2 kilometers) taking place on the grounds and the longer distances (5 and 10 kilometers) passing through the forest. Each distance has its own start time, and participants are advised to arrive at least half an hour before the start to collect their start number.
course_highlights: 500 meter and 2 kilometer courses on the grounds of Parc Spelderholt
5 and 10 kilometer runs through the forest
Start and finish on the grounds of Parc Spelderholt
additional: Each distance has its own start time. Arrive at least half an hour before the start to collect your start number. Parking is available at the entrance of the grounds. Participation is possible for all ages. Registration is possible in advance and on the day itself; parking at Parc Spelderholt.

name: Vestingloop Edam
location: Vestingwerken Edam, Edam, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Vesting Run Edam is a traditional running race held over the old fortress of Edam. Since the first edition in 1954, in which a distance of 5 kilometers was run, the route has always remained a fixed part, despite adjustments in distances. The race offers various distances, including youth runs, a 3-mile trim run, and a 10 km race. The finish is located at the Baandervesting near the chain bridge, while the longer distances start at the Noordervesting. The Vesting Run is known for its changing weather conditions and a friendly atmosphere for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Route over the old fortress of Edam
Finish at the Baandervesting near the chain bridge
Start of 10 km and 3 miles at the Noordervesting
additional: Timing for the 10 km and 3 miles is recorded with a chip in the start number. Youth runs use shoe chips. OJC participants participate for free but must register at the registration desk to pick up a shoe chip. Free parking and showers are available in the changing rooms. Medals are awarded to the top three boys and girls in the youth runs. Cash prizes can be won in various age categories for the 10 km. Terrain over the old fortress, registration via online platform, free parking and showers available.

name: Culture Run Woerden
description: The Culture Run Woerden celebrates its first anniversary and is a unique fun run where sports, culture, and the rich history of Woerden come together. During this enjoyable run, you explore the city center in a surprising way, passing not only well-known places but also crossing iconic and cultural buildings. The combination of movement, culture, and the typical Woerden gezelligheid makes this event popular among both residents and visitors. With two distances of 5 and 10 kilometers, suitable for walking and running, it is accessible for young and old. The start and finish are at Technohub Woerden, and the course is festively decorated with acts and entertainment.
course_highlights: Course through the city center of Woerden
Crossing iconic and cultural buildings
Surprising acts and entertainment along the route
additional: The Culture Run is a fun run where participants can choose between 5 or 10 km, both walking and running. The event is suitable for young and old, families, and groups of friends. The number of starting tickets is limited due to capacity restrictions at various locations along the route. Start and finish are at Technohub Woerden. There is extra festive decoration with surprising acts and entertainment along and in the route. Course through the city center, cultural buildings, entertainment along the route, two distances (5 and 10 km), walking or running possible.

name: De 15 van Wassenaar

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld voor De 15 bedraagt €25,- plus keuze bijdrage aan goed doel

description: The 15 of Wassenaar is a charming running event taking place on Sunday, October 11, 2026. Participants can choose between a distance of 15 kilometers or 7.5 kilometers, which run through the village center, estates, and villa neighborhoods of Wassenaar. The event combines athletic challenge with a festive atmosphere, including refreshments along the route, a medal, and an afterparty to celebrate the achievement. The race is organized with attention to charitable causes and features an engaged audience along the beautiful course.
course_highlights: Route through village center, estates, and villa neighborhoods
Refreshments with 2 water stations and a fruit point along the route
Enthusiastic crowd along the scenic course
additional: All participants receive refreshments along the route, a bib number, a medal, fruit, and the first drink at the finish. There is a guarded cloakroom and an afterparty. Minimum age is 16 years for the 7.5 km and 18 years for the 15 km. There are 2 water stations and a fruit point along the route. The course is made traffic-free with traffic controllers and temporary closures. Registration is via the website, with the possibility to contribute to charitable causes. Start time is 14:30, minimum age 16 or 18 years, medal and afterparty included.

name: Rondje Bussloo
description: Rondje Bussloo is a charming running event around the Bussloo recreation area, organized by the team behind Rondje Oeken. The course of the two distances runs over paved paths through a varied landscape of water, forest, and open plains, suitable for both recreational and advanced runners. The start and finish are at Strandhuys De Enk in Wilp, which also offers cozy hospitality. The event is known for its sportive and friendly atmosphere and takes place on Sunday, October 11, 2026, at 10:30 AM.
course_highlights: Course over paved paths with a varied scenery of water, forest, and open plains
Start and finish at Strandhuys De Enk with a beautiful view over the water
Suitable for recreational and advanced runners
additional: Race numbers are available on the day at the race secretariat and will not be sent in advance. Parking at Bussloo costs €3.50 and is paid digitally when exiting the barrier. Toilets are available at Strandhuys De Enk. There is cozy hospitality at the start and finish where supporters can cheer. Fun for all ages, route with multiple start points, route markings, and use of the Strava app for route tracking.

name: Loopavond Gemzen
location: Lambert Dijkslag Atletiekbaan, Heerde, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: Loopavond Gemzen is a running event taking place on October 13, 2026, in Heerde, Netherlands. The race is held at the Lambert Dijkslag Athletics Track and offers participants the choice of distances of 3 km and 5 km. The event occurs in typically cool and clear autumn weather, ideal for performance. The organization invites runners of all levels to participate and enjoy a sporting evening.
course_highlights: Distances of 3 km and 5 km
Organized at the Lambert Dijkslag Athletics Track
Cool and clear autumn weather, average 14 °C
additional: The event takes place on an athletics track, which implies a flat and fast course. The weather conditions are generally cool and clear, favorable for performance. The event is held at the Lambert Dijkslag Athletics Track; check details and registration with the organizer in advance.

name: 5e Duin en Bollen Vierdaagse
description: The Duin en Bollen Vierdaagse is a fun walking event in the autumn through the beautiful landscapes of South Holland. Participants can choose from five walking distances and walk 1 to 4 days through colorful forests, dunes, villages, and along the Dutch coast. Along the way, walkers are surprised by music, theater, atmospheric chill spots, and cozy stops with treats. The routes pass iconic locations such as Keukenhof, the Amsterdam Dunes, and historic villages, making it a charming and varied walking adventure for everyone.
course_highlights: Walking routes along the sea, dunes, colorful forests, and cozy villages
Passage through Keukenhof Forest and Keukenhof Castle
Beautiful natural areas such as the Amsterdam Dunes and historic polders
additional: Start package pickup on Wednesday, October 14, 2026, between 17:00-20:00 at Museum De Zwarte Tulp in Lisse. Start and finish locations vary per day and distance, with start times ranging from 8:00 to 11:45 depending on the distance. Medal for participation in 4 days, commemorative pin for 1-3 days or weekend participation. Music, theater, chill spots, and treats along the route. Routes pass by historic and natural sights such as castles, mills, polders, and nature reserves. Facilities and logistical details for the walking route, start and finish locations, and medal distribution.

name: Veenendaal City Run
description: The Veenendaal City Run is a fun run full of light and sound through Winkelstad Veenendaal, organized by Sportservice Veenendaal.

name: Geopark Hondsrug Crosscircuit
organizer: Stichting De Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark
description: The Geopark Hondsrug Cross Circuit is a challenging cross-country circuit taking place in the beautiful Hondsrug area, a unique glacial landscape and UNESCO Global Geopark. The circuit consists of multiple cross races organized by various local running groups, allowing participants to actively move through a natural and diverse environment. Participants of different ages and levels can join, with special rules for juniors. The circuit promotes sportsmanship and connection with the landscape.
course_highlights: Running through the unique glacial landscape of the Hondsrug
Varied natural areas and challenging cross courses
Organized by local running groups with attention to safety
additional: Participants take part at their own risk and must be adequately insured. Juniors (ages 12 to 17) are only allowed to run the short distance. Refunds of registration fees are not possible, but participant replacements are allowed up to one week before the event. Encouragement prizes are awarded at the closing in Grolloo. The event includes various cross races in the region, focusing on active movement and exploring the geopark area.

name: Run for Kika Amsterdam
description: On October 19, 2025, the Run for KiKa Amsterdam 8km invites participants to support the fight against childhood cancer by running through the heart of Amsterdam.
course_highlights: 8 km race through Amsterdam
Support the fight against childhood cancer
Event date: October 19, 2025

name: 50e Jan Koudstaal Dijkloop - Halve Marathon Schoonhoven
description: The 50th Jan Koudstaal Dijkloop in Schoonhoven is a running event with multiple distances, including 1.5 km, 6 km, 10 km, and the half marathon of 21.1 km. The race is affiliated with the Atletiekunie and offers a varied course for both recreational and more experienced runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of Schoonhoven. Prices range from €3.00 to €15.00, depending on the distance.
course_highlights: Distances ranging from 1.5 km to 21.1 km (half marathon)
Affiliated with the Atletiekunie
Organized in the surroundings of Schoonhoven
additional: Registration is possible via online forms, and the event is affiliated with the Atletiekunie. Additional facilities such as a DJ and a poffertjes stall contribute to a festive atmosphere.

name: Bierrun Groningen
description: The Bierrun Groningen on October 17, 2026, is a fun social run of approximately 8 kilometers through the city of Groningen. During the route, you visit four local breweries where you can taste five delicious Groningen beers. There is no timing registration; it’s about running together, enjoying beer, and discovering interesting beer stories. The start and finish are at Folkingebrew The Pub, and afterwards, there is a social gathering to relax and enjoy.
course_highlights: Route of about 8 km along 4 Groningen breweries
5 tasting glasses of delicious local beers
Start and finish at Folkingebrew The Pub (Boterdiep)
additional: There are 2 start groups: one at 13:00 and one at 13:30. There is no timing registration; it is a social run. An exclusive Runners Beer can be pre-ordered and will be ready on the day itself. After the run, there is a social gathering with more beer. Participants receive a sporty keepsake and a unique medal at the finish. The route starts from Folkingebrew The Pub, with the option to order an exclusive Runners Beer. The event focuses on fun, gezelligheid, and discovering Groningen beers.

name: A. Vogelloop
description: The A.Vogelloop is a festive running race taking place on October 17, 2026, in 't Harde. The race is organized by Wallenloop and Havenloop together with A.Vogel, supporting the charitable foundation Opkikker. The route runs through the beautiful Zwaluwenburg estate with an unpaved 5-kilometer loop through a wooded environment, starting and finishing in the lovely A.Vogeltuinen. There is attention for both recreational and professional runners, and there are special youth distances with medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Unpaved 5-kilometer loop through woods and past a forest pond
Start and finish in the A.Vogeltuinen with beech trees and rhododendrons
Youth run entirely within the A.Vogel gardens
additional: Start and finish at the visitor center of A.Vogel. There is a pagoda tent, water station, coffee, tea, and soft drinks available, along with some stalls selling products, toilets, and a water tap. Prizes for the top 3 adults and children, medals for all youth participants. Parking is available at Eperweg 3-5; cycling is recommended. The race is organized in collaboration with local clubs and charities, offering a recreational and sporting event for all ages.

description: The Bosse Pielenloop in Vogelwaarde is a friendly running race organized by Voetbalclub Vogelwaarde. The race offers various distances, including a children's run and longer distances of 4.6 km, 9.4 km, and 13.3 km. Each participant receives a traditional Bosse Piel, a duck-shaped cookie, as a souvenir. The event takes place on Saturday, October 17, 2026, and provides changing rooms and showers in the facilities of VV Vogelwaarde.
course_highlights: Distances of 4.6 km, 9.4 km, and 13.3 km
Children's run of 1000 meters for children aged 6 to 12
Traditional Bosse Piel cookie for every participant
additional: Changing rooms and showers available in the facilities of VV Vogelwaarde. Award ceremony and raffle at 16:45. Registration fee payable in cash or card upon pickup of bib number. Registration is online and recommended, starting after 14:15. Location not specified, includes a traditional Bosse Piel cookie for participants.

name: Giblo-run
description: The Giblo-run takes place on October 17, 2026, in Beerse and offers an active day with running races and walks for various distances. Participants can choose from 5 km, 10 km, and 10 miles, with well-marked routes and refreshments along the way. There is a treasure hunt with assignments and various activities for children such as a bouncy castle and a climbing park. After the event, there is an award ceremony and food trucks are present for food and drinks. The organization ensures a safe and friendly atmosphere with facilities such as a cloakroom and showers.
course_highlights: Color-coded signage: yellow (5 km), green (10 km), red (10 miles)
Refreshments along the route with water, and fruit and water at the finish
Child-friendly activities: treasure hunt, bouncy castle, trampolines, climbing park, and face painting
additional: Registrations are possible until the day itself on-site at the GIBLO meadow (Antwerpseweg 48) via the green gate Tanseleerstraat. Payment can be made with tokens purchased at the entrance using Payconiq or cash. A cloakroom is available at the start, and participants can shower after the event in the sports hall 't Beerke with group showers. The award ceremony takes place on the podium on the GIBLO meadow. Food trucks offer fries, hamburgers, pancakes, and fresh soup. Terrain: city and park environment, registration via phone or email, including children's and obstacle runs, walking routes, and a photo treasure hunt.

name: Singelloop Middelburg
description: The Singelloop Middelburg is an annual running event held in the historic center of Middelburg. The race offers a challenging course of 6.75 kilometers through the atmospheric canals and streets of the city. The event is accessible to both competitive and recreational runners and is known for its friendly and sporty atmosphere. The organization of Dynamica Sport ensures a well-organized race with a wide field of participants.
course_highlights: Course of 6.75 km through the historic center of Middelburg
Running along atmospheric canals and picturesque city streets
Suitable for both competitive and recreational runners
additional: Members of Dynamica receive a 50% discount on the registration fee when registering in advance. There is a distinction between official races and recreational runs. Registration is handled via the race secretariats or the website. The race is part of the race program of Dynamica Sport. The race takes place on October 17, 2026, from 14:00 to 16:30, and is a popular event for runners in Zeeland.

name: Boerbos cross
organizer: Stichting De Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark
description: The Boerbos Cross in Rolde is a challenging cross-country race through the unique landscape of the Boerbos, part of the UNESCO Global Geopark De Hondsrug. The route runs over unpaved paths, hills, heather, and sand drifts, with distances for juniors, seniors, and masters. The cross is organized by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten, and Vomos and is part of the Hondsrug cross circuit. Timing is done without a chip, and a limited number of participants are allowed.
course_highlights: Unpaved paths through forest and heather
Historical sand drift with challenging hills
Varied terrain of sand and hills
additional: The cross has three categories: juniors (12-17 years, approx. 5 km), seniors, and masters with short distance (5 km) and long distance (approx. 9 km). Timing is chipless. A waiting list is possible if registration is full. Public transport is available with a stop within walking distance. Course of about 5 or 9 km through forest and sand drift, registration via inschrijven.nl, maximum 100 participants for the Boerbos Cross alone, maximum 250 for the cross circuit.

name: Dutch Backyard Ultra Zeewolde
description: The Dutch Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon where participants start each hour on the same 6.706 km loop. There is no fixed finish; anyone who completes the loop within the hour starts again exactly one hour later. The event lasts as long as the participants keep going, with only one winner: the last runner to complete a loop, the 'last man standing'. The route in Zeewolde runs through the Scouting Landgoed and mainly passes through nature with few elevation changes.
course_highlights: Each loop is exactly 6.706 km long
Route through Scouting Landgoed Zeewolde with minimal elevation gain
Natural area with quiet, unpaved paths
additional: Participants must complete each loop within an hour to be allowed to start the next. No personal assistance is permitted during a loop, only communal aid stations. Artificial aids such as poles are not allowed. Participants who do not finish within the hour receive a DNF. The distance run by each participant is shared. Participants and crew have access to the basecamp, an open field the size of a football pitch where the loop starts and ends. The race is held on the Scouting Landgoed Zeewolde, with no campers allowed and tents of 4x4 meters. It is expected that only one participant will finish, making the race particularly challenging.

name: TCS Amsterdam Marathon 2026
location: Olympisch Stadion, Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The TCS Amsterdam Marathon takes place on Sunday, October 18, 2026, and is known for its fast and flat course with a rich historical background. The start and finish are in the iconic Olympic Stadium, with a route along the Amstel River, stately mansions, windmills, and through the green Vondelpark. This event attracts thousands of runners annually and offers an unforgettable experience with enthusiastic supporters along the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the historic Olympic Stadium
Course along the Amstel with beautiful views of mansions and windmills
Through the green heart of the city: Vondelpark

name: MOLENHOEKS MAKKIE running the hills
location: Molenhoek, Rijk van Nijmegen, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: The Molenhoeks Makkie is a trail run in October starting in Molenhoek, located in the Rijk van Nijmegen. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, or 15 kilometers, with all routes offering a hilly course instead of a flat road race. With a maximum of 1,400 participants, it provides a more intimate running experience compared to large urban events. The organization, Stichting Molenhoeks Makkie, provides extensive facilities such as public transportation, parking, changing rooms, first aid, AEDs, a monitored wardrobe, and massage services.
course_highlights: Hilly course instead of flat road
Start and finish in Molenhoek, Rijk van Nijmegen
Distances of 5, 10, and 15 kilometers

name: Herfstloop Twente
location: Atletiek Club TION, Enschede, Overijssel, Netherlands
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16 km, 8 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Autumn Run Twente is one of the oldest running events in East Netherlands, organized since 1976 by Atletiek Club TION in Enschede. The race takes place through the beautiful countryside near Rutbeek and offers a suitable distance for every runner. In 2026, the routes of the 5-mile, 10-mile, and half marathon will return to their original courses. The 2-mile race, introduced in 2024, is a popular distance for beginners and youth. The atmosphere is professional yet informal, with strong involvement from volunteers and sponsors.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful nature area near Rutbeek
Original courses for 5 miles, 10 miles, and half marathon
2-mile distance suitable for (re)beginners and youth
additional: Start and finish are at the track at AC TION. Participation in the 2-mile race is possible from age 11. The organization consists of a committee of 7 people and more than 50 volunteers on the day itself. The Autumn Run is rated with an average score of 8 by participants. Registration is via the website, facilities include free parking, medal option for €1.50, and an event set in the natural environment of Enschede.

name: Turfveld Wintercross 5, 10, en 15 km, Texel
location: De Dennen, Den Burg, Texel, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Turfveld Winter Cross in Den Burg on Texel is a challenging cross-country race series held in the wooded area De Dennen near Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld. The first race on October 18, 2026, offers multiple distances, including 14.9 km, 9.8 km, 4.91 km, and 0.75 km, with a start location at Nattevlakweg. The route takes you over beautiful, winding paths in the forest and is suitable for both youth and adults. The cross-country race is part of a series of five races, with participation in at least three races required for the standings. Start times are 10:30 AM for youth up to 12 years old and 10:50 AM for other participants.
course_highlights: Wooded environment De Dennen with winding paths
Longest distance on October 18 is approximately 14.7 km divided over 3 laps
Sheltered start location at Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld
additional: Registration is possible from 9:45 AM at 't Bospaviljoen Turfveld, Nattevlakweg 2. Preferably pay in cash with exact change; otherwise, a Tikkie will be sent. Youth up to and including 12 years run 750 meters and start at 10:30 AM, other distances start at 10:50 AM. The cross-country race is part of a series of five races, with participation in at least three races required for the standings. Season 2026-2027, multiple distances, course from 2 km to 14.7 km, registration from 9:45 AM, location 't Turfveld, Den Burg.

name: 10 van AVR
description: The 10 of AVR is an annual running race in Rucphen that offers both a 10-kilometer and a 5-kilometer course. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and the challenging route that takes participants through the beautiful landscape of the region. The organization of AVR'90 ensures a socially safe sports environment and a well-organized day for all participants. The event attracts both recreational runners and competitive athletes and is a staple in the local running calendar.
course_highlights: 10 kilometer and 5 kilometer courses
Running through the beautiful landscape of Rucphen
Friendly and sporty atmosphere
additional: The race offers a good opportunity to run a fast time at the end of the season.

description: The Bunkercross in Olst is a unique and challenging cross-country race celebrating its 17th edition as the sporting opening of the Sallands Cross Circuit. The completely unpaved course takes you over historic command bunkers and through the forests of landgoed De Haere, an area full of nature and history. The race attracts a wide range of participants, from regional top athletes to passionate recreational runners, and offers an exciting and atmospheric start to the cross-country season. Race numbers are distributed at the impressive Castle De Haere, where participants can also enjoy a friendly chat afterwards.
course_highlights: Completely unpaved course over landgoed De Haere
Passage over historic command bunkers and emergency hospital bunker
Varied forest terrain with challenging climbs
additional: Race numbers are distributed at Castle De Haere, where participants can also enjoy a friendly chat afterwards. The Bunkercross is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit with 10 cross-country races. The start times for the Bunkercross on October 18, 2026, are 1 km at 10:45, 2 km at 11:15, 5.5 km at 12:00, and 11 km at 13:00. The course is 100% unpaved and runs over historic bunkers and through forests. Fully unpaved course, historic bunkers, forests, distances from 1 km to 11 km, registration via mijninschrijving.nl.

name: Zeezichtloop Petten
description: The Zeezichtloop Petten takes place on October 18, 2026, with start and finish at Plein 1945 in the heart of Petten. The race offers various distances for runners and walkers, including a relaxed walk of 10 or 15 kilometers, a challenging 5 km running route that is run twice, and a festive Kidsrun for the youngest participants. The course passes through the village center, along the dike with beautiful sea views, dunes, and forest, avoiding steep climbs and muddy sand for a more accessible route. The day concludes with award ceremonies and the presentation of the Erik ten Velden trophy to the fastest Pettemer in the 10 km.
course_highlights: Route along village center, dike with sea view, dunes, and forest
Avoidance of steep climbs and muddy sand
Warm encouragement moment at Plein 1945 halfway through the second lap of the 5 km
additional: Online registration is possible until October 17, 2026, at 17:00. The Kidsrun is divided into age categories with different rounds (2-4 years: 1 round approx. 350 m, 5-8 years: 2 rounds approx. 700 m, 9-12 years: 3 rounds approx. 1100 m). The Erik ten Velden trophy is awarded to the fastest Pettemer in the 10 km. Results and photos are available via the website and social media channels. Walkers can choose 10 or 15 km at their own pace without competition pressure. Routes along sea, forest, and dike; registration until October 17, 2026; free parking; rainproof fairground run.

name: Rode Loper Run

The trails range from 12 km to 50 km, including a swim trail and various kids' trails, all starting and finishing at Laguna Beach. The combination of dunes and coast provides a unique and varied running experience, with weather conditions in October adding an extra challenge. This 14th edition offers a perfect location for both runners and supporters.

description: The AERS Group Zeeland Cross Competition is a fall and winter season cross-country competition consisting of seven races, organized by regional athletics clubs in Zeeland. The competition is open to everyone, including non-members, and offers various distances for youth and adults/masters. The courses mainly consist of grass and forest paths, with potentially muddy sections depending on the weather, making shoes with good grip recommended. There is always a reward for youth participants and prizes for adults and masters per category, both per race and for the entire competition.
course_highlights: Courses consist of grass and forest paths
Depending on the weather, sections may be muddy
Short and long cross distances for different age categories
additional: The competition consists of 7 cross races in the season. There is a points classification that is updated and published after each race. For adults and masters, there is an award ceremony per category, both daily prizes and for the entire competition. Spikes or shoes with good grip are recommended due to the terrain. Cross-country running on grass and forest paths, muddy when it rains, short and long distances for youth and adults, prizes for daily winners and overall standings.

name: Snertcross

price_tiers.distance: Lange cross dames en Lange cross heren 55+

description: The Snertcross is an annual running race in Warandebos, Tilburg, organized by T.S.A.V. Parcival. The race is part of the Regio 13 Crosscircuit and is included in the Tilburg Triple. The Snertcross offers various categories and distances, including juniors, short cross, long cross women, long cross men 55+, and long cross men. The race is characterized by a challenging course with multiple laps depending on the distance.
course_highlights: Junior cross: 2 laps
Short cross: 1 lap
Long cross women and men 55+: 3 laps; Long cross men: 4 laps
additional: Late registrations are possible up to one hour before the start of the respective race on race day. Payment can only be made in cash or via a payment request with QR code. The Snertcross is part of the Tilburg Triple, where participants who take part in three or more events receive an exclusive medal. Registration is possible several days before the race, with late registration on race day. The race takes place in Warandebos, with parking available on the university campus. There are no changing facilities at the start, but there are facilities at Tilburg University sports center.

name: Lage Vuursche Ultra
description: The Lage Vuursche Ultra is a challenging 50 km trail run through historic forests around Baarn, featuring a varied course of deciduous and coniferous forests, heathlands, and open plains. The route is run using a GPX file and offers a nice mix of single tracks, forest paths, and avenues. The on-course support is well organized with a maximum of 15 km between aid stations, and participants receive a UTMB index at the finish. This event is part of the Dutch Ultra Series 2026 and is known for its natural beauty and challenging nature.
course_highlights: 50 km through historic forests with deciduous and coniferous trees
Varied course with single tracks, forest paths, and heathlands
Maximum 15 km between aid stations, no disposable cups
additional: Start and finish at Natuurcamping De Zeven Linden with parking facilities. Bib and tracker pickup from 08:30 at the race secretariat. Time limit 8 hours, finish by 17:00 at the latest. No disposable cups at aid stations, own race cup required or available for purchase at the secretariat. Participants receive detailed information two days before the event via email. Maximum of 300 participants, no cups at the stations, start and finish at Kampeerterrein de Zeven Linden.

name: Halloween Citywalk
description: The Halloween City Walk in Veghel is a spooky walk of approximately 3 kilometers through the center of Veghel, organized on Halloween evening, October 31, 2026. It is not a running race, but a creepy experience for the whole family with various scary figures along the route that frighten the participants. The walk starts between 7:00 PM and 8:00 PM at the Market near ice cream parlor Matteucci. Participation is possible from 16 years old, younger participants may only walk accompanied by an adult.
course_highlights: Route of about 3 kilometers through the center of Veghel
Spooky and creepy atmosphere with sinister characters along the route
Start at the Market near ice cream parlor Matteucci
additional: Individual participation possible from 16 years old; younger participants only under the supervision of a parent or adult. Start time between 7:00 PM and 8:00 PM. The walk is not a race but an event with a spooky atmosphere. Registration for the Krollenloop itself is sold out, but registration for the Halloween City Walk is still possible. Start at 7:00 PM, registration via the website, participants from 16 years old can participate independently, younger participants accompanied by an adult.

name: Ijzeren Man Volksloop
description: The IJzeren Man Volksloop is a well-known event in Weert and the surrounding area. Since 1980, AV Weert has been organizing this trail run in the IJzeren M nature reserve.

name: Startbaanrun
description: Under the motto 'De StartbaanRun gives children plenty of room,' we hope to raise a lot of money again with the edition of November 2, 2025, for our G

name: Alphense Bergen Trail
location: Cultureel Centrum Den Heuvel – Heuvelstraat 5 - Alphen (NB)
description: The Alphense Bergentrail is a challenging trail run through a diverse natural area around the pond 'Het Zand'. You run through forests and heathlands.

name: Pingelloop Haaksbergen
location: Clubgebouw ‘n Diek en atletiekbaan, Scholtenhagenweg 39, 7481 VN Haaksbergen
description: On November 3, 2024, it's time to enjoy the beautiful nature in the Het Lankheet nature reserve, together with other runners and enthusiasts.

name: Grote Veldloop Vorden
description: Runners will face a special challenge on Sunday, November 3, 2024: the Great Field Run. In the beautiful nature reserve the Grot

name: Krollenloop
description: The Krollenloop is an annual running event held in Veghel, with the eleventh edition on Sunday, November 3, 2024. This race offers

name: Smokkeltrail
description: The Smuggling Trail is a challenging trail run, specially for experienced runners. The route is 90% off-road and runs over uneven and very varied terrain.

name: Boerenkoolloop
location: Atletiekbaan van AV NOVA, Warmenhuizen, Noord-Holland, Netherlands

description: The Boerenkoolloop in Warmenhuizen is a fun race and fitness run over 5 and 10 km, starting and finishing at the athletics track of AV NOVA. The course takes participants through the villages of Tuitjenhorn, Eenigenburg, and Warmenhuizen, partly over quiet polder roads and the monumental Westfriese Omringdijk, where the wind can be an challenging factor. After the race, each participant receives a bag with ingredients for a delicious boerenkool mash, sponsored by Koninklijke VEZET. There is also a youth run of 1.2 km and a walking tour of approximately 11 km, where walkers follow a partly reversed route. The facilities offer spacious changing rooms, warm showers, and additional amenities for comfort.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the athletics track of AV NOVA
Route over quiet polder roads and the monumental Westfriese Omringdijk
View of the surrounding landscape and wind as a challenging factor
additional: Race numbers will be sent and are expected to arrive around October 30th. They can also be collected up to 15 minutes before the start at the Harenkarspelhal next to AV NOVA. Spacious changing rooms and warm showers are available. After the race, everyone receives a boerenkool package with sausage, potatoes, and herbs. Parking is available at AV NOVA and at Bejo Zaden BV approximately 800 meters away. The walking tour starts between 8:30 and 9:30 am; participants must be at the finish by 12:30 pm to receive the boerenkool package. Registration is via Inschrijven.nl until October 25th; same-day registration is not possible. Start times are 11:10, 11:25, and 11:35. Start and finish at the athletics track of AV NOVA.

name: Bosloop Malden
description: The Bosloop Malden is a running race with a rich history since 1978 and will be held on Sunday, November 1, 2026. It is a popular race among the smaller running events in the Netherlands, ideal for testing form two weeks before the Zevenheuvelenloop. The race offers distances of 5, 10, and 15 kilometers through the woods, and there are also special runs for children, including the Bambinoloop for children aged 3 to 8 and a 2-kilometer run for children aged 9 to 12. Participation for children up to 12 years old is free, made possible by sponsor Medical Training Malden. Registration is open from September 1 to October 30, 2026, and closes once the maximum number of participants per distance is reached.
course_highlights: Running through the woods of Malden
Distances of 5, 10, and 15 kilometers
Special youth distances: Bambinoloop and 2 km Kidsrun
additional: Number pickup from 9:00 AM at the race grounds. The Bambinoloop has two starts: first for ages 3-5, then for ages 6-8. No timing is provided for Bambinoloop. The 2 km run is part of the MTM Kidsrun Bosloop Malden School Trophy. Registration on race day is not possible. Full = full per distance. Distances include 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km, with special races for children; free participation for children under 12; registration from September 1 to October 30, 2026; no registration on race day possible.

name: Haarlerbergloop
distance_verbose: 30 km, Halve marathon, 16 km, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km
price_range: € 2 voor herinneringsmedaille, overige kosten niet gespecificeerd
description: The Haarlerberg Run is a challenging running event in the beautiful surroundings of the Sallandse Heuvelrug, with almost entirely unpaved paths over fields, sandy roads, forest and heath paths. The event spans two days: on Saturday, October 31, 2026, the Haarlerberg Trail takes place with distances of 11, 16, 22, and 30 km, and on Sunday, November 1, 2026, the shorter distances of 1, 2.5, 5, and 10 km are scheduled. The run is small-scale and is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit and the CrossCircuit of the East. The start and finish location is on Molenweg in Haarle near café De Droadnagel, which also has facilities such as toilets and changing rooms.
course_highlights: Almost entirely unpaved paths over fields, sandy roads, forest and heath paths
Beautiful routes through National Park the Sallandse Heuvelrug
Steep hills and wide vistas
additional: Start and finish location at Molenweg in Haarle near café De Droadnagel with toilets and changing rooms, no showers. Bib pickup and bag drop at own risk. No late registration, pre-registration until 30 minutes before start. Participants in 5 km and 10 km can purchase a commemorative medal (€ 2) after the race. The trail is limited to 349 participants and registration closes no later than October 31 at 11:30 or earlier if full. Own reusable cup required for the trail, reusable cup available for purchase (€ 4). No awards ceremony for the trail, but every participant receives a medal. Participants in the 5 km and 10 km races contribute € 1 per participant to Stichting Support for Nature. Distances: 1 km, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 11 km, 16 km, 22 km, 30 km; terrain run; registration from September; contribution to Support for Nature; races including trail and youth distances.

name: Loop Esch Door
description: Esch Door Running is a running event in and around the center of Tubbergen, featuring a challenging and fast course over the Tubbergse Esch. Since 2022, the event has grown into an adult race with a festive atmosphere and a beautiful mix of performance and recreation. The event offers various distances for runners of all levels, including special runs for children and people with disabilities. The start and finish are at the Raadhuisplein in Tubbergen, where conviviality and camaraderie are also central.
course_highlights: Fast course through the countryside and the Tubbergse Esch
Start and finish at the Raadhuisplein in the center of Tubbergen
Various distances from 500 meters to 10 kilometers, including walking routes
additional: Pick up race numbers on November 1st from 08:00 at the town hall of Tubbergen until 30 minutes before the start. Walkers can collect their start number from 09:00. Parking at the swimming pool on Sportlaan is recommended. There is a water station on the course and sports nutrition available after the race. First aid is present along the route. KinderKroon KidsRuns start from 12:45 with different age categories. Prize ceremonies take place shortly after the finish of each distance. The event also offers an inclusive run for people with disabilities and has a cozy, community-oriented atmosphere.

name: Maasduinenloop
location: Afferden, Nationaal Park De Maasduinen, Limburg, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Maasduinenloop is a charming running event taking place in National Park De Maasduinen, with start and finish at Golf Course Bleijenbeek in Afferden. The run offers a unique experience through beautiful nature and combines sportiness with conviviality. The proceeds of the event go entirely to burn wound care at the Expertise Center for Pediatric Trauma and Burn Wound Care at Radboudumc Amalia Children's Hospital. The Maasduinenloop welcomes runners of all ages and levels, with special attention to young participants via the Kidsrun.
course_highlights: Running through National Park De Maasduinen
Start and finish at atmospheric Golf Course Bleijenbeek
New routes with a 10 km loop
additional: Kidsrun start times: 10:30 AM (up to 7 years old, 500 m) and 10:45 AM (8 to 11 years old, 1,000 m). All Kidsrun participants receive a medal and a healthy snack. Award ceremony immediately after the Kidsrun around 11:00 AM. Teams consist of men, women, or mixed; score is the sum of the three fastest times. Team members automatically participate in the individual run at no extra cost. Start and finish at Golf Course Bleijenbeek. Distances range from 500 meters to 10 km, with the course marked and guided by traffic controllers and mountain bikers, using time registration, with start and finish at Landgoed Bleijenbeek.

description: The Warnsborn Cross is a traditional cross-country race held on the beautiful Warnsborn estate near Arnhem. The race is run on unpaved paths along streams and ponds, with challenging elevation changes. There are three distances: 5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km, which respectively consist of 1, 2, or 3 laps of 5.5 km. There is also a Kidsrun of 1200 meters for children up to and including 12 years old. The start and the collection of race numbers take place at Tennis Association Schaarsbergen.
course_highlights: Unpaved paths through the Warnsborn estate
Running along streams and ponds
Challenging elevation changes
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 9:30 to 10:45 AM at Tennis Association Schaarsbergen, Kemperbergerweg 671a, 6816 RT Arnhem. The Kidsrun starts at 10:30 AM, the other distances start at 11:00 AM. Start and registration at Tennis Association Schaarsbergen, course over unpaved paths with elevation changes, suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit
description: The Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit starts on November 1, 2026, and consists of nine varied running races spread over six months in the Green Heart. The circuit is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners and offers a platform where participation is more important than winning. Participants can choose from different distances and benefit from an affordable circuit registration, including a free running shirt and a finishing gift after 8 or 9 participations. The circuit encourages participation and promises a friendly and sporty atmosphere.
course_highlights: Nine varied runs in the Green Heart
Distances of 5 km, 10 km, 10 miles, and half marathon
Course along the picturesque river Kromme Mijdrecht and through Wickelhofpark
additional: Circuit participants can switch unlimited times between short and middle distances via the information desk. Switching to the long distance is not possible without a separate registration. There is a 10 km walk, Family Run, and G-Run for children up to 12 years old. Race numbers can be reissued at the information desk in case of loss. There are changing rooms, showers, and limited bag storage. In the sports hall, there is a pickup point for coffee, tea, and soft drinks. The award ceremony takes place in the sports hall. Nine varied runs between November 2026 and April 2027, including short, middle, long distances, and half marathon, with extra rewards for multiple participations.

name: LPR - Last Pirate Running
description: LPR - Last Pirate Running is a running event taking place in Volendam on Sunday, November 1, 2026. The race offers a short distance of 1.6 kilometers, ideal for a quick and challenging running experience. Registration closes on October 20, 2026, and participants can sign up via the provided registration website. The event is organized by ProRun and is suitable for runners looking for a unique and accessible race.
course_highlights: Short distance of 1.6 km
Organized in the picturesque Volendam
Fast and challenging course
additional: Registration for the 1.6 km distance closes on October 20, 2026. A training schedule for 10 miles (16.1 km) is available on the website, which can help with preparation. Registration for the race was closed as of October 2026; the event is intended for runners who want to enjoy a short and fun race in North Holland.

name: Kievit Sport Twentsche Cross Competitie
organizer: AV Goor, AV Iphitos, ASV Eibergen, AAV Sisu, AC Tion, LAAC Twente
description: The Kievit Sport Twente Cross Competition is a challenging cross-country series consisting of six races in the beautiful natural areas of Twente. The competition offers a unique opportunity to measure yourself against peers and enjoy the winter character of the region. The races vary in distance and are accessible for different age categories, from youth to masters. With strong local involvement and sponsors such as Kievit Sport and Wiggers Vleeswaren, this competition is a popular event for runners in Twente.
course_highlights: Natural cross-country courses in various Twente nature reserves
Distances ranging from 1 km for youth to 10 km for seniors and masters
Unique collaboration of six athletics clubs in the region
additional: Race bibs can be collected at locations such as Zwembad de Vijf Heuvels (Markelo). There are changing rooms and toilets available. The age category reference date is the age during the last race for youth and at the first race for masters. The competition is made possible by local sponsors and six athletics clubs. There is also a Canicross distance of 2.5/5 km during the Hulsbeekcross. The series includes races such as Hessenheemcross, Wintercross, Oudejaarscross, Rutbeekcross, Hulsbeekcross, and Dinkelcross, with results and standings available on the official website.

name: Maple Leaf Wintercup
organizer: GAC Hilversum en de Baarnse Atletiek Vereniging
