description: The Maple Leaf Wintercup 2026, held on Sunday, November 1st at Bosbad De Vuursche in Baarn, is a cozy running and walking event set in a beautiful autumn setting. The race is organized by the Gooise Atletiek Club Hilversum and the Baarnse Atletiek Vereniging and offers challenging unpaved courses surrounded by fall colors. There are various distances for both active walkers and runners, including youth distances and competitive runs with and without a race license. The start and finish are located on the scenic grounds around Bosbad De Vuursche, creating a friendly and sporty atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Challenging unpaved course in autumn colors
Long Cross of 9.5 km with 4 laps
Short Cross of 3.1 km with 2 laps
additional: Race bibs can be collected from October 25th to 31st at Run2Day Hilversum or on race day at the race secretariat. There is no separate gender categorization for the Short and Long Cross. Pupils from the organizing athletics clubs can participate for free after registering via the contact form. There is a performance run and a race license run for both the short and long cross. The courses consist of multiple laps depending on the distance. The routes include unpaved paths, with activities such as Nordic walking, cross-country running, and youth races; start and finish at Bosbad De Vuursche.

name: Spaarnwoudecross
description: The Mokums Cross Circuit is a series of four forest cross races in the vicinity of Amsterdam, including the Spaarnwoude cross organized by Haarlem Atletiek in Spaarndam. Participants register for at least three of these races and have a chance to win a nice final souvenir. For the main events, there is a classification where the best three results out of the four races count. The circuit is made possible through a collaboration of five Amsterdam athletics clubs and their sponsor.
course_highlights: Wooded cross races in the vicinity of Amsterdam
Four different locations: Spaarndam, Amsterdamse Bos, De Eenhoorn, Gaasperplas
Final souvenir for participants in at least three races
additional: Participants in at least three races receive a souvenir. The twenty fastest men and women of the main events earn points for the final classification. The award ceremony takes place at the first race of the season. Cross run with mud course, family and youth event, held on November 2, 2025, in Haarlem at Wheelerplanet in Spaarndam, with participants such as Tessa Weening and Sophie Kwak.

name: Hermans Assurantiën Duatlon
description: The Hermans Assurantiën Duathlon, organized by AVR'69, is a well-known off-road run-ATB-run race taking place in the beautiful forests of Reusel. This 25th edition on Sunday, November 1, 2026, offers competitive distances (14 km run, 60 km mountain biking, 7 km run) for athletes aged 18 and over, as well as recreational distances (7 km run, 30 km mountain biking, 3.5 km run) for participants aged 16 and over. The start and finish are at sport park D'n Hoek, which also has ample changing and shower facilities. Participants can register individually or as a team, and a warm meal is provided after the race.
course_highlights: Run-ATB-Run race in the forests of Reusel
Off-road course with mountain biking mandatory
Start and finish at sport park D'n Hoek with good facilities
additional: All segments start together at 10:00 AM. Participants must use a mountain bike. There is a warm meal after the race for the competitors. Parking is available at the parking lot of sport park D'n Hoek, but entry to the sports park by car is not allowed. There are spacious shower and changing facilities in the AVR'69 clubhouse. Cash prizes and medals are awarded for both competitive and recreational categories. Registration can be done individually or as a team (duo runner/cyclist). The race takes place on November 1, 2026, with registration open from April 10, 2026, to October 31, 2026. The race starts at 10:00 AM and requires a mountain bike. Participants must be at least 18 years old for the main race and 16 for the recreational variant.

name: Van de Meerendonk Heidetrail
location: Gilde Sint Sebastiaan, Oirschot, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Van de Meerendonk Heidetrail is a beautiful recreational run across the expansive Oirschotse heath, suitable for runners and walkers. The routes are clearly marked with arrows, making it impossible to get lost. There are water and fruit stations at all distances, and afterwards, there is a friendly gathering with free coffee or tea and some treats. The start takes place at Gilde Sint Sebastiaan in Oirschot, and participation is possible for various distances, both running and walking.
course_highlights: Expansive forest and heath area
Clearly marked routes with arrows
Water and fruit stations at all distances
additional: Start location: Gilde Sint Sebastiaan, Wintelresedijk 1, 5688GW Oirschot. Runners start between 8:30 and 9:30 AM, walkers between 9:00 and 9:30 AM. Limited toilet and changing facilities, no showers. Afterward, free coffee or tea with some treats until 1:00 PM. Members of Atletiek Oirschot pay €5.00 in advance for all distances. Registration and payment on the day itself is possible but not recommended. Routes are marked with arrows, water and fruit stations at all distances, start between 8:30 and 9:30 AM, no prizes, free coffee and tea afterwards, participation at your own risk, limited facilities without showers.

name: Leesten Cross
description: The Leesten Cross is a recreational cross-country run taking place in the beautiful forest area around Ugchelen. The race offers a challenging course over forest, sandy, and heath paths without muddy sections, with a stunning view over the heath as a reward. It is an ideal opportunity to test your fitness and race level in a cozy and accessible environment. The start and finish are at the Bospaviljoen ’t Leesten, a top location for runners in the Netherlands.
course_highlights: Course over forest, sandy, and heath paths
Stunning view over the heath
Start and finish at Bospaviljoen ’t Leesten in Ugchelen
additional: After submitting your start number, you will receive a drink voucher. There is no changing facility available. First aid is present. The 10 km counts towards the club championship cross of AV Veluwe. Trail over sandy paths in Kroondomein, elevation change approximately 60 meters, registration closed, start/finish location Wildrooster Wenum-Wiesel, no showers/changing rooms, first aid present.

name: Twentse Smokkel Trail
description: The Twente Smuggling Trail is a unique trail run in the border area of Losser, taking place on November 1, 2026. The routes are 90% on unpaved paths and varied terrain with many singletracks, taking participants to places where normally no running is allowed. The trail features multiple distances, from challenging 27 km and 22 km runs to a 10 km drop-off trail where participants are transported to the start by horse and carriage. In addition to the trail runs, there is also a walking trail and a kid's trail for children. Participants symbolically smuggle a package of butter across the border and receive a Twente currant bread as a reward after finishing.
course_highlights: 90% on unpaved paths with many singletracks
Route passes through pristine forests, nature ponds, and along the Dinkel
Unique border crossing with symbolic butter smuggling and musical support along the way
additional: There are refreshment stations approximately 11 km and 4 km before the finish, plus a water station 2 km before the finish. The start and finish location is at the Multifunctional Accommodation Nilantspad 3 in Losser, where changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available. The 10 km Drop Off Trail starts from the German monastery Bardel, with participants transported to the start by horse and carriage. Timing is available for the 27, 22, and 14 km trails, but not for the 10 km drop-off. Dogs are not allowed. After finishing, participants receive a wooden medal and a Twente currant bread. The top three men and women per distance are awarded a handcrafted smuggling trophy. Trail and walking routes over unpaved paths, including children's and drop-off trails, with themes of smuggling history and nature experience. Registration opens on July 1, 2026, via inschrijven.nl, with limited participants per distance and refreshment stations at 11 and 23 km.

name: De 4 daagse van Girona
description: The 4-day Girona walk is an intimate hiking event in Spain, organized for a maximum of 300 participants. From November 4 to 7, 2026, you will walk through the beautiful and varied landscapes of the Girona province, with routes starting and ending in the historic center of Girona. About 70% of the paths are unpaved, featuring fragrant forests, rolling hills, and some climbs that require good fitness. The event is offered as a complete package including overnight stays and breakfast at Hotel Ibis Girona, with a festive closing after the final walking day.
course_highlights: Approximately 70% unpaved paths through forests and along rivers
Start and finish in the medieval center of Girona
Varied routes with flat sections and short climbs
additional: Participants stay at Hotel Ibis Girona, which also serves as the start and finish location. Transportation is arranged to and from Barcelona airport following recommended flights. There is a celebratory closing after the last walking day. The routes vary daily between approximately 18 km and 26 km, with an option between a shorter and a longer route with an extra loop. 5 hotel overnight stays, walking route, medal, briefing, breakfast, lunch, transportation, insurance, optional dinner, extra nights possible.

name: NightRun Rijssen
description: The NightRun Rijssen takes place on Thursday, November 5, 2026, and offers a unique evening experience where participants run through the center of Rijssen, past beautiful buildings and businesses. The run is not a competition but focuses on fun and experience, with a magical atmosphere created by lighting and the evening setting. There are different distances: a kids' run of 1 km, a 5 km walk or run route, and a 10 km for the enthusiasts. The start and finish are in the center of Rijssen, with a rolling start to promote flow.
course_highlights: Run through the center of Rijssen during shopping evening
Route passes through buildings and businesses
Magical and festive atmosphere with lighting and evening decor
additional: Start and finish in the center of Rijssen at 'T Schild (next to Pearle). Rolling start in small groups for good flow. Finish at Lucky on Morsweg 8. No time registration, no competitive character. There is a warm-up opportunity at NightRun Borne on October 9. Event takes place during shopping evening in Rijssen center; no race, focused on fun and experience; participants are illuminated by the streets and enjoy a festive atmosphere.

name: Devil's Trail Schiermonnikoog
description: The Devil’s Trail Schiermonnikoog is a unique running experience taking place on November 6 and 7, 2026. Participants can enjoy e

name: Batavia Night Run
description: The Batavia Night Run is a festive running event taking place on Friday evening, November 6, 2026, in the illuminated Batavia Quarter in Lelystad. Participants can choose from various distances, including 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and kids runs of 800 and 1500 meters. The course runs through the historic and beautifully lit area around Museum Batavialand, providing a unique nighttime running experience. The organization also supports the charity Stichting ALS Nederland.
course_highlights: Course through the beautifully lit Batavia Quarter
Distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km
Kids runs of 800 and 1500 meters
additional: Participation in the festive night run is included with registration. There is an option to purchase a Batavia Night Run shirt and cancellation insurance separately. The organization collaborates with photographers and videographers for promotional images. Participants must adhere to current traffic rules and RIVM guidelines. Night run registration is possible; charity involvement; event combines sport and entertainment in a festive setting.

name: Devil's Trail - Schiermonnikoog
description: Devil's Trail Schiermonnikoog is a unique running event taking place on the beautiful Wadden Island of Schiermonnikoog. The trail offers participants the choice of a 10 km NightTrail, a 15 km, and a 30 km trail through the National Park, allowing you to experience the island both in daylight and in the dark. The event occurs in one of the darkest and wildest natural areas of the Netherlands, part of the Wadden Sea World Heritage. It is a challenging and atmospheric trail run that offers a special way to experience nature and the island.
course_highlights: NightTrail of 10 km starting from Berkenplas
15 km and 30 km trails through Schiermonnikoog National Park
Running in the dark at one of the darkest places in the Netherlands
additional: Starting number resale is possible via the platform inschrijven.nl with a maximum asking price of 20% above the purchase price. The trails take place on Friday evening (NightTrail) and Saturday (day trails). The organization is Stichting Sportbeleving in collaboration with Sporteiland. The event involves trail running on challenging terrain and is characterized by an adventurous atmosphere. It is suitable for experienced trail runners who want to enjoy the natural environment of Schiermonnikoog.

name: 28e Nacht van OLAT / Kennedy Trail
description: The 28th Night of OLAT/Kennedy-Trail takes place from Friday evening, November 6th to Saturday, November 7th, 2026 in Oirschot, Netherlands. Participants can choose from three distances: 110 km, 80 km, and 55 km, with start times in the evening and night. The route consists of a mix of paved and unpaved paths, with extensive refreshment stations and a pasta meal for the 110 km and 80 km runners after the nocturnal stage. All participants must be finished by 7:00 PM on Saturday and will receive a certificate, with the option to purchase a medal at an additional cost.
course_highlights: Route partly paved and partly unpaved, with longer unpaved daytime sections
Extensive refreshment stations with food and drinks
Pasta meal for 110 km and 80 km participants after the night stage
additional: Start times: 110 km at 20:00, 80 km and 55 km at 23:00. Registration approximately one hour before start. Dogs not allowed. All participants must finish before 7:00 PM on Saturday. Medal optional at an additional cost. Night trail race with multiple distances, support, registration about an hour before start, finish before 7:00 PM on November 7, 2026, medal available for purchase.

name: LoveLife Run Terneuzen
location: ZorgSaam Ziekenhuis De Honte, Terneuzen, Zeeland, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voor een kleine bijdrage ontvang je een LoveLife Run sportshirt en een medaille.

description: On November 7, 2026, the very first LoveLife Run will take place in Terneuzen, a special running event where (former) cancer patients run 5 kilometers together with their loved ones and caregivers. This event aims to turn helplessness into strength and to raise funds for groundbreaking cancer research. Everyone is welcome to participate or support participants with a donation. The proceeds go to cancer research and local care initiatives, organized by Zeeland Business and volunteers.
course_highlights: 5 kilometer running route
Running together with (former) cancer patients, loved ones, and caregivers
Location at ZorgSaam Hospital De Honte in Terneuzen
additional: Participants receive a sports shirt and medal. Food, drinks, and entertainment will be available. (Former) cancer patients can participate for free and will be supported with running training sessions prior to the event. Registration for training can be done until September 1, with registration without training until one week before the event. It is recommended to arrive sustainably by bike or public transport. The event starts at ZorgSaam Hospital De Honte and is supported by Atletiekvereniging Scheldesport. Participants can collect donations and show support for people affected by cancer.

name: De Najaarsloop van Cialfo
description: The Autumn Run of AV Cialfo is a running event taking place in Epe, organized by AV Cialfo. The run is held on Wachtelenbergweg and offers participants a great opportunity to be active in the fall in a sporty and friendly atmosphere. Pre-registration is possible until the end of October, with late registration available up to 30 minutes before the start. The event attracts runners from the region and is part of the local sports offerings.
course_highlights: Location on Wachtelenbergweg in Epe
Autumn season running event
Late registration available up to 30 minutes before start
additional: Pre-registration is possible until October 27 via inschrijven.nl. Late registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the start of the run. Run at the location Wachtelenbergweg, Epe; date has passed; registration via online platform

name: Dorpsrun Renswoude

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: € 60,- per team voor de halve marathon

description: The Dorps Run Renswoude takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, and offers a suitable distance for every runner, from beginners to experienced athletes and young sports enthusiasts. Participants can run individually or register as a team for the corporate competition. The event is known for its friendly and sporty atmosphere in the village of Renswoude, with routes passing through the surrounding area. Previous editions sold out quickly, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: Half marathon of 21 km, consisting of two laps of the 10.5 km route
10.5 km route through the village and surroundings
Kidsrun of 1 km for young runners
additional: Start numbers can be collected on the day itself from 11:30 AM until half an hour before the start. A chip on the back of the start number is used for time registration. After the event, all participants receive a medal. There are showers and changing rooms available at sports hall De Hokhorst. Photos of the event will be posted on the website a few days after the event, without names and respecting privacy. Parking is available near De Hokhorst, within a short walking distance. The nearest train station is Veenendaal/De Klomp, with bus connections to Renswoude. Pre-registration online is possible until November 5, 2026; Kidsrun is also possible on the day itself; start times: half marathon at 1:45 PM, 10 km at 2:00 PM, Kidsrun at 12:30 PM.

name: Duifpoldertrainingsloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De inschrijfkosten zijn laag: 2 euro voor alle afstanden.

description: The Duifpolder Training Run is a small-scale running race through the beautiful Duifpolder between Schipluiden and Maasland. This race, organized in the spring and autumn by De Hardloper Schipluiden, offers three distances: 3.5 km, 7 km, and 11.7 km. The start is at 14:00 at the Tram Bridge in Schipluiden, close to the registration and changing area. The run is accessible and ideal as training, with a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to chat afterwards in the clubhouse of IJsclub Vlietland.
course_highlights: Small-scale run through the Duifpolder between Schipluiden and Maasland
Choice of three distances: 3.5 km, 7 km, and 11.7 km
Start location at the Tram Bridge, near registration and clubhouse
additional: Registration is at the clubhouse of IJsclub Vlietland, Zouteveenseweg 2a, Schipluiden. Registration opens at 12:45 PM. There is a changing area and toilet facilities, but no shower. After the race, there is an opportunity to enjoy a drink in the clubhouse. Start location at Tram Bridge, Schipluiden; no shower facilities; drinks available after the race.

name: Plantsoenloop
description: The Plantsoenloop Groningen is the oldest and most beautiful running race in Groningen, suitable for young and old with four different distances. The atmospheric event takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, and leads participants over a beautiful hilly course through the Noorderplantsoen. This 68th edition is a true running classic that should not be missing from your calendar.
course_highlights: Beautiful hilly course
Running through Noorderplantsoen
Four different distances for all ages
additional: Four different distances, course through Noorderplantsoen, organized by Sportcentrum Kardinge

name: Salbam Lemelerbergloop
description: The Salbam Lemelerberg Run is a challenging cross-country race held on the Lemelerberg near Ommen. The race is part of the Vechtdal Cross Competition and offers various distances: a youth run of 2 km, and for adults approximately 6 km and approximately 12 km. The course is completely off-road and hilly with significant elevation changes in the natural area of Lemelerberg, the largest nature reserve in Landschap Overijssel. The race is ideal for runners who enjoy a challenging trail run in a beautiful environment.
course_highlights: Completely off-road course
Hilly with significant elevation changes
Lemelerberg nature reserve near Ommen
additional: Start times: Youth run 2 km at 12:30, 6 km at 13:00, 12 km at 14:00. The race is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competition with a total of five races. To qualify for the overall victory, participants must participate in and finish four of the five races. Various distances, start times for youth and adults, part of regional cross-country competition.

name: Schipholloop
location: Amsterdam Airport Schiphol, Haarlemmermeer, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Schiphol Run returns on November 7, 2026, as a unique running event around Amsterdam Airport Schiphol. With a rich history of over 50 years, this 60-kilometer ultramarathon offers a pure, partly self-sufficient trail experience where immersion and challenge are central. Participants can choose from various distances, including a half marathon and the ultramarathon, and enjoy a beautiful course through the diverse polder landscape with breathtaking views. With a limited number of participants of up to 100 people, it is an exclusive and unforgettable race for long-distance runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Iconic 60 km ultramarathon around the Haarlemmermeer polder
Beautiful, diverse environment with unexpected and breathtaking views
Trail-style run with GPS navigation and full autonomy
additional: Maximum of 100 participants per edition. Not a traditional race with ribbons and traffic controllers. The run is partly self-sufficient and trail-style with GPS navigation and fixed checkpoints. There was a special trial edition on May 23 prior to the November edition. Limited to 100 participants, with facilities such as drop bags, aid stations with drinks and snacks, and medals for finishers. The event emphasizes experience and natural surroundings, and is organized by a private initiative and AV Haarlemmermeer.

name: Waalbosrun
location: Bezoekerscentrum De IJsvogel, Rijsoord, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Waalbos Run is a sporty and enjoyable running event organized by the IJscube Rijsoord in collaboration with visitor center De IJsvogel. Participants run a beautiful route through the Waalbos in Rijsoord, along green paths, water, and wooded areas. The event is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners and offers different distances for young and old. Start and finish are at the visitor center, where supporters are welcome to cheer on the runners. Besides sportiness, conviviality and camaraderie are also central, and part of the proceeds go to a good cause.
course_highlights: Beautiful route through the Waalbos with green paths
Running along water and wooded areas
Start and finish at Visitor Center De IJsvogel
additional: There are three distances: Kidsrun (approx. 1.8 km) starting at 12:00 PM, 10 km starting at 1:00 PM, and 5 km starting at 1:10 PM. Start and finish are at Visitor Center De IJsvogel. The event is suitable for young and old, and part of the proceeds go to a good cause. Participants contribute to a good cause; the event is held in autumn, with expected cool and changeable weather conditions.

name: Watersley Halloween Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 KM WALK € 15 Walk the trail in a small group. Pick a time slot between 18:20 and 20:00.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 KM RUN € 15 Run the short loop through the forest. Joint start at 18:00. Your time gets recorded.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 KM RUN € 18 The full route. The darkest parts of the park and forest. Joint start at 18:00.

description: The Watersley Halloween Trail takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, in Sittard. Participants can choose from a 5 km walk, a 5 km run, or a challenging 10 km run through the dark Watersley park and forest. The evening begins with an exciting experience in the Haunted House at Watersley Plaza and ends at The Monastery with a free drink. The routes are atmospherically lit and feature hidden actors, providing a unique and spooky trail experience.
course_highlights: Start in the Haunted House with an exciting walkthrough experience
Routes through the park and forest with 14 illuminated points and hidden actors
Finish at The Monastery with a free drink (hot chocolate or lemonade)
additional: Start location is Watersley Plaza, Watersley 31, Sittard. The 5 km walk is in small groups with free time between 18:20 and 20:00. The 5 km and 10 km runs start together at 18:00 and are timed with RaceGorilla. Minimum age is 8 years for the 5 km, 16 years for the 10 km. Children under 12 only run with an adult. Parking is free. The trail includes forest paths and illuminated points, a Haunted House experience, free parking, and a free drink at the finish. Registration is possible for both timed and untimed routes, with age restrictions for each distance.

name: Zuidduinloop
location: Katwijk aan Zee, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Zuidduinloop is part of the Duinloopcircuit, a unique running series along the most beautiful coastal areas of the Netherlands. The race offers a varied course with challenging dune paths and fast beach sections, suitable for both enthusiastic runners and recreational participants. The atmosphere is always fantastic, and the event invites everyone to enjoy running outdoors. The Zuidduinloop takes place in Katwijk aan Zee and is part of a series of running events spread throughout the year.
course_highlights: Varied course with dune paths and beach sections
Unique coastal setting in Katwijk aan Zee
Suitable for various ages and levels
additional: There are classifications for all distances, separated for girls/women and boys/men, based on the best four results of the circuit. Race in Katwijk aan Zee, with various distances including short kids runs and longer runs, including GPX routes and results.

name: Knallende Kilometer
location: Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas, Bergschenhoek, South Holland, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kosten € 7,50 om deel te nemen inclusief een pannenkoek OF kop snert van Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas.

description: The Knallende Kilometer is a unique running event organized by Atletiek- en Wandelvereniging De Kieviten, taking place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas in Bergschenhoek. It is a time trial start where each runner starts individually with an interval of 30 seconds, allowing you to run a fast kilometer on a straight and flat course. After the race, you will not receive a medal, but a delicious pancake or a warm bowl of pea soup as a reward. The event is accessible to both competitive runners and recreational participants who want to enjoy a friendly run.
course_highlights: Straight and flat course of 1000 meters on the bike path atop the Rottemerentunnel
Start location near parking lot 'Zwijnenplaats' and finish near parking lot 'Mollenplaats'
Individual time trial start with start at 11:00 AM and a new runner every 30 seconds
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas. Parking is best at Mollenplaats. After finishing, you will receive a pancake or a bowl of pea soup at the restaurant. Participants will receive their start time via email one week before the event. Late registration is not possible and participation is limited. Flat course of 1000 meters on the bike path atop the Rottemerentunnel, start location at Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas, parking at Mollenplaats, pre-registration required.

name: Athlos Hydro Trail Run
description: The Athlos Hydro Trailrun takes place on Saturday, November 7 in Harderwijk, Veluwe. This trail run offers a challenging route through the beautiful nature of Veluwe, allowing participants to enjoy autumn landscapes and water crossings. The event is organized by Atletiekvereniging Athlos, known for its involvement in the local running community. The Hydro Trailrun is a sporty and recreational event suitable for trail runners who enjoy a varied course.
course_highlights: Trail run through the nature of Veluwe
Beautiful autumn landscapes
Water crossings and challenging terrain
additional: Photos of the 2025 edition are available via various albums. The start and finish of the routes are in the center of Harderwijk. The organization uses mobile photographers to capture water fun and other moments. Trail run over diverse terrains including forest, heath, and sand; registration is open; collaboration with sponsors; practical information and results available.

name: Slangenburg trailrun
description: The Slangenburg Trailrun takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at De Pokkershutte in IJzevoorde. This trail run takes you over winding forest paths and unpaved routes, surrounded by the beautiful autumn colors of the Slangenburg forest. Four distances are available, including a special Kidsrun for young trail runners from 6 years old, and an official half marathon of 21.1 kilometers. The atmosphere is relaxed and focused on enjoying nature and outdoor sports, without an award ceremony.
course_highlights: Winding forest paths and unpaved routes
Autumn colors in the Slangenburg forest
Official half marathon route of over 21 kilometers
additional: There are refreshment stations along the way with drinks and snacks. First aid is available during the trail run. Parents are allowed to accompany their children during the Kidsrun provided they are registered and have a start number. After the race, each participant receives a free bowl of pea soup with rye bread and bacon. Free parking is available at the location. There is no award ceremony; the focus is on fun and enjoying nature. At De Pokkershutte, drinks and snacks are available for purchase after the race. Trail through forests, online registration, start and finish at De Pokkershutte, free parking, parents may accompany children, no award ceremony.

name: JM ATB toertocht
location: Restaurant de Babbelaar, Oostkapelle, Zeeland, Netherlands
description: The JM ATB Tour is an annual mountain biking event held on the first Saturday of November in Oostkapelle. The 30 km and 50 km routes are beautifully marked and lead through forests, country roads, dikes, and surprising paths on Walcheren, without crossing the beach. The start is between 08:30 and 10:00 AM at restaurant De Babbelaar, where there is also an opportunity to chat afterwards over food and drinks. The event attracts over 300 to 400 participants annually and is known for its good organization and care along the route.
course_highlights: Routes of 30 and 50 km through forests, country roads, and dikes
Beautiful and varied paths on Walcheren
Refreshment stations along the route and bike rinsing after the event
additional: Start can be between 08:30 and 10:00 AM from restaurant De Babbelaar, Dorpsstraat 18, Oostkapelle. There is a refreshment station along the route and first aid available. After the event, bikes can be rinsed by the fire brigade at the fire station. Helmet is mandatory, participation is at your own risk. No shower facilities and no breakdown service; bring your own repair kit. Parking is available near the start location. Routes through forests, country roads, and dikes; start and finish at restaurant De Babbelaar; pre-registration via inschrijven.nl; participation at your own risk, helmet required; no showers; first aid available; no breakdown service; car parking at Domburgseweg/Ambachtsstraat and Dorpsstraat.

name: Feesteloop
price_range: Kinderloop: 6-7 euro, 5 km en 10 km: 12-14 euro, teamrun: 18-21 euro
description: The Festival Run in Avelgem is a fun and sporty race taking place on Saturday, November 7, 2026. The event offers various distances, including a 10 km and several kids' runs, suitable for both recreational runners and teams. The start and finish are centrally located, with changing rooms and showers available at the Ter Muncken sports complex. The team run consists of a combination of 5 km and 2.5 km distances with relays in a closed zone, making the event also suitable for teams and clubs.
course_highlights: 10 km run through Avelgem
Kids' runs of 500, 750, and 1000 meters
Team run with relays in a closed relay zone
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the Ter Muncken sports complex. The team run starts with a runner covering 5 km, followed by two runners each running 2.5 km, with relays in a closed relay zone. The kids' runs start from 14:00 with different distances for boys and girls born in 2019 and later. Participants can choose between 2 or 4 laps of 2.5 km, with a festive atmosphere and podium ceremonies. Registration is possible online until November 6.

description: Last Runner Standing is a unique race where participants must keep running in a loop of about 1 mile until only one runner remains.

name: “LAST RUNNERS STANDING” - Iedere 30 minuten een nieuwe uitdaging!
Olympisch Stadionloop 2026
location: Olympisch Stadion, Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands
price_range: € 16,50 (voor bedrijfs- en scholierenloop, inclusief €2,50 naar UNICEF)
description: The Olympic Stadium Run 2026 takes place on November 8th at the iconic Olympic Stadium in Amsterdam. This running event, organized by Atletiekvereniging Phanos in collaboration with Run2Day, includes distances of 800 meters for children, and 5 and 10 kilometers for individuals, school groups, and corporate teams. The routes pass through the Olympic Stadium and the Amsterdam Forest, and the race is part of the Rondje Mokum 2026. The Olympic Stadium Run combines sportiness with a good cause, as participants run for UNICEF.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the historic Olympic Stadium Amsterdam
Routes of 5 and 10 km through the Amsterdam Forest
800 meter children's run inside the Olympic Stadium

name: LoveLife Run Deventer
description: LoveLife Run Deventer is a special running event taking place on November 8, 2026, where (former) cancer patients together with their loved ones and caregivers come into action. Participants can choose to walk or run 1 or 5 kilometers, with the goal of reaching the finish line at their own pace, without timing. Special training sessions are offered by experienced running coaches from AV Daventria 1906 to prepare participants well. The proceeds of the event go to groundbreaking cancer research and local initiatives at Deventer Hospital, the Oncology Knowledge Center, and IPSO Center Salland. Everyone is welcome to participate, even if you have not had cancer yourself.
course_highlights: Routes of 1 and 5 kilometers around Deventer Hospital and the Brinkgreven terrain
Wheelchair-friendly routes for both 1 km and 5 km
Start and finish at the Radiotherapy Group next to Deventer Hospital
additional: Participants receive a mandatory LLR shirt that will be handed out on the day. There is no timing; the goal is to reach the finish line. There are 12 weeks of guided training for (former) cancer patients led by AV Daventria 1906, starting on August 19, 2026. The event is organized by a local team of volunteers and supported by running coaches. It is advised to arrive sustainably by bike or public transport. Participation is at your own risk. Participants are encouraged to use sustainable transportation and wear an organization-provided LLR shirt. The event is free for participants and focuses on fundraising for cancer research and local initiatives.

name: AV Salland Crossloop Raalte
location: Landgoed ’t Reelaer en Raalterwoold, Raalte, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The AV Salland Crossloop in Raalte is a challenging cross-country race that has been organized since 2009 around Theater 't Hoftheater. The route takes you through the wooded estate 't Reelaer and the rolling terrain of Raalterwoold, with approximately 90% unpaved paths. The course includes forest sections, avenues, fields with elevation changes, and sometimes muddy patches, providing a varied and tough running experience. There are short youth races and more demanding 5 and 10 kilometer distances, and the race is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit.
course_highlights: Approximately 90% unpaved paths
Routes through estate 't Reelaer and Raalterwoold
Forest sections, avenues, fields with elevation changes, and muddy patches
additional: The race is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit. Construction activities around the Hoftheater are visible, offering an extra view of the surroundings. Results and course records are maintained, and previous results are available via the race administration. The race offers various distances, including 5 and 10 km, and short youth runs. The course is characterized by natural, often muddy paths and a diverse landscape.

name: AVW Dijkgatboscross
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1500 meter, 1 km
description: The AVW Dijkgatboscross is a cross-country race organized by Atletiekvereniging Wieringermeer in Wieringerwerf. The race offers a challenging course through the Dijkgatbos, suitable for various levels and ages. The organization is known for its friendly and sporty atmosphere, welcoming both youth and adults to participate. AV Wieringermeer encourages group sports at all levels and provides expert guidance.
course_highlights: Course through the Dijkgatbos with natural terrain
Suitable for both youth and adults
Organization with a friendly and sporty atmosphere
additional: Participants can register on the day of the race; the terrain offers a natural and challenging environment for runners; the race is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Landgoedloop
location: Landgoed Visdonk, Roosendaal, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Landgoedloop is an annual event in Roosendaal, organized by Atletiek- en Recreatiesport Vereniging THOR. It takes place on the second Sunday of November at Landgoed Visdonk and consists of three components: a fairy tale walk, a trail run, and walking tours. The trail run offers challenging routes of 6 and 10 km mainly over unpaved paths, while the walking tours cover distances of 6, 10, and 20 km. The fairy tale walk is a 3 km forest walk with fairy tale characters and nature puzzles, specially designed for families and children. The proceeds of the event go entirely to Natuurmonumenten West Brabant.
course_highlights: Trail run of 6 and 10 km over unpaved paths at Landgoed Visdonk
Walking tours of 6, 10, and 20 km through forested areas
Fairy tale walk of 3 km with fairy tale characters and nature puzzles
additional: Trail run starts at 9:00 AM, distances of 6 and 10 km. Fairy tale walk starts between 11:00 AM and 1:30 PM. Walking tours start between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. Dogs are allowed during the fairy tale walk under strict conditions (on a leash, cleanup required). Same-day registration is possible with an additional €1, only if space is available. The 6 and 10 km trail runs, fairy tale walk, and start times between 8:00 AM and 1:30 PM, proceeds go to Natuurmonumenten.

name: Schoonhovencross
description: The Schoonhovencross takes place on Sunday, November 8, 2026, in Hollandscheveld, organized by Stichting De Snelle Rakkers. The cross country race is held around the recreational lake and the course is completely unpaved, ideal for spikes. There are various distances for youth, G-group, and adults, with prizes for different categories. After the race, participants can enjoy a bowl of pea soup or smoked sausage when submitting their bib number.
course_highlights: Completely unpaved course around the recreational lake
Suitable for running on spikes
Start and changing facilities at the hall and party center Schoonhoven
additional: Parking and changing facilities at the hall and party center Schoonhoven. After submitting the bib number, choose between a bowl of pea soup or smoked sausage. There are prizes for various age categories and for women/men in different age groups. Registration until November 7, prices for different categories, start and finish at Paviljoen Schoonhoven, course suitable for spikes.

price_range: €9,- voorinschrijving, €10,- op de dag, kinderen gratis

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Zeijer Strubbenloop takes place on November 8, 2026, for the 15th time in Zeijen. The race offers a beautiful 5-kilometer route through the surroundings of Zeijen, with the 10-kilometer race consisting of two laps of this route. The start is at the village square near café Hingstman. The 10-kilometer race is part of the Univé Loopcircuit De Kop van Drenthe, and prizes are awarded to the fastest women and men in both the 5 km and 10 km categories. The day begins with kids runs for various age groups and ends with award ceremonies inside café Hingstman.
course_highlights: 5 kilometer route through the beautiful surroundings of Zeijen
10 kilometer consists of two laps of the 5 km route
Start and finish at the village square near café Hingstman
additional: On-the-day registration is possible between 11:00 and 13:30 at Café Hingstman, cash only. Race numbers are ready at the race secretariat and will not be sent in advance. The kids run starts from 12:30 in different age groups, the 5 km and 10 km races start at 14:00. The award ceremony takes place inside café Hingstman. Registration is possible via inschrijven.nl until November 8, with start and finish at Café Hingstman.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
price_range: €4-€20 per race of voor het hele seizoen
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a popular regional running event held annually in Zeewolde, organized by TVZ Zeewolde. The race offers various distances, including 1, 2, 5, and 10 kilometers, with the longer distances consisting of multiple laps. The event attracts both recreational and enthusiastic runners and is known for its friendly atmosphere and beautiful routes around the RCN camping area. The Flevo Fun Run is a perfect opportunity for athletes of all levels to enjoy running together in a natural environment.
course_highlights: Routes of 1, 2, 5, and 10 km with multiple laps for longer distances
Start and finish at RCN camping Zeewolde
Varied course suitable for recreational and competitive runners
additional: The 10 km distance consists of 2 laps of 5 km. The 2 km distance consists of 2 laps of 1 km. There is a club competition associated with the Flevo Fun Run. Photos and results from previous editions are available via the organization's Facebook page and photo page. Participants receive a medal, registration is required, and there are various age categories. The event promotes enjoyment of running and community connections.

name: Klaazienaveen SportBOXX Oosterbosrun
location: near Trambrug over de Koning Willem Alexander Kanaal, Klazienaveen, Drenthe, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld bedraagt €10,00 ,- voor beide afstanden.

description: The SportBOXX Oosterbosrun, organized by Loopgroep Klazienaveen, is an annual running race held in the autumnal Oosterbos near Klazienaveen. Participants can choose between two distances, 5 km and 10 km, which are clearly marked with arrows and ribbons. The start and finish are located near the tram bridge at Meester Ovingstraat. The race offers prizes for the best seniors and veterans and a reward for breaking the course record.
course_highlights: Running through the autumnal Oosterbos
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Route marked with arrows and ribbons
additional: Registration is only possible in advance until Saturday, November 8th at 18:00; same-day registration is not possible. Youth up to 15 years old can participate for free in the 5 km. There are no changing or shower facilities. Participants run at their own risk. There is a raffle with SportBOXX gift vouchers among the participants. No on-the-day registration, start and finish near Trambridge at Meester Ovingstraat 87, no changing or shower rooms, prizes for top seniors and veterans, course record bonus.

name: NSL Nederzandt cross
location: Nederzandt Langevelderslag, Noordwijk, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The NSL NederZandtCross is a challenging running race taking place on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at Nederzandt Langevelderslag. This first edition combines elements of a trail run and a performance run with a course through dunes, beach, and forest. The race offers three distances: 3.8 km, 10.2 km, and 16.6 km, with the course mostly consisting of unpaved paths and steep elevation changes. The organization is a collaboration between NSL and Vrijstaat Nederzandt and focuses on challenge and performance with time registration.
course_highlights: Course through dunes, beach, and forest
Mostly unpaved paths with steep elevation changes
Beach section reminiscent of a trail run
additional: Start times: 11:00 AM for middle and long distances, 11:10 AM for the short distance. Phone number for information and emergencies during the event: 0613-344747. The first edition of the NSL Nederzandt Cross takes place on November 8, 2026, at Nederzandt Langevelderslag, Noordwijk.

name: Docfacross
description: The Docfacross is part of the AV Oss '78 Cross Competition, a series of six small-scale and accessible running races in and around Oss. The races are held on beautiful unpaved courses suitable for both beginners and experienced runners of all ages. The competition offers a sporty and friendly atmosphere where participants can challenge themselves against others and enjoy running in nature. The Docfacross takes place on November 8, 2026, and invites everyone to participate in this challenging cross-country run.
course_highlights: Unpaved courses in and around Oss
Suitable for young and old, beginners and experienced runners
Part of a series of six small-scale cross races
additional: The cross competition consists of six races, with participation in at least four races offering a chance to qualify for the final standings. The races are accessible and provide a friendly and sporty atmosphere. No specific start time or prize information for the Docfacross is listed on the website. Cross competition with multiple small-scale races, registration possible via Inschrijven.nl, race on November 8, 2026.

name: 15e Scopias Klein Zwitserlandcross
description: The Scopias Klein Zwitserlandcross is an annual cross-country race held in the countryside of Tegelen, near Speelpark Klein Zwitserland. This event is part of the Limbra cross competition and offers challenging courses for various categories. New in 2025 is a pilot with a walking tour through the Jammerdal nature reserve, with routes of 6 and 12 km. The organization ensures a friendly atmosphere with prize ceremonies and additional activities for children.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the countryside of Tegelen near Speelpark Klein Zwitserland
Walking tour through Jammerdal nature reserve with routes of 6 and 12 km
Part of the Limbra cross competition
additional: The prize ceremonies for the long and short cross are split; the long cross prize ceremony takes place immediately after the start of the short cross. Participants can update their details and switch between the long and short cross during registration. Pre-registration is not required for the walking tour; registration can be done on-site. Children can exchange toys along the route at special exchange boxes. The race is open to all levels, with on-site registration possible. The event is part of the Limbra cross competition and is characterized by a friendly atmosphere and good facilities.

name: AVH Cross
description: The AV Haarlemmermeer Cross is a challenging cross-country race held often under harsh weather conditions such as frost, mud, rain, and snow. The event is accessible to everyone and offers various distances, including a 1 km loop for the youngest athletes, a 2.5 km sprint cross for older juniors, and competitive runs of 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km. This cross-country race is a real test of strength where technique, speed, and endurance come together, and it is part of the popular RunX Haarlem Cross Circuit.
course_highlights: Cross-country race with mud, grass, and turns
Loops of 1 km, 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Under harsh weather conditions such as frost, rain, and snow
additional: The race is part of the RunX Haarlem Cross Circuit. There are various distances for different age groups and levels. The event is organized by AV Haarlemmermeer, an athletics club that also offers training groups and trial lessons. No specific start times or pricing information is provided on the website. The race takes place in Haaksbergen and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. Multiple distances are offered, making the event attractive to a broad audience.

name: Thorbecke / KWF run
description: The Thorbecke KWF Run in Zwolle is an annual running event where students, teachers, parents, and local residents come together to raise money for cancer research. The event symbolizes collaboration, energy, and engagement within the school community. The run is a festive and meaningful activity that contributes to supporting KWF Kankerbestrijding.
course_highlights: Collaboration of students, teachers, parents, and local residents
Running festival at the Thorbecke Scholengemeenschap in Zwolle
Fundraising effort for cancer research
additional: The run is part of a broader initiative by KWF where schools and associations take action against cancer. There is a strong emphasis on creating a personal action page to collect donations and engaging the community. The run symbolizes the collective effort for cancer research and building involvement within the school. The event functions as a running festival and school campaign, with the goal of raising funds for cancer research. The proceeds are increased annually, with recent amounts exceeding 17,500 euros.

name: Amersfoort Night Run
description: The Amersfoort Night Run is a new running event taking place on Friday evening, November 13, 2026. During this unique night run, you will race through a beautifully illuminated city, past light installations, live music, and surprising entertainment. The route passes along the Eem river and through the city center of Amersfoort, with views of historic sights such as the medieval city wall, Monnikendam, Our Lady Tower, and the Koppelpoort. The event combines sport with experience and is officially timed, making it a real race. Afterward, there is a lively afterparty at Eemplein near the KAdE Café to celebrate your achievement.
course_highlights: Atmospherically lit course through the city center of Amersfoort
Along historic sights such as the medieval city wall, Monnikendam, Our Lady Tower, and Koppelpoort
Entertainment along the way with live music, bands, and light installations
additional: Start and finish are at Eemplein near the KAdE Café. There is time registration, so it is an official race. Afterward, there is an afterparty to celebrate together with other participants. Multiple distances including a kids' run, illuminated route through the city, live music, entertainment, and an afterparty. The proceeds support ALS.

The course runs through the Norschoten neighborhood and offers a fun and sporty evening with atmosphere-enhancing elements such as lights and fluorescent clothing. For companies, there is a special corporate run with a pasta buffet beforehand and an afterparty with a DJ and singer.

name: Hobbeldebobbelloop
description: The Hobbeldebobbelloop in Zoutelande is an annual running event, this time taking place on November 14, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: 6 km and 11 km. The event is organized by Dynamica and offers a great opportunity to run in the surroundings of Zoutelande. For more details about registration and facilities, refer to the organization.
course_highlights: Choice between 6 km or 11 km course
Run in the surroundings of Zoutelande, Zeeland
Organized by Dynamica
additional: Registration via external link; event takes place on November 14, 2026, between 14:30 and 17:00 hours.

description: Wine and Dine Buitenpepers is a cozy neighborhood dinner taking place on Saturday evening, November 14, in Buitenpepers, a lively neighborhood in 's-Hertogenbosch. The event brings residents together for an unforgettable evening full of conviviality, good food, and wine, spread throughout the entire neighborhood. It is a great opportunity to meet each other and strengthen the community in a warm and festive atmosphere.

Cozy and festive atmosphere
Strengthening the community

Activities calendar, neighborhood meetings, neighborhood meal, neighborhood dinner, community support

name: Hafkamp Groenewegen De Ronde Venen Marathon
Beachrun Zandvoort
description: The Beachrun Zandvoort is a atmospheric running race held on the beach and through the dunes of Zandvoort. With a beautiful combination of sun, sea, and beach, this run offers a unique experience for both recreational and avid runners. The route varies over hard and soft sand and through the diverse dune landscape, providing a challenging and varied run. The event is ideal for anyone who wants to enjoy nature and the fresh sea air while running.
course_highlights: Running over the 9-kilometer-long beach of Zandvoort
Varied terrain with both paved and unpaved paths in the dunes
Opportunity to run barefoot through the water or on the hard sand
additional: The run takes place in a varied landscape of beach and dunes with elevation changes and diverse terrains. There is an extensive network of paths allowing for different distances. The fresh sea air and the sound of the waves create a unique running experience. Parking is available at various paid parking lots and the event is easily accessible by train and bus. The event offers different routes, including the circuit, the dunes, and the beach, and is scheduled for November 22, 2026.

name: Chocolademelkloop
description: The Chocolate Milk Run is a fun family running event in the forests of Bilthoven, suitable for runners of all levels. On Sunday, November 15, 2026, participants can choose from distances of 1, 2, or 5 kilometers. The event is known for its warm atmosphere, delicious hot chocolate afterwards, and the presence of Pieten who participate in the run. It is a sporty and accessible event where young and old can enjoy moving in nature.
course_highlights: Running through the forest of Bilthoven
Mostly unpaved paths
Enjoyable family run with Pieten and hot chocolate
additional: Parents with a 2 or 5 km registration are allowed to run the 1 km family run with their child at no extra cost. The 1 km family run is aimed at children aged 3-8 years and mostly takes place on unpaved forest paths. There is a prize draw where prizes are awarded to all participants, regardless of their time. The start and finish area is at the Werkplaats in Bilthoven. Distances: 1 km, 2 km, 5 km; no time registration; parents can run for free with children; start and finish on the grounds of the Werkplaats.

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplas, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasrun is a running series consisting of three races in November, January, and February, organized by AAV'36 in Alphen aan den Rijn. The races take place around the Zegerplas and offer distances of 5, 10, 15, and 20 km, as well as youth distances of 400 and 1000 meters on the athletics track. The course is almost entirely car-free and runs through the Zegersloot area and around the Zegerplas, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at the AAV'36 athletics track, which also has changing rooms, showers, a canteen, and a massage room.
course_highlights: Almost entirely car-free course through the Zegersloot area and around the Zegerplas
Distances range from 400m for youth to 20 km for adults
Start and finish at the AAV'36 athletics track with facilities such as changing rooms and showers

There is no refreshment station along the Aarkanaal due to a ban on plastic cups, but water is available at the finish and at a refreshment station on the track for 15 and 20 km runners during their second lap. Free leg massages are available in the massage room, provided by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn. Changing rooms, showers, a canteen, and limited lockers are available. Registration is via the website. Free leg massage by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn. Winter conditions possible.

name: Sterke Start Loop
description: The Strong Start Run on November 15, 2026, in Zevenhuizen is a running event featuring distances of 5, 10, and 21 kilometers. The routes pass through beautiful nature, along water, and through wooded areas, mainly on paved surfaces, with ground paths also included in the 21 km. The event offers a unique and varied running experience and is dedicated to supporting premature babies. Additionally, there is a 1 km Kidsrun with obstacles, symbolizing the challenges faced by prematurely born children. The start and finish are at the Willem-Alexanderbaan, where participants and supporters gather for a strong start to the day.
course_highlights: Routes through nature, along water, and through forests
Mainly paved surfaces, with ground paths at 21 km
1 km Kidsrun with obstacles for children
additional: The start and finish are at the Willem-Alexanderbaan in Zevenhuizen. Parking is clearly signposted and there is no public transport accessibility due to the early start time. The Kidsrun begins at 11:00 AM. Participants can be cheered on at the finish line, with estimated arrival times per distance. Volunteers are being sought to support the event. The event supports research and care for premature babies, with a Kidsrun and the option to participate virtually. The proceeds go to charities and scientific research.

name: Loetcross
description: The Loetcross in Lekkerkerk is a challenging cross-country race taking place on November 15, 2026. The course runs over varied terrains such as grass, shell paths, and along ditches, providing a diverse and natural running experience. Multiple distances are available, ranging from 1.2 km to 7.2 km, suitable for various ages and levels. The race is known for its rugged character, ensuring shoes will definitely not stay clean. Pre-registration is possible until November 13, 2026.
course_highlights: Cross-country over grass, shell paths, and along ditches
Distances ranging from 1.2 km to 7.2 km
Natural and varied terrain with challenging sections
additional: Women can register for the long distance of 7.2 km, but participation is outside the women's competition and awards. Shoes will not stay clean during the race due to the terrain. Fields marked with * are mandatory during registration. The event includes various components for different ages and levels, and registration is required.

name: Bommelasloop
description: The Bommelasloop is a popular recreational nature run that has been organized for many years by Rekreatie Sport Twente. The run takes place in the beautiful Natura 2000 area Het Buurserzand, located between Enschede and Haaksbergen. There are four different distances, so every runner can find a suitable challenge. The start is at 11:00 AM and participants receive a free drink afterwards. The atmosphere is relaxed and focused on recreation, without awards or medals.
course_highlights: Nature run in the Natura 2000 area Het Buurserzand
Four distances: 7.6 km, 11.7 km, 16 km, and 20.5 km
Start and finish at Camping Twente in Enschede
additional: On-the-day registration and bib pickup are possible from 09:45 to 10:50, subject to availability. There is no award ceremony or medals, but participants can receive a drink by presenting their bib at the bar at the campsite. Due to limited parking, cycling is recommended. Nature run in Buurserzand, registration on the day possible, no awards or medals, free drink after the run, no dogs or wheelchairs allowed.

name: Sytze Wetting Trail
location: Outdoor centrum Copini, Leeuwarden, Friesland, Netherlands
description: The Sytze Wetting Trail is an annual trail run organized by AV Lionitas in the nature reserve of de Lytse en Grutte Wielen near Leeuwarden. The trail offers an adventurous course mainly on unpaved paths, grass, and narrow trails, with enjoyment of nature as the main focus. There are three distances: 19 km, 7.9 km, and a Kidsrun of 1 km. The run is more challenging than a road race and requires good trail shoes with tread. After the race, participants receive free pea soup.
course_highlights: Mostly unpaved course through the nature reserve of de Lytse en Grutte Wielen
Adventurous route over grass and narrow trails
Possibility of wet feet, recommended to wear good trail shoes with tread
additional: Clothing facilities and showers available. Bag racks to store your belongings. Refreshments during and after the race. Please park in Kleine Wielen (Groene Ster), not at Restaurant Groote Wielen. After the race, free pea soup offered by Restaurant de Groote Wielen. Trail through nature reserve, unpaved ground, start and finish near Outdoor Center Copini, Leeuwarden, with refreshments and free pea soup afterwards.

name: USP Night Run - powered by Runnersworld Utrecht
description: The USP Night Run is a festive night run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park, with distances for both adults and children. The route passes through the beautiful, illuminated Botanical Gardens, providing a unique and spectacular running experience. The event offers a lively and sporty evening with a cozy start and finish area, including water stations along the way and at the finish. There is also attention for teams and companies wishing to participate together, with additional options such as running shirts and pasta meals.
course_highlights: Run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park
Spectacular passage through the illuminated Botanical Gardens
Distances of 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and kids runs of 800 m and 1.5 km

Additional items available for order upon registration: USP Night Run shirt, cancellation insurance, pasta meal. Company teams can participate with their own running shirts and consumption tokens. Name on bib with registration chip. The event supports good causes and offers discounts and extra items such as a running shirt and pasta meal.

name: Utrecht Science Park Night Run

Participants run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park, including a spectacular passage through the lit-up Botanical Gardens. Various distances are available, including 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and kids runs. The event is organized by Central Events and supports the charitable cause Stichting ALS Nederland.

Distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km, plus kids runs

The start and finish take place at Skipiste Nieuwegein, where a cozy afterparty is also held. The trail runs through a beautiful nature reserve and offers various distances for both trail and paved terrain runners. Participants must use a headlamp due to running in the dark, which contributes to the unique atmosphere of the event.

There is a mixed changing area and first aid available. The event is cup-free; participants bring their own waste. After the race, there is an afterparty at the hospitality venue at the start/finish. Trail and paved routes, headlamp required, online registration, supporting good causes.

Since 2024, the start location is at childcare center ’t Schoapie, which improves accessibility and atmosphere. The Schalmloop offers distances for all ages and is known for its challenging, varied nature route with gentle elevation changes. The event guarantees a cozy and sporty winter day in nature.
course_highlights: Course mainly through Boetelerveld nature reserve

additional: The Schalmloop features multiple distances: 1.3 km (start 11:45), 2.6 km (start 11:25), 5.2 km (start 12:00), and 10.7 km (start 10:00). Beautiful nature and challenging terrain

name: Ameland Adventurerun
description: The Ameland Adventurerun is an adventurous running event taking place in December on the Wadden Island of Ameland. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, and 21 kilometers, as well as special children's distances of 1 and 2 kilometers. The event combines sporting challenge with the unique nature of the island and winter elements. It is a festive event with a finish party and a warm reception for runners and supporters.
course_highlights: Running between Wadden Sea and North Sea with pristine nature
Distances of 5, 10, and 21 kilometers plus children's distances
Winter elements and a festive finish party with Christmas tunes
additional: After the finish, participants of 5, 10, and 21.1 km receive a medal and a special Ameland Adventurerun bandana. There is a race secretariat in the Sporthal Nes where the participation packet can be collected. The organization promotes sustainability by minimizing cups at refreshment stations and offers ECO cups. Participants must book their ferry crossing themselves via Wagenborg Passagiersdiensten. description: Spaarnwoude Park Ultra is a unique running race in Velsen-Zuid where participants run laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km through a nature reserve. Each lap must be completed within 30 minutes to qualify for the next lap, with participants able to choose which distance they run on the day itself. The event takes place at the Peddelpoel recreational pond and is limited to 150 participants, organized by volunteers from Loopmeesters and RunX Haarlem. The start and rest zone offers facilities such as toilets and picnic tables, and after the race, all runners receive hot chocolate as a memento.
course_highlights: Laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km through a nature reserve
30-minute limit per lap
Start and finish at Peddelpoel recreational pond with facilities
additional: Maximum of 150 participants per edition. Participants bring their own food and drinks. There are exchange cups for the fastest runners in the last lap, one per distance. The start and rest area provides space for tents, chairs, and support crews. All participants receive a memento and hot chocolate after the race. Laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km, 30-minute limit per lap, participants bring their own food and drinks, memento and hot chocolate after the race.

The event is presented on the WeTri platform, which supports a wide range of triathlon and running events in the Netherlands. The race invites runners to participate in a sporting challenge while raising awareness for cancer.

Location in Tuitjenhorn

description: The KNRM West Coast Challenge is a unique one-day endurance sports event where teams of two take turns running and cycling over a distance of 130 kilometers from Hoek van Holland to Den Helder, almost entirely along the beach. There is also a half challenge of 62 kilometers for duos and solo runners, with solo participants allowed to be accompanied by a cyclist. The event is focused on fundraising for the KNRM, with all proceeds going to rescue operations. The start is on December 12, 2026, at 04:30 for the full challenge and at 11:00 for the half challenge. The atmosphere is friendly, and participants are encouraged to strengthen their connection with the KNRM.
course_highlights: 130 kilometers almost entirely along the beach past twelve KNRM coast stations
Course is unmarked; participants find their own way
Crossing at IJmuiden with KNRM rescue boats and tidal changes is important
additional: Participants must find their own route as the course is unmarked. Front and rear lights on the bike are mandatory in the dark (04:30-08:00 and from 17:00). In case of poor beach conditions, the cyclist may ride through the dunes. There is a reschedule date on January 16, 2027, in case of bad weather. The half challenge starts at 11:00 at restaurant Sea You in Velsen-Noord. Teams can choose full payment or half price with a sponsorship action via samenvoorknrm.nl. Registration is final after payment or after reaching the sponsorship amount. The event involves a run-bike-run alternation and has a strong focus on fundraising for the KNRM. Details about registration and participation costs are not specified.

Festive atmosphere with warm-up and medal ceremony
Afterwards, drinks in the Kapelstraat

The event includes fun runs for families, classmates, teams, friends, and neighborhoods; multiple Rotary Clubs in the Netherlands organize similar events; in 2026, participation will be expanded with a large national involvement.

description: The Mescherberg Run is a nearly forty-year-old mountain running classic in South Limburg, held in December. The course takes you over steep climbs and unpaved paths through the Savelsbos and the fields around Eijsden and Mesch, featuring challenging elevation changes and the legendary staircase trail. There are four distances and a Kidsrun, suitable for both beginner and experienced trail and mountain runners. The race has no time limit, allowing everyone to finish at their own pace. Organized by the Maasrunners and supported by volunteers, this run offers a unique experience in the special landscape of the Bocage land.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and unpaved paths through the Savelsbos
Legendary staircase trail on the 16.1 km and half marathon
Extra loop through Belgian Voeren at the half marathon
additional: Each distance has its own color start number and route marking. There is no time limit for all distances. Trail shoes are recommended due to the unpaved and technical course. Start and finish are at S.V.M.E. in Eijsden. No baggage drop-off is available. Drinking stations are present on the 10 km (1 station), 16.1 km (2 stations), and half marathon (3 stations). The Kidsrun is free and starts well before the other distances with different start times per age group. Various distances, trail course with climbs and descents, no time limit, shirts for sale, Kidsrun for young runners, involved in nature conservation and social initiatives.

description: The Ter Specke Loop takes place in the beautiful, wooded environment of Sportpark Ter Specke in Lisse. The characteristic course is flat and sheltered, starting on Spekkelaan and finishing on the athletics track. The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km, running one to three laps. For families and the youngest participants, there is a free GeZZinsloop of 1 km with a medal afterwards. After crossing the finish line, you are welcomed at the Health Square with fruit and water, provided by the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit.

Distances of 1 km (GeZZinsloop), 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km

Circuit participants can switch between short and medium distances unlimited times via the information desk; switching to the long distance is only possible through individual registration. Various distances (5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 1 km kids' run), start and finish at Sportpark Ter Specke, on-site registration with card payment, free kids' run, and massage options after the race.

The course features hills and turns, registration until December 12, start and finish at De Oude Brandtoren, various categories including a fun run for all ages.

The event was started in 2008 by Rotary Club Gorinchem and has since grown into a nationwide phenomenon with dozens of editions in the Netherlands and some abroad. In 2019, Santa Runs were organized in 58 cities with a combined revenue of over €450,000 for more than 100 charities. The Rotary Santa Run aims for a uniform appearance and a powerful collective start on the Saturday before Christmas.

Participants dressed as Santa Claus
Uniform national appearance with simultaneous starts

The event requires a minimum of 240 participants per location and is preferably held on the Saturday before Christmas. The organization is a turnkey concept with a manual, contingency plan, and uniform appearance. location: Sportclub Prins Hendrik atletiekbaan, Vught, North Brabant, Netherlands
distance_verbose: 27 km, Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km, 3.5 km
