description: The Kangaroo Run is a running and walking event in Vught that takes place on Boxing Day. The start and finish are at the athletics track of sports club Prins Hendrik, located in a wooded area. Participants can choose from various distances ranging from 3.5 km to 27 km, including a special kids run and a paraloop for athletes with disabilities. After the finish, there is a festive Christmas atmosphere with mulled wine, sausage rolls, and a sustainable keepsake made by Cello Zorg.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Prins Hendrik athletics track in a wooded environment
Quiet roads along fields, meadows, and forests
5 km partly unpaved, other distances paved, one lap per distance
additional: Warm-up at 13:15 for distances up to 10 km. Refreshments with water, tea, orange, and sports drinks available at the finish and at aid stations at 15, 21, and 27 km. First aid and masseurs present. Spacious changing and shower facilities and a guarded cloakroom. Parking with instructions from parking attendants. Public transport: 20 minutes walk from Vught station. Kids run maximum 500 meters, maximum 50 participants. Paraloop 3.5 km fully paved, starts at 13:30. The course runs over quiet roads, both paved and unpaved. Registration is possible via inschrijven.nl. The event offers facilities such as refreshments, first aid, changing rooms, and showers. Registration usually opens a few months before the event.

name: Kasteelloop
description: The Kasteelloop in Horst aan de Maas is a lively and traditional running race held annually on the second Christmas day. The race offers various distances for different ages, from the little ones to experienced runners, attracting a broad audience. The route takes you through the beautiful Horst and surroundings, with a sporty and festive atmosphere. The organization ensures a warm welcome and a well-organized event with award ceremonies for all categories.
course_highlights: Distances range from 600 meters for the very young to 10 kilometers for adults
Start and finish in Horst aan de Maas with a varied route through the area
Distance sponsors for the 5 km and 10 km add extra engagement
additional: Program start times: 10:00 600m (0-5 years), 10:10 1000m (6-9 years), 10:20 2000m (10-15 years), 10:45 5000m, 11:30 10000m. Award ceremonies after each distance. Distance sponsors: Vissers Energy Group (5 km), Unique Waterontharders (10 km). Registration for 2026 is closed; sponsors include Vleeshandel Willems and Eric Heijligers.

name: Oudejaarsloop Blijham
price_range: 8 euro, leden 7 euro, jeugd t/m 17 jaar 4 euro
description: The New Year's Eve Run in Blijham is an annual running event organized by Atletiekvereniging Aquilo. The event attracts more than 1000 runners and walkers and takes place with start and finish at the parking lot of ASVB. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and sporting challenge at the end of the year. The organization ensures a well-organized and safe race environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the parking lot of ASVB in Blijham
Popular New Year's Eve running event with more than 1000 participants
Varied course suitable for runners and walkers
additional: The New Year's Eve Run is an event with a large turnout of runners and walkers. Results from previous editions are available online via an external link. Photos of the event are shared on local news and blog sites. The organization is part of AV Aquilo, which also organizes other running events in the region. Course updates, registration from 10:00 AM, participation includes prizes and pacers for speed.

name: Keiloop
description: The Keiloop is an annual running event organized by Sportclub Meddo, taking place in 2026 for the 39th time. The race offers five different distances: 1, 3, 5, 10, and 15 kilometers, suitable for various levels and ages. The event is held in Winterswijk Meddo and is known as a beautiful tradition within the local sports community. The organization also invites volunteers to contribute to the success of the race.
course_highlights: Five distances: 1, 3, 5, 10, and 15 km
Organized by Sportclub Meddo in Winterswijk Meddo
Annual event with a long-standing tradition
additional: The race is held annually and has a loyal group of participants. Registration is possible via the official website. The event takes place in winter, around Christmas, and offers a great opportunity for a sporting activity in the Achterhoek.

name: Kerstloop Amstelveen
description: The Christmas Run Amstelveen is a festive running event held in the beautiful Amsterdam Forest. The routes are mostly car-free and offer a pleasant running experience for young and old. With distances of 2.5 km for youth, 5 km for fast runners, and a main distance of 10 km, there is a suitable challenge for everyone. After the race, all participants receive a medal and can enjoy a fresh oliebol. The organization AV Startbaan and Roda Conditie warmly welcome everyone for an active and gezellig day.
course_highlights: Routes mostly through the Amsterdam Forest
Car-free course
Free parking at the start
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day of the event from 10:00 at RODA’23. Time registration is done with a chip on the start number, which must not be folded. After the race, each participant receives a fresh oliebol and a medal. The top three in each distance receive a trophy, and there is a €50 prize for breaking the course record on the 10 km. Payment on the day can only be made with exact cash or QR code, no card payment. Routes through the Amsterdam Forest, pre-registration recommended, electronic timing, parking at the sports complex, changing and shower facilities.

name: 33e Physique 3de Kerstdagloop
description: The Physique Third Christmas Day Run in Arnhem is a festive running event taking place on Sunday, December 27, 2026. The main race is the half marathon of 21.1 km, known as one of the most beautiful and challenging half marathons in the Netherlands, featuring a demanding course through forests and heathlands. Additionally, there are distances of 14 km and 7 km, which partly run over unpaved paths and hilly terrain. The race is organized at Sportcentrum Valkenhuizen and offers facilities such as changing rooms, showers, and supervised baggage storage. Timing is done with the Ipico system, and there are refreshment stations on the longer distances.
course_highlights: Half marathon course of 21.1 km with 185 meters elevation change through forests and heathlands
14 km route with more than 50% unpaved paths and a fast start over hills and avenues
7 km course with forest sections, many climbs and descents, and the notorious 'Goat Hill'
additional: Changing rooms, showers, and free supervised baggage storage available. First aid is provided. Timing with Ipico chip, which must be returned after the race (unreturned chips cost 10 euros). Refreshment stations at 8 and 17 km for the half marathon and at 10 km for the 14 km. Volunteers are members of Ciko’66. The finish line is on the track of Ciko’66. Routes through forests and heathlands, car-free bike paths, changing rooms, first aid, sports massages, limited parking, public transport recommended.

name: Drenthe Trail Run
price_range: 7 km: €25,50 + €1 administratiekosten; 18 km: €36,50 + €1 administratiekosten; 26 km: €42,50 + €1 administratiekosten
description: The Drenthe Trail Run is a winter trail run taking place on December 29, 2026, in Norg. Participants can choose from three distances: 7, 18, or 26 kilometers, which pass through the forests, heathlands, and unpaved paths of Drenthe. The event focuses on nature experience, adventure, and camaraderie, with a varied course suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The start and finish are in Norg, and time slots are used to ensure safety and tranquility on the course.
course_highlights: Varied course through forests, sandy roads, and trails
Routes of 7, 18, and 26 km through the most beautiful natural areas of Drenthe
Winter trail emphasizing nature and adventure
additional: Time slots are used per distance to keep the course calm and safe. Participants receive personal time registration and their first name on the bib. There are refreshment stations with snacks, sports nutrition, and water; participants are asked to bring their own reusable cup for sustainability. First aid and technical assistance are available at the start/finish. After the finish, there is food, drinks, music, and socializing. A baggage point is available for dry clothing. Trail shoes are recommended. Registration opens on June 17, 2023, at 08:00 AM, with the use of time slots for safety and tranquility. The event emphasizes outdoor adventure, respect for nature, and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Sylvesterloop Elsloo

name: Vaarderhoogt Sylvester By Night

description: The Vaarderhoogt Sylvester by Night Run is a unique evening run in the atmospherically lit Soester Dunes. Participants can choose up to three laps of 1300 meters each through a beautifully decorated forest and dune area, following the official course of the Sylvestercross. The finish line is at the familiar location, offering a preview of the big Sylvestercross day. In addition to the run, there is a Family Run for children and a walking tour, making the event suitable for the whole family. Prepare for a magical evening full of fun and a special running experience.
course_highlights: Run through a beautifully lit forest and dune area
Official course of the Sylvestercross
Finish at the familiar location in the Soester Dunes
additional: Participants can order an LED foam stick during registration, which can be picked up together with the start number. The walking tour starts at 18:30 and is one lap of 1.3 km. The Family Run is specially for children aged 5 to 15 and starts at 19:00. The course is difficult to navigate for strollers and rollators. The run offers a magical evening with various experience pieces along the course. Decorations, optional foam stick, registration with the possibility to participate in an originality prize, start and finish in the dunes, donation to the Princess Maxima Center Foundation.

name: AH Oudejaars Crossloop Vorden
location: Het Grote Veld, Vorden, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: The AH Old Year’s Cross Run in Vorden takes place on Wednesday, December 30, and offers a festive run through the most beautiful forest paths and sandy roads of the nature reserve 'Het Grote Veld'. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, or 15 km, and there is a special kids' cross of 1 km for children aged 4 to 12. The organization ensures a friendly atmosphere with coffee, tea, and oliebollen afterwards, and there are prizes for various categories. Registration is open until December 27 at 6:00 PM, after which participants will receive their start number.
course_highlights: Running over forest paths and sandy roads in nature reserve 'Het Grote Veld'
Distances of 5, 10, and 15 km available
Kids' cross of 1 km for children aged 4-12
additional: Registration fee includes coffee or tea and an oliebollen afterwards. For kids' cross participants, there is juice, an oliebollen, and a medal. A start number with chip for time registration will be sent via email one day before the run and can be collected up to half an hour before the start. Same-day registration is not possible. Registration is open from mid-September until December 27 at 6:00 PM; the event attracts many participants from the region and is known for its friendly atmosphere.

name: Oudjaarsrun
description: On December 31, 2026, LSV Invictus will organize the second edition of the New Year's Eve Run in Appelscha, a sporting event to actively close the year. Participants can choose between two distances: 5 km and 10 km. The course is fully paved and runs through the beautiful National Park Het Drents Friese Wold, with start and finish in the center of Appelscha. After finishing, there is an opportunity to celebrate the sporty year with music and conviviality in the Steegdenhal.
course_highlights: Fully paved course
Run through National Park Het Drents Friese Wold
Start and finish in the center of Appelscha at Boerestreek
additional: Pick up race numbers and award ceremony in the Steegdenhal. Afterwards, there is a festive closing with music and conviviality. Ample parking available for participants and visitors. Start times at 11:00 and 11:10 AM, parking at Pretpark Duinenzathe and in the center of Appelscha, participation possible in 5 or 10 km, cozy closing in Steegdenhal.

name: Oliebollenloop
description: The New Year's Eve Run is the last sporting challenge of the year in the north, held on December 31st in and around Gorredijk. The race offers distances of 4 miles and 10 km, with separate starts for solo runners and corporate teams. Additionally, there is a kids run with three distances for different age groups. The route is traffic-safe and well marked, and afterwards, participants are rewarded with delicious oliebollen (Dutch doughnuts).
course_highlights: 4 miles and 10 km course through Gorredijk with refreshment stations
Car-free route with traffic controllers for safety
Kids run with distances of 600m, 900m, and 1600m for different groups
additional: Kids run start times: 600m at 10:45, 900m at 11:00, 1600m at 11:15. 10 km start at 12:05, 4 miles start at 12:20. Corporate run possible with teams of 3-5 participants, finishing time based on the first 3 finishers. No same-day registration, registration can be done online until December 30th at 22:00 or until the limit is reached. Registrations in October and November include a free Craft Oliebollen Running Shirt. Bib transfer possible via platform until December 13th at 23:59. Registration is online until December 30th, no same-day registration available. Start times are around 12:00, with the start location at Sportcentrum Kortezwaag. Parking advice: cycle or carpool, road closure from 11:00.

name: Sylvestercross
description: The Sylvestercross is an annual running event in the Lange Duinen of Soest, known as the most beautiful cross-country race in the Netherlands. The event spans two days, with the festive Sylvester by Night runs on December 30 and various performance runs and official races on December 31, including cross-country races for different age groups and levels. Since 2025, the Sylvestercross has held bronze status in the World Athletics Cross Country Tour, making it an important event for competitive runners. The course offers challenging routes through dunes and forest, with special rounds for youth, recreational runners, and a new trail run of 21.5 km.
course_highlights: Course in the Lange Duinen of Soest with dune and forest landscape
Four different rounds ranging from 400 meters to 3,300 meters
New Sylvester Trail Run of 21.5 km over former forest marathon course
additional: The Sylvestercross consists of various race components for different age groups and levels, including a relay cross and G-cross. The relay cross is a team race with 4 participants, each running a round of 1900 meters. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The Sylvestercross is part of the National Cross Circuit and offers athletes the opportunity to collect points for the World Athletics ranking. Multiple distances and categories, including night run and relays; event on December 30 and 31, 2026; registration possible via the website.

name: Tankloop Westkapelle
location: De Tank, Zeedijk, Westkapelle, Zeeland, Netherlands
description: The Tankloop Westkapelle is a running event that takes place annually on the dike in Westkapelle. The run offers a unique experience along the coastline with a challenging course suitable for both performance-oriented runners and recreational runners. The organization of Dynamica Sport welcomes participants of all levels for a sporty end to the year. Registration can be easily done via the provided registration link.
course_highlights: Running along the sea dike of Westkapelle
Unique coastal course with beautiful views
Suitable for both competitive and recreational runners
additional: Register via inschrijven.nl; participant overview available; invitation available as an attachment; members of Dynamica receive a discount on the registration fee when registering in advance. Paved terrain, registration until December 29th 23:59, start and finish at ‘De Tank’ on the Zeedijk, first aid available, no shower facilities.

name: Katerloop
description: The Katerloop is a traditional running race organized by the Limmer Ice Club during the Limmer Fair. The race attracts both youth and adults and offers various distances, including 5 and 10 kilometers. The course runs, among other places, through the garden of the Cornelius Church and is known for its cozy and sporty atmosphere. The start is in the morning, with the youngest children starting at 10:00 AM and adults at 10:30 AM. The Katerloop is an annual event with a warm community and enthusiastic participants.
course_highlights: Course through the garden of the Cornelius Church
Distances of 5 and 10 kilometers
Start during the Limmer Fair in Limmen
additional: Registration is confirmed via email verification. After confirmation, the site administrator will contact you. There are separate start times for youth and adults. The organization is the Limmer Ice Club, founded in 1895. The Katerloop in Limmen is held during the Limmer Fair and is known for its small-scale, friendly atmosphere. The edition in Numansdorp on January 1, 2027, offers participants a starting number including a souvenir cup, and registration is possible until December 28.

name: Florijn Winterloop
location: Sportpark De Koekel, Woudenberg, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: The Florijn Winter Run is an annual running and walking event in Woudenberg, marking the sporting start of the new year for over 30 years. The routes pass through the beautiful Landgoed Den Treek and the Utrecht Hill Ridge, featuring a mix of paved and unpaved paths. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and experienced athletes and offers various distances, including 5 km and 10 km forest runs. The atmosphere is sporty and convivial, with a rich tradition and a true Florijn mentality.
course_highlights: Routes through Landgoed Den Treek and the Utrecht Hill Ridge
Mix of paved and unpaved paths
Private path 'Ravensloot' exclusively accessible during the run
additional: Timing registration via ChronoRace with chip; results can be followed live on the website and social media; bib pickup on the day itself before the start at Sportpark De Grift; same-day registration is not possible; course records and prize money available; multiple start times per distance (5 km start at 13:00, 10 km start at 14:00). The event also includes a winter walk and features an extensive route on the sports park in Woudenberg.

With distances ranging from youth run to half marathon, it offers a suitable challenge for every level. The route takes you through the beautiful Groningen-Friesland landscape with wide views and a warm atmosphere at the start and finish. The event is known for its friendly and sporty character, where runners and spectators together start the new year actively.

Start and finish at the former church on Plantsoen
Refreshment stations along the route with sports drinks, tea, water, and fruit

Bib pickup until 15 minutes before the start. Parking on the parking lot of v.v. De Wilper Boys near the clubhouse. First aid available at the start/finish and mobile along the route. Refreshments with sports drinks, tea, water, and fruit. Results with finish video available. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon; pre-registration required; winter conditions; youth and adults; parking near the sports club; first aid present; remembrance and refreshments included.

name: De Nieuwjaarsloop
location: Leiden Atletiek, Leiden, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The New Year's Run in Leiden is an accessible running race to start the new year actively. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, or 15 kilometers, with start and finish on the athletics track. The race is organized by Leiden Atletiek in collaboration with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest and is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but participation in the circuit is not mandatory. The event emphasizes the fun of participation, with prizes for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the athletics track
Choice of 5, 10, or 15 kilometers
Part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit
additional: The New Year's Run is organized by Leiden Atletiek together with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest. The race is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but participation in the circuit is not mandatory. There are prizes for the fastest runners. Registration can be done via the registration form on the race page. The run is traditionally held on January 3rd, with same-day registration. The event is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit and is supported by local sports clubs.

name: Douwe Kleefstra
description: The Douwe Kleefstra Run is a recreational running race starting from the Lionitas athletics track in Leeuwarden. The race offers various distances: 1 km kids run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 16.1 km (10 miles), with routes precisely measured. The 10 km route passes through Goutum and Zuidlanden, while the 16 km follows the same route with an additional loop via Bredyk, a tunnel under the railway, and a section of the Elfstedentocht. All participants receive a cup of hot chocolate after the race. The fastest man and woman in the 10-mile race are awarded the Douwe Kleefstra and Sietske Rijpstra trophies, respectively.
course_highlights: Start from the Lionitas athletics track
10 km route through Goutum and Zuidlanden
16.1 km route with an extra loop via Bredyk, tunnel, and Elfstedentocht
additional: Electronic timing with chip in the start number. Participation is entirely at own risk and responsibility. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. There is an affordable combined registration available for the Douwe Kleefstra Run, Leeuwarden-Marsum-Leeuwarden, and Rondje Goutum with a special Golden Lion start number and raffle. The distance chosen during pre-registration for the Douwe Kleefstra Run determines the distance for the other runs in the combination. Distances range from 1 km to 16.1 km; pre-registration required; special combined and youth prizes; start at the Nijlân athletics track.

name: Oliebollen omloop
location: Sportpark Pelzer, Boxmeer, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Olympia's Oliebollen Omloop is an annual running event held on the first Sunday of the new year at Sportpark Pelzer in Boxmeer. The race is intended for members, interested parties, and participants in the Run Competition Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. The run over various distances offers a great opportunity to actively close the Christmas holidays, start the new year sportively, and enjoy team spirit and conviviality. The route takes you over the sports park and through the adjacent Brestbos. Prizes are available for the winners and, of course, eternal fame.

Route through the adjacent Brestbos
Various distances available
additional: The run is part of the Run Competition Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. There are prizes for the winners and the event promotes team spirit and conviviality. Running race over various distances, through sports park and Brestbos, prizes for winners

The race takes place on public roads and offers various distances: 5 km, 10 km, 16.1 km running, and a 16 km walk. After the finish, participants receive a bucket of snert, a traditional treat. There are prizes for the best runners per distance and age category, and the bib numbers also serve as lottery tickets. Registration is exclusively online and closes a few days before the event.

Coffee stop for walkers at the Culture House in Lutjewinkel

For walkers, there is a coffee stop at the Culture House in Lutjewinkel. Immediately after the finish, participants receive a bucket of snert. The race takes place on public roads at Sportcomplex de Kogge, with the course and registration online, and start and finish at JT Bulbs.

name: Goese Wallenloop

description: The 64th Wallenloop, organized by AV'56 in Goes, is a traditional running race taking place on Saturday, January 9, 2027. The race attracts athletes from the region and offers a challenging course through the city of Goes. The organization ensures a sporty and friendly atmosphere, welcoming both recreational runners and competitive athletes. The Wallenloop is an important event in the Zeeland running calendar and is known for its good organization and enthusiastic participants.
course_highlights: Course through the historic center of Goes
Varied surface with city roads
Atmospheric winter race in January
additional: The General Conditions for Running Events of AV'56 apply to the races. Shoe checks may take place in case of special performances according to the race regulations. The organization can be reached via the contact form on the website and by phone during races at 0113-230788. Race categories range from 900 meters to 7560 meters, online registration is possible until a few days before the race, no on-site registration mentioned.

name: Zandstuve Bosloop
description: The Zandstuve Bosloop is a challenging cross-country run that is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competition. The race takes place in the beautiful, forested Zandstuve forest, managed by Overijssels Landschap, and is organized by Loopgroep de Zandstuve in collaboration with Sportlust Vroomshoop. The run offers various distances for youth and adults, with a friendly and sporty atmosphere. The competition consists of five races in the region, with participants competing in different age categories for the overall victory.
course_highlights: Running in the forested Zandstuve forest managed by Overijssels Landschap
Cross-country run part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competition
Distances: 1500 m for youth, 5 km and 10 km for adults, with laps of 750 m and 5 km
additional: On-site registration for individual participation is possible up to half an hour before the start at the Clubhouse of Sportlust Vroomshoop. Youth run 1500 meters (2 laps of 750 m), 5 km participants run 1 lap, and 10 km participants run 2 laps of 5 km. Prizes are awarded for all categories at 5 km and 10 km, medals for youth at 1.5 km, and a souvenir for Canicross participants. With individual registration, a contribution to Landschap Overijssel can be made. Distances: 1500m (youth), 5 km, 10 km; pre-registration and on-site registration available; donation option for Landschap Overijssel; prizes for various categories.

name: StardGRL
description: The Stard Grote Rivieren Loopcircuit (StardGRL) is a running competition in the Drechtsteden region consisting of nine running events spread throughout the year. The races take place in various typical Dutch landscapes and vary in distance from 5 km to a half marathon. Participants compete in age categories, and the standings are determined by the best six performances out of the nine races. The atmosphere is informal and friendly, with a lot of attention to personal goals and mutual rivalry.
course_highlights: Nine running events through typical Dutch landscapes
Distances range from 5 km to half marathon
Standings based on the best six performances out of nine races
additional: The competition consists of nine races with a ranking where the best six performances count. Participants run in age categories and can register for the entire circuit. There is an informal and friendly atmosphere around the races with opportunities for socializing and drinks afterwards. Nine races, registration and ranking information available, results are posted on uitslagen.nl.

description: The JSC Crossloop Broekland is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit, a winter competition with ten unique cross races in various villages of Salland. The course in Broekland offers a challenging and atmospheric cross-country experience in a natural setting. The races are suitable for both avid competitive runners and recreational runners who enjoy outdoor running. The competition encourages participation in multiple races with a points system based on the best performances of the season.
course_highlights: Unique cross course in the beautiful Salland
Varied terrain with rolling hills, forest paths, meadows, and sandy sections
Suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners
additional: The JSC Crossloop Broekland is part of a competition with 10 cross races in Salland. The best 6 races count towards the standings (instead of 7). There is a kids run of 1 km that does not count towards the standings. The organization places great importance on safety and may decide to cancel a race in bad weather conditions, as recently happened due to slipperiness and low wind chill temperatures. Race canceled due to bad weather and safety concerns.

name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition that has been organized by MPM in Hengelo for over 45 years. The competition consists of four races held over the first few months of the year, with distances of 1.4 km, 5.1 km, 10 km, and 15 km. The course runs through the countryside of Hengelo, with start and finish at the same location in Woolderes. The races are accessible to various categories and offer prizes in cash and vouchers. The organization provides electronic timing and there is an opportunity to shower afterwards.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside of Hengelo
Start and finish at the same location in Woolderes
Distances of 1.4 km, 5.1 km, 10 km, and 15 km
additional: Pre-registration closes on January 3, 2027; late registration is possible on race day from 9:00 AM until half an hour before the start at IKC De Wooldermarke. A race number with chip is issued once for all four races and can be picked up on Saturday beforehand or on race day. Running shirt and medal are optional and can be ordered and collected. Shower facilities are available at Gymzaal Woolderesweg. The race number must be worn on the chest. Wearing earplugs/headphones is discouraged. Bringing animals, strollers, etc. is not allowed. Start times: 11:00 AM for 10 km and 15 km, 11:06 AM for 5.1 km, 11:10 AM for 1.4 km. Registration on Sunday morning from 9:00 AM, start and finish in Woolderes, weather conditions may affect the race, prizes include cash and vouchers.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a popular regional running event held annually at RCN Camping Zeewolde. The event offers various distances, including 1, 2, 5, and 10 kilometers, with the longer distances consisting of multiple laps. The run is accessible to both recreational and competitive runners and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic routes. The Flevo Fun Run is part of the activities of TVZ Zeewolde and attracts runners from the region.
course_highlights: Routes of 1, 2, 5, and 10 km with multiple laps for longer distances
Start and finish at RCN Camping Zeewolde
Varied course suitable for recreational and competitive runners
additional: The 2 km route consists of 2 laps. The 10 km route consists of 2 laps of 5 km each. Photos and results from previous editions are available on the organization's Facebook page and photo page. Running race for young and old, registration via the website, seasonal events.

name: Q-lite Enclavecross
distance_verbose: 10 km, 8 km, 7 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1 km
description: The Q-lite Enclavecross takes place in January in the forests of Baarle-Nassau and offers a varied cross-country program with a maximum of 500 participants. The event is aimed at children, club runners, and adults, with 17 different distances ranging from short youth runs to 9 km. The route runs through the forests and the event is organized by Gloria Atletiek, with local athletes competing for classification points. The program is tightly organized and is held on time even in winter conditions.
course_highlights: Running through the forests of Baarle-Nassau
17 different distances from 0.4 km to 9.5 km
Small participant fields with a maximum of 500 runners
additional: There is a special program for children and a race for adapted sports over 1.17 km. The event is local and focused on club athletes. The weather in January is cold, around 1°C with a chance of precipitation, so warm clothing is recommended. Multiple distances, forest terrain, registration required, organized for children, youth, and adults.

name: Busreis Egmond
location: Sportpark de Hondsheuvels, Eindhoven, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: On Sunday, January 10, 2027, Eindhoven Atletiek organizes a fun bus trip to the Egmond quarter and half marathon. The bus trip is popular among runners from various athletics clubs and running groups. Participants will be provided with free food and drinks during the trip, and the departure and arrival point is Sportpark de Hondsheuvels in Eindhoven. The bus departs at 07:30 and returns at 16:30. To participate in the race itself, registration must be done separately via the official Egmond Half Marathon website.
course_highlights: Quarter and half marathon of Egmond
Departure and arrival at Sportpark de Hondsheuvels in Eindhoven
Bus trip with free food and drinks
additional: The bus has 76 seats, of which 12 are still available. Departure at 07:30 from Eindhoven and return at 16:30. The bus trip includes free food and drinks. For participation in the quarter or half marathon, registration must be done separately via the official race website. Transport to Egmond, registration for the marathon, departure at 07:30, return at 16:30, 12 seats still available.

name: Hulst by Lightrun
description: Hulst by Lightrun is a friendly running and walking event held in Hulst. The event takes place on the third Friday evening of each month and offers a cozy atmosphere for participants of various levels. The route passes through the charming streets of Hulst, making it a unique experience for runners and walkers. It is an accessible event that invites sportiness and conviviality.
course_highlights: Running and walking routes through the charming streets of Hulst
Friendly and relaxed atmosphere
Monthly event on the third Friday evening
additional: The event takes place every third Friday evening of the month. It is an accessible running and walking event with a cozy atmosphere. Friendly running & walking event held every third Friday evening.

name: 3 Meren Gieten Cross
description: The 3 Lakes Gieten Cross is a cross-country race taking place on Saturday, January 16, 2027, in Gieten, near Eext. The race is part of the UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug cross circuit and is organized by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten, and Vomos. The course runs over unpaved paths along three forest lakes in the Gieterbos, featuring forest trails, sandy paths, and steep hills. There are distances of 5 km and 9 km, suitable for different age categories, and timing is without chip. The race has a maximum of 300 participants, and there are no shower or changing facilities.
course_highlights: Unpaved paths along three forest lakes in the Gieterbos
Forest trails, sandy paths, and steep hills
Part of the UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug cross circuit
additional: Maximum of 300 participants per race. Timing without chip. No shower or changing facilities available. Juniors run approximately 5 km, seniors and masters run 9 km. Results and photos are published after the event. Course over unpaved paths, no shower or changing facilities, max 300 participants.

description: The Stadtmüller-Udikloop is a forest run race in Klijndijk, organized from the Udik community center. The event offers two distances, 10 km and 4 miles, and mostly takes place on forest paths and quiet roads. The route passes several dolmens, making it a unique and atmospheric running experience. There is a cash prize for breaking the course record, providing an extra challenge for participants.
course_highlights: Route passes several dolmens
Mostly on forest paths and quiet roads
Forest run in the vicinity of Klijndijk
additional: There is a cash prize of €100 for breaking the course record. The official 10 km course records are 30:59 for men and 35:43 for women. The event lasts approximately 2 hours and 30 minutes. Course passes dolmens, forest and road sections, registration beforehand and on the day, prizes for course record.

name: Zuurbergcross
description: The Zuurbergcross is a challenging cross-country race organized by Atletiekvereniging Holten, part of the SNS CrossCircuit of the East. The start and finish are located at the Stuurhuus of the MAC at Beusebergerweg 37 in Holten. The course is varied with some sections over hard roads and a short stretch of cobblestones, which can be avoided by running along the berm. There is ample parking, first aid available, and a speaker provides atmosphere during the event.
course_highlights: Course with some sections over hard roads
Approximately 500 meters of cobblestones that can be avoided via the berm
Start and finish at the Stuurhuus of the MAC Beusebergerweg 37
additional: Ample parking, first aid available, and a sound system during the event. Participation is entirely at your own risk. The course is suitable for spikes with some sections over hard roads and cobblestones that can be avoided. The race takes place in Beuseberg, Holten, and offers practical facilities such as registration at MAC Stuurhuus, parking, first aid, and sound equipment.

description: The Bosmarathon & Minder is a running event in Assen featuring a full marathon and several shorter distances. The routes mostly run over unpaved paths through the Asserbos, a forest area of approximately 100 hectares. Start, refreshments, and finish are at the AAC'61 athletics track. The loop is just over 7 km, with six loops making up the full marathon. There are refreshments along the way and at the finish with water, tea, broth, and sports drinks, and changing rooms are available.
course_highlights: Route mostly over unpaved paths in the Asserbos
Start, refreshments, and finish at AAC'61 athletics track
Loop of just over 7 km, six loops for the marathon
additional: Registration can be done in advance via inschrijven.nl until January 15 or on the day at the clubhouse with card payment. Refreshments along the route and at the finish include water, tea, broth, and sports drinks. Changing rooms are available at the facility at Achterpad 1, 9405 BN Assen. Participation is at your own risk. Results and photos will be published afterwards on the club page. Unpaved paths, pre-registration and same-day registration, changing rooms available.

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplasgebied, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplas Run is a series of three running races taking place in November, January, and February around the beautiful locations of the Zegerplas in Alphen aan den Rijn. The races offer distances of 5, 10, 15, and 20 km, as well as special youth distances of 400 and 1000 meters on the athletics track. There are also walking distances of 5 and 10 km that start simultaneously with the 20 km running race. The start and finish are always at the athletics track of AAV'36, which also has changing rooms, showers, and a canteen. The race features official timing and offers an almost car-free course through the Zegersloot area and around the Zegerplas.
course_highlights: Almost entirely car-free course through the Zegersloot area and around the Zegerplas
Start and finish at the athletics track of AAV'36 with changing rooms and showers
Various distances for both beginner and experienced runners, including youth distances on the track
additional: There is a time limit of 2 hours for the walking distances. A refreshment station is available on the track for participants in the 15 and 20 km races during the second lap. Free massage after the race is possible in the massage room of AAV'36 (bring your own towel). Souvenirs for youth distances are free; other souvenirs and stamp cards for participation in all three races are available for purchase. First aid is present on the track and course. The canteen is open, and limited lockers are available. Distances for runners and walkers, course through Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas, car-free course, start and finish at AAV'36 athletics track, changing rooms and showers available, free leg massage by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn.

name: Goedhart Drechtloop
location: Leimuiden, Kaag en Braassem, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Goedhart Drechtloop has been organized annually since 1969 on the third Sunday of January by Vereniging S.V. Kickers ‘69. The race offers various distances: a Kids' run of 1.4 km, 4 km, 10 km, and 10 miles. The route passes through the villages of Leimuiden and Rijnsaterwoude and along the Drecht river, providing a beautiful and varied running experience in the Green Heart.
course_highlights: Run through the villages of Leimuiden and Rijnsaterwoude
Route along the Drecht river
Varied course in the rural Green Heart
additional: The start and finish are at Beukenlaan in Leimuiden. The event runs from 11:00 to 14:00. Multiple distances are available, including a Kids' run of 1.4 km. The organization is managed by S.V. Kickers ‘69. The event takes place on January 17, 2027, from 11:00 to 14:00, with various running options and a friendly atmosphere for participants of all ages.

name: Leemkuilcross
location: Berg en Dal, Nijmegen, Gelderland, Netherlands
price_range: Kind- en jeugdcross: € 3,5; Korte- en lange cross: € 7; Na-inschrijving: € 5 en € 10
description: The Leemkuilcross is one of the most beautiful cross-country races in the Netherlands, organized by NSAV ’t Haasje and AV Cifla. It takes place on the hilly, unpaved forest course in Berg en Dal and is known for its challenging nature, with the notorious staircase as a highlight. The race offers various distances for children, youth, and adults and attracts athletes who enjoy a tough cross. Bib numbers can be collected at the Berg en Dal tennis club, and there is limited parking available. The Leemkuilcross is held annually on the third Sunday of January.
course_highlights: Hilly, unpaved forest course in Berg en Dal
Rounds around the Leemkuil with the notorious staircase as a challenge
Distances ranging from 1200m to 8400m
additional: Bib numbers can be collected at the clubhouse of the Berg en Dal tennis club, Molenbosweg 10. There is limited parking. Late registration is possible up to more than half an hour before the start of the respective cross, with higher costs. Prize ceremonies take place immediately after each event. Cancellations are possible up to a week before the event with administrative costs. The course consists of a hilly, unpaved forest route with the notorious staircase; registration is possible up to 1 week before the event; prices include registration fees and the possibility of late registration.

name: Watermolenloop
description: The Watermill Run in Haaksbergen is a popular running race that attracts many sports enthusiasts every year. The race takes place in a charming environment with a varied course that passes through nature and by characteristic spots in Haaksbergen. The 2026 edition drew enthusiastic runners early in the morning, despite the cool weather, which only enhanced the sporty atmosphere. The event is organized by the Athletics Club Haaksbergen (AVH) and is a great opportunity for both recreational and avid runners.
course_highlights: Varied course through nature and past characteristic spots in Haaksbergen
Atmospheric start at Athletics Club Haaksbergen (AVH)
Traditional event with a sporty and friendly atmosphere
additional: The Watermill Run is organized by Athletics Club Haaksbergen (AVH). The event takes place in January and attracts a wide audience of runners. There is a sporty and friendly atmosphere, even in cold weather. The race is part of the local sports activities in Haaksbergen. The Watermill Run attracts sports enthusiasts to Haaksbergen and is characterized by a route along the Oostendorper Watermill and through the Lankheterbos, with support from volunteers and security services.

name: Duin Strandloop
description: The Duinloopcircuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast featuring varied courses that combine challenging dune paths and fast beach sections. The Duin/Strandloop on January 23, 2027, offers a great atmosphere for both avid runners and recreational participants who want to enjoy running outdoors. The races are suitable for all ages with various distances, from kids runs to 10 km. The circuit encourages participation through a ranking based on the best four results.
course_highlights: Varied courses with dune paths and beach sections
Opportunities for kids runs and longer distances up to 10 km
Unique natural setting with beautiful scenery and challenging terrain
additional: Start times per distance: 500m Kidsrun at 09:30, 1 km Kidsrun at 09:35, 2 km Kidsrun at 09:45, 5 km and 10 km at 10:00. Rankings are kept for all distances, separated for girls/women and boys/men, based on the best four results of the circuit. Courses, rankings, start times, results

Participants can choose from multiple distances by running 1 to 4 laps, making it suitable for both recreational and advanced runners. The start and finish are at the same location, and chip timing is used for accurate times. The event is exclusive to employees and family members of affiliated companies at Railsport.
course_highlights: Course through hilly forest with winding sandy paths
Unpaved terrain with one lap of 2.5 km
Start and finish at the same location

Railsport Runners shirt can be purchased on the day of the event for € 5.00 and is recommended for sustainability. Location is Stationsplein 299 in Amersfoort, in the SOVA Railzicht building. Course through sandy paths in the forest, multiple distances, chip timing registration, location at Stationsplein 299, Amersfoort.

description: The Gewoon COOP Crossloop in Luttenberg is a popular and traditional cross-country race that is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit. Since 1976, participants run through the forests and hills of Luttenberg, featuring a challenging course that is mostly unpaved and includes steep climbs, including the famous climb to the bench. The race combines a unique atmosphere, a solid course, and a rich history, making it an unforgettable experience for young and old.
course_highlights: Mostly unpaved course with 70% unpaved ground
Famous climb to the well-known bench
Route through forests and over hills with views of the Sallandse Heuvelrug
additional: Start numbers are personal for the entire season and must be brought to each race. Spikes are not allowed due to potential damage to timing mats. Participants receive a unique Sallands Cross Circuit running shirt upon registration. The cross is divided into multiple distances with start times between 10:45 and 12:40 hours. The start and finish location is the Gemeenschapscentrum Elckerlyc, Butzelaarstraat 22. The race offers various distances for young and old, including a final race past the Lourdes Grotto. The event is sponsored by Charlot Jalink of Gewoon Coop and has a strong community atmosphere.

name: Halve Marathon Zoetermeer
description: The Zoetermeer Half Marathon is a festive running event taking place on Sunday, January 24, 2027. The 14th edition offers four distances: 1.5 km Kids Run, 5 km, 10 km, and the half marathon of 21.1 km. The routes pass through Burgemeester Hoekstrapark, Balijbos, and the municipalities of Zoetermeer and Pijnacker, featuring a fast and straight course. The event is suitable for young and old, with special attention to school competitions and a business run for teams.
course_highlights: Routes through Burgemeester Hoekstrapark and Balijbos
Course through the municipalities of Zoetermeer and Pijnacker
Clear kilometer markings per distance (color-coded)
additional: Running shirts can be ordered for €12.50 each and can be picked up on Saturday, January 23 between 15:00 - 17:00 and Sunday, January 24 from 10:00. There is a school competition for the 1.5 km Kids Run and a business run for teams on the 5 km distance. The half marathon has mandatory time limits at certain points of the course due to traffic closure. There is a parking policy and volunteers are sought for the event. Multiple distances, registration details, running shirts available for order, course with color coding, and timing and speed limits for the half marathon.

name: Midwintercross Heeten
location: Sportpark SV Heeten, Heeten, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Midwintercross in Heeten is a regional cross-country race that is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit and is organized by SV Heeten. The 54th edition will take place on Sunday, January 3, 2027, at Sportpark SV Heeten. The course runs through the sports park and the forests around Schoonheten, with approximately seventy percent unpaved terrain and slight elevation changes. The routes offer green landscapes and forest sections, and afterwards, there is an annual awards ceremony for the winners. The Midwintercross has a long history and has become a fixed cross-country race in the region.
course_highlights: Course over sports park and forests around Schoonheten
Approximately 70% unpaved terrain with slight elevation changes
Green landscapes and forest sections visible along the way
additional: The Midwintercross offers multiple distances. The routes of 6 km and 10 km were adjusted in 2024. After the race, there is an annual awards ceremony. Registration is open for participants, and there is a festive atmosphere.

name: Rondje Roege Baarg
description: Rondje Roege Baarg is a charming cross run and walking event organized by Hardloopclub Onstwedde in collaboration with Stichting Wandelen in Westerwolde. The running routes vary from 6.4 to 22.8 kilometers and pass through the beautiful landscape of Westerwolde, including Ter Wupping, Veele, and Wessinghuizen. There is a marked 10-kilometer route for walkers with a refreshment station. The start and finish are at MFA de Bast in Onstwedde, where changing and shower facilities are available. After the event, participants can enjoy delicious pea soup from butcher Hemmen.
course_highlights: Cross run through the beautiful Westerwolde with routes of 6.4, 11.3, 18.9, and 22.8 km
Three refreshment stations along the way for runners
Walking route of 10 km marked with yellow arrows and one refreshment station
additional: Start and finish at MFA de Bast with changing and shower facilities. Manual time registration, results via uitslagen.nl. Dogs not allowed. After the event, pea soup for all participants. Walkers can start between 10:30 and 11:30 am. Walkers receive a stamp for their walking booklet. Emergency number available for walkers. The 10 km walking route, running distances from 6.4 km to 22.8 km, start and finish at MFA De Bast, changing and shower facilities, pre-registration until January 24, participation at own risk, dogs not allowed.

name: 19e Rhoonse Griendentocht
description: The 19th Rhoonse Griendentocht is a beautiful walking event taking place in Rhoon on Saturday, January 30. Organized by the Royal Walking Association Netherlands (KWbN), it offers walkers the chance to enjoy a healthy and happy walking experience in a scenic environment. The route is suitable for both beginners and experienced walkers and contributes to promoting activity and well-being.
course_highlights: Walking through the nature reserve of Rhoon and surroundings
Options for participation on two days
Discovering local landscapes and historical environments
additional: Participants who wish to participate on two days can register for both days via the form by first signing up for Saturday and then adding a participant for Sunday via '+ add participant'. Wandel.nl is an initiative of KWbN, the largest walking organization in the Netherlands, which inspires and supports walkers. Two-day participation, registration forms, membership discounts.

name: Rondje Oeken
location: De Vroolijke Frans, Brummen, Gelderland, Netherlands
price_range: geen grote inschrijfgelden, mogelijk kleine kosten voor inschrijving
description: Oeken Run is a cozy and small-scale running event taking place in the beautiful countryside of Oeken and Brummen. The route passes along rural roads, forest edges, and quiet paths, and is fully marked and mostly traffic-free. The event is accessible to all levels, from beginners to avid runners, and is known for its friendly and sporty atmosphere. Start and finish are at De Vroolijke Frans in Brummen, which also offers ample parking.
course_highlights: Beautiful landscape with rural roads, forest edges, and quiet paths
Fully marked and mostly traffic-free course
Start and finish at De Vroolijke Frans, Knoevenoordstraat 51 Brummen
additional: There are two start times: 10:00 AM for the 21.1 km and 10:30 AM for the 12 km. Parking is available at De Vroolijke Frans and on the grass field behind it. Registration can be done via the registration form on the website, both in advance and on the day itself. The event is accessible and focused on conviviality, sportsmanship, and safety with experienced volunteers and first aid present. The course varies from unpaved to trail, includes a youth run, registration possible on the day, start at De Vroolijke Frans.

name: Uithoorns Mooiste De Loop
description: Uithoorns Mooiste De Loop is a charming and well-organized running race in Uithoorn, known for its varied and safe course. The race attracts many participants each year, including long-distance runners and children, and is supported by a large group of volunteers and traffic controllers. The event is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit and offers a festive sports day with attention for participants and a special anniversary atmosphere.
course_highlights: Varied and safe course
Special atmosphere and good organization
Part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit
additional: The race is supported by approximately 125 volunteers and more than 50 traffic controllers. There is attention for participants with water stations along the route, fruit, and a keepsake after the race. During the 40th anniversary, special treats such as whipped cream cakes and flower bulbs were distributed. Multiple distances are available, including a children's run and special categories, with registration via www.inschrijven.nl; the course runs through Uithoorn and surrounding areas, with traffic controllers and minimal disruption.

name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition that has been organized by MPM in Hengelo for over 45 years. The competition consists of four races spread over the first months of the year, with distances of 1.4 km, 5.1 km, 10 km, and 15 km. The course runs through the countryside of Hengelo, with start and finish at the same location in Woolderes. The races are accessible to various categories and offer a friendly and sporty atmosphere for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside of Hengelo
Start and finish at the same location in Woolderes
Distances ranging from 1.4 km to 15 km
additional: Pre-registration closes on January 3, 2027; late registration is possible on race day from 9:00 AM until half an hour before the start at Semmelweisstraat 46, IKC De Wooldermarke. Bib pickup can be done on the Saturday beforehand between 3:00 PM and 5:00 PM or on the race day itself. The bib includes a timing chip and is valid for all four races. Shower and changing facilities are available in the small sports hall at Woolderesweg, closing at 1:15 PM. Running shirts and medals can be optionally ordered during pre-registration and collected at bib pickup or after finishing. The classification is based on at least 3 of the 4 races. Wearing earplugs/headphones is discouraged. Bringing pets, strollers, etc., is not allowed. Participants can register for different distances, with start and finish at Woolderes. The event offers prizes such as money and vouchers. The race will be held on January 31, 2027, and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

The race offers a challenging course with a short cross of about 5 km, a long cross of about 10 km, and various youth cross distances. The start is at 10:00 AM for the short and long crosses, followed by the youth cross at 11:10 AM.
