description: The Midwinter Marathon in Apeldoorn is a three-day running event taking place in the first weekend of February. The event offers various distances, including a marathon with a unique route through the Natura 2000 area and the Kootwijkerzand, a 10-mile race through a forested and hilly environment, and shorter distances such as the Night Run and Kidsrun. The marathon route is partly off-road and passes iconic locations such as Apenheul and Radio Kootwijk. The Midwinter Marathon is known for its atmospheric organization, beautiful nature, and a wide range of participants from recreational runners to competitive athletes.
course_highlights: Marathon route with 900 meters off-road over the Kootwijkerzand
Route through Natura 2000 area with passage along Apenheul and Radio Kootwijk
10 English Miles through forested and hilly environment with the highest point at 100 meters above NAP
additional: The marathon starts and finishes at AV’34 in the Orderbos. There is a reception with coffee/tea and something sweet, and after the race, pea soup with rye bread and bacon or a vegetarian option. The 10EM starts and finishes on the Loolaan, with changing rooms and showers in nearby gymnasiums. There are start groups for the 10EM based on expected finish time. The marathon has a limit of 700 participants and registration closes once this is reached. No late registration is possible. The 10EM has a maximum of 4200 participants. Multiple refreshment stations and medical support are available. The Midwinter Marathon also offers an app for live tracking of runners. Multiple distances including Kidsrun, 8 km, and marathon; event scheduled for February 2027; registration opens in October 2026.

name: Blaauwbek Marathon
description: The Blaauwbek Marathon is a charming winter marathon around the Oldambtmeer in Blauwestad. The half and full marathons start in Bad Nieuweschans and finish at De Rietkraag, with bus transportation from the finish to the start. There are also 5 km and 10 km distances that start and finish at De Rietkraag, featuring a unique course over the airport. In addition to runners, there are walking routes of 10 and 20 km and special distances for children. The organization provides warm refreshments along the way and a warm welcome at the finish.
course_highlights: Course around the Oldambtmeer with beautiful nature and paths
Separate start and finish locations with bus transport for marathon runners
Unique course over the airport for 5 km and 10 km distances
additional: The half marathon starts at 11:15 AM with bus transport from De Rietkraag. The full marathon starts at 9:45 AM with bus transport from De Rietkraag. Finish closes at 4:30 PM for both marathon distances. Children start at 3:30 PM for the 5 km. Walkers can start independently after receiving the route. Event with various distances, including youth and walking routes, and bus transport for marathon runners. The event returns after a few years of absence and is characterized by a winter theme and a cozy atmosphere.

name: Erpelkappersloop
description: The Erpelkappersloop in Axel is a traditional race organized annually by Joggingclub Moerbeke-Waas. This race attracts both recreational and competitive runners and offers a festive and sporty experience in a beautiful setting. The race is part of a series of events organized by the club, which is known for its diverse and well-organized running activities. The Erpelkappersloop guarantees a friendly and challenging running experience during the winter season.
course_highlights: Organized in Axel, a cozy location
Traditional race with a sporty atmosphere
Part of a series of events by Joggingclub Moerbeke-Waas
additional: The race takes place on February 6, 2027, and targets a broad audience of runners.

name: Gletsjerkuil Ees Cross
organizer: Loopgroep SGO, Vomos UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug
description: The Glacier Pit Ees Cross is a challenging cross-country run taking place in the unique landscape of the Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark. The race is held in Ees and offers two distances: a short distance of approximately 5 km and a long distance of approximately 9 km, both over unpaved paths through forest and heath. The route passes along narrow trails, various glacier pits, and the storm forest with fallen trees, providing an adventurous and natural running experience. The cross is part of the Hondsrug cross circuit and is organized by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos.
course_highlights: Entirely unpaved course except for two bike path crossings
Route through narrow heath trails and various challenging glacier pits
Passage through the mysterious storm forest with fallen trees
additional: The cross is run without chip timing. There are no shower or changing facilities. The start location is Land van Bartje, Buinerweg 8, 9536 PG Ees. Public transport is available via Belbus line 59 from Borger. The cross is part of the Hondsrug cross circuit and is the 5th race in the circuit. Course through nature reserve, start at 11:00 and 11:10, registration via inschrijven.nl, no changing or shower facilities.

name: Kruikenloop
description: The Kruikenloop in Tilburg is an energetic and lively run that traditionally marks the start of the carnival in Kruikenstad. The course runs partly through the nearby Stadsbos 013 and offers distances of 5, 10, and 15 kilometers, with the 5-kilometer loop to be run multiple times. For the youth, there is a special run of 1.111 meters, focusing on fun and sportsmanship. After the finish, there is a festive afterparty in the Sarto canteen, and prizes are awarded for the best carnival costumes.
course_highlights: Course partly through Stadsbos 013
5 km loop that can be run 1, 2, or 3 times (5, 10, 15 km)
Youth run of 1.111 meters
additional: Number bib changes possible until February 8th at 18:00 via personal dashboard. Number bib transfer and resale allowed through official platform. After the finish, there is a lively afterparty in the Sarto canteen. Prizes for creatively dressed participants and a costume prize for the youth run. Chip timing via the number bib, times quickly available online. Registration via the website; course partly through Stadsbos 013; festive atmosphere with music and costumes; organized during carnival in Tilburg.

name: Leeuwarden Marsum Leeuwarden
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km
price_range: Jeugd t/m 15 jaar: € 5,00; 16 Jaar en ouder: € 7,50; meerprijs medaille € 3,50
description: Leeuwarden Marsum Leeuwarden is a classic running race starting at the Lionitas track in Leeuwarden. The course of the half marathon of 21.1 km takes you through the cold fields northwest of the city, where the wind has free rein. In addition to the half marathon, there are also distances of 1 km kidsrun, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km, all precisely measured. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. Participation is at your own risk and responsibility.
course_highlights: Half marathon course through cold fields northwest of Leeuwarden
Precisely measured distances of 1 km kidsrun, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21.1 km
Start and finish at the Lionitas athletics track
additional: Start times per distance: 1 km kidsrun at 11:00, 21.1 km at 11:10, 10 km at 11:20, 5 km at 11:35, 2 km at 11:40. Participants can check the route in advance via afstandmeten.nl and download GPX files for sports watches. The Gouden Leeuw race number is valid for this race and Rondje Goutum, with participation in raffles and the option to purchase a special medal. Terrain: farmland and athletics track; Registration online via afstandmeten.nl; Race on February 7, 2027; Start and finish location at Atletiekbaan Nijlân, Leeuwarden.

name: Twentse Vennenloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld bedraagt € 12,-. Na aftrek van minimale noodzakelijk kosten gaat de opbrengst rechtstreeks naar het sponsordoel.

description: The Twentse Ven’n Loop is a small-scale running event taking place in the beautiful nature of Twente. It is known for its relaxed atmosphere and unique running experience. This event, which will be held for the 11th time in 2027, offers participants not only a sporting challenge but also the opportunity to contribute to a good cause. The start and finish are at Camping de Meene in Buurse, and the run is characterized by Twentse hospitality.
course_highlights: Run through the beautiful Twentse nature
Start and finish at Camping de Meene in Buurse
Small-scale event with a maximum of 250 participants
additional: Maximum number of participants is 250. The proceeds from the registration fee, after deducting costs, go to a sponsorship cause. Participants must adhere to the regulations and the instructions of the organizers. Pets, strollers, and similar are not allowed. The organizers reserve the right to change the route or cancel the event in case of extreme weather conditions. The Road Traffic Act remains in force during the run. Distances: 4.8 km, 10.3 km, 16.2 km; course through nature, wet ground, facilities at start/finish, charity action.

name: AVT Valentijnscross
description: The AVT Valentijn Cross in Wierden is a challenging cross-country race held at Het Lageveld. The course runs over sandy beaches, grass, hills, and through the forest of recreation park Het Lageveld. The terrain is mainly unpaved and varied, providing a surprising and diverse running experience. This cross-country race is part of the MD Stoffering CrossCircuit of the East and attracts both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Course over sandy beaches, grass, hills, and forest
Mainly unpaved and varied terrain
Changing surface for a challenging cross-country race
additional: Pre-registrants can pick up their bib number with chip at the collection desk. Participants in the circuit may keep their bib number with chip for future races. Individual registration is possible up to half an hour before the start. Spikes are not allowed due to mat timing. The bib must be worn visibly on the front. Dogs and accompanying persons without registration are not permitted to participate. In case of extreme weather conditions, the organizers may decide to cancel the race without refund of the registration fee. Cross-country race held at recreation park Het Lageveld in Wierden, with distances of 10 km and youth distances of 1.5 km and 2.5 km, usually in February.

name: Krokusloop
description: The Duinloopcircuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast featuring varied courses that combine challenging dune paths and fast beach sections. The Krokusloop, part of this series, offers a great atmosphere for both avid runners and recreational participants who enjoy outdoor running. With various distances for different ages and levels, the event is accessible to everyone who wants to enjoy running at its best.
course_highlights: Varied courses with dune paths and beach sections
Unique running series along the Dutch coast
Suitable for all ages and levels
additional: Start times per distance: 500m Kidsrun at 09:30, 1 km Kidsrun at 09:35, 2 km Kidsrun at 09:45, 5 km and 10 km at 10:00. Rankings are kept for all distances, separated for girls/women and boys/men, based on the best four results of the circuit. Varied courses with dune paths and beach sections, part of a series of running events along the coast.

name: Polderrun
description: The Polderrun is a sporting running event in the heart of Bleskensgraaf, bringing together participants from the region and beyond. The race offers various distances, including 3.5, 7, and 10 miles, with a fast and fully paved course through the open polder. The Polderrun is known for its atmospheric start and finish in the middle of the village, and the combination of nostalgia and innovation in the course. The event also supports a charity, Stichting Moz Kids, making a meaningful contribution to vulnerable children in Mozambique.
course_highlights: Fully paved and fast course through the open polder
Long straight roads and sturdy dike banks
Start and finish in the middle of the village Bleskensgraaf
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 08:30 in the meeting area De Spil. The meeting area also offers changing rooms, toilets, and limited shower facilities. Timing is done with an Ipico chip in the race number, measuring net time. There is a water station at kilometer 8.1 of the 10 miles. Parking is available at three locations in Bleskensgraaf, with a preference for Melkwegplein and Weideweg. Same-day registration is not possible. Registration for 2027 is not yet known, but the event is popular and quickly sold out. Facilities include parking, first aid, and timing with Ipico. There is also a donation option for a charity.

name: Dinkelcross
price_range: Inschrijving via inschrijven.nl, geen expliciete prijs vermeld
description: The Dinkelcross is a beautiful cross-country race organized by Iphitos in the forest and nature reserve De Zandbergen in Losser. The race is part of the Twentse Cross Competition and offers challenging courses that are completely off-road, featuring sandy plains, steep short hills, and a route along a tributary of the Dinkel River. Various distances are available for both youth and adults, ranging from 1 km to 10 km. The Dinkelcross is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants and emphasizes the Olympic idea that participation is more important than winning. After the race, participants can enjoy socializing and homemade cake at the Zaandhoes, the start and finish location.
course_highlights: Completely off-road course through forest and nature reserve De Zandbergen
Crossing a sandy plain and several steep short hills
Running along a tributary of the Dinkel River
additional: A maximum of 150 day participants can register; late registration is not possible. The start and finish location is the Zaandhoes, accessible from Grensweg. There are changing rooms and shower facilities. Start times are divided over different distances and age categories between 10:30 and 12:45 hours. The Dinkelcross is part of the Twentse Cross Competition. Off-road course, various distances, start and finish at Zaandhoes, changing rooms and showers available, suitable for all levels.

name: Noord-Aa Polderloop
location: Road Runners clubhuis, Zoetermeer, South Holland, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname kost 4 euro voor de 1,5 kilometer

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname kost 7,50 euro voor de 5 kilometer

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname kost 10 euro voor de 10 kilometer

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname kost 15 euro voor de 15 kilometer

description: The Noord-Aa Polder Run takes place on Sunday, February 14, 2027, at the clubhouse of the Road Runners in Zoetermeer. The course runs through the polder area around the Noord-Aa and is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. There are various distances: a kids run of 1.5 km and the 5, 10, and 15 kilometers, allowing everyone to choose a suitable goal. The proceeds of the event go to IKC Het Zwanenbos to support education and well-being of children in the region.
course_highlights: Course through the polder area around the Noord-Aa
Route along water, open polder land, and paved paths
Variation in distances from 1.5 km to 15 km
additional: Each distance starts at a different time to keep the course clear: 1.5 km at 12:30 PM, 5 km at 1:00 PM, 10 km at 1:10 PM, and 15 km at 1:20 PM. Pre-registration is recommended for a guaranteed start spot. The event is made possible by sponsors; new partners can contact via the provided email address. Course through the polder around the Zoetermeer Plas, not on an athletics track, suitable for various levels, with a focus on conviviality and good causes.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a popular regional running event held annually at RCN camping Zeewolde. The event has grown in recent years and attracts runners from the region. The run offers a friendly and sporty atmosphere for participants of various levels. Photos and results from previous editions are available via the official Facebook page and the website.
course_highlights: Running in the surroundings of RCN camping Zeewolde
Distances of 1 km, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Start time 11:00 AM for 5 km and 10 km
additional: The 5 km and 10 km races start at 11:00 AM. Photos and results from previous editions are available on the Facebook page and photo page. The 5 km and 10 km races were fully booked in previous editions, with open registration for 1 km and 2 km until 12:00 PM on race day. Held every second Sunday of the month in November, December, January, and February at RCN camping Zeewolde. Four distances: 1 km, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km. Medals for kids and participants who take part in multiple races. Minimum ages vary per distance.

name: Danikerbosloop
description: The Danikerbosloop is an annual running race in Geleen, which will be held for the 19th time in 2027. The race takes place in a wooded area around Daniken and offers distances of 5 km, 5 miles, and 10 miles, suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants. There is also a kids-run of about 1.2 km for children up to 13 years old. The start and finish are at Manege Ten Eysden, where there is also an opportunity for a snack and a drink.
course_highlights: Wooded environment on the outskirts of Geleen
Course with a small warm-up lap followed by 1, 2, or 4 large laps
Start and finish at Manege Ten Eysden
additional: Registration on site can be done from 09:00 at Manege Ten Eysden, cash only. Upon collecting the start number, participants receive two vouchers: one for a drink and one for a piece of Limburg vlaai. Prizes are awarded for the top three in all distances except the Kids-run, where all children receive a prize. Pre-registration is possible online from December 1 until one week before the event, with cash payment on site. Participants receive a drink and Limburg vlaai with their start number. The Kids-run starts at 10:00.

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplas, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasrun is a running series consisting of three races in November, January, and February, held around the beautiful locations of the Zegerplas in Alphen aan den Rijn. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, 15, and 20 km, with special youth distances of 400 and 1000 meters on the athletics track. The course is almost entirely car-free and runs through the Zegersloot area and around the Zegerplas, suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. The start and finish are always at the AAV'36 athletics track, which also offers changing rooms, showers, and a canteen. Official timing is provided via MyLaps, and for the longer distances, there are water stations, with water available at the finish line.
course_highlights: Almost entirely car-free course through the Zegersloot area and around the Zegerplas
Start and finish at the AAV'36 athletics track with changing rooms and showers
Official timing via MyLaps and water stations at longer distances
additional: There is a time limit of 2 hours for the walking distances of 5 and 10 km. Walkers start simultaneously with the 20 km running race. For young runners, there are special distances of 400m and 1000m on the track with free memorabilia. There is a massage area where free massages are offered by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn (bring your own towel). The canteen is open, and limited lockers are available. Runners of 15 and 20 km receive a water station at the start of their second lap on the track. Registration on race day is possible from 9:30 AM in the canteen. The races are held in winter conditions and offer options for walkers and youth, with a maximum time limit of two hours for walking distances.

name: WoolderEsloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voor-inschrijving is alleen mogelijk via de website en sluit op 3 januari 2027.

description: The Woolderes Runs is a traditional running competition that has been organized by MPM in Hengelo for over 45 years. The competition consists of four races spread over the first few months of the year. The distances vary from 1.4 to 15 kilometers, and the course runs through the rural area of Hengelo. Start and finish are at the same location in Woolderes, creating a clear and friendly atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Course through the rural area of Hengelo
Distances of 1.4 km, 5.1 km, 10 km, and 15 km
Start and finish at the same location in Woolderes
additional: Electronic timing. Bib pickup from 9:00 AM on race day or Saturday beforehand. Option to order a T-shirt. Shower facilities at Gymzaal Woolderesweg. Participation at your own risk. Wearing earplugs/headphones is discouraged. The Woolderes Runs consist of four races held every three weeks in the first months of the year. Participants can register for distances of 1.4 km, 5.1 km, 10 km, and 15 km. The organization emphasizes a friendly atmosphere and the course through the rural area of Hengelo.

name: Omloop van Noordwijkerhout
location: Sportpark De Boekhorst, Noordwijkerhout, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The HomeWizard Omloop van Noordwijkerhout is a charming running race held in the beautiful dune area and along the colorful bulb fields around Noordwijkerhout. The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit and offers distances of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon of 21.1 km, as well as a family run of 1 km. The half marathon takes you through forests, dunes, and paved roads, combining nature and sport. The location is Sportpark De Boekhorst, which has facilities such as changing rooms, showers, and a baggage storage. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes who want to enjoy a challenging and varied course.
course_highlights: Half marathon through dunes and blooming bulb fields
5 and 10 km over fully paved roads along colorful bulb fields
Varied course with forest, dunes, and nature
additional: Start and finish at Sportpark De Boekhorst, Noordwijkerhout. There are changing rooms, shower facilities, and a baggage storage available. Parking can be found at various locations nearby, but cycling is preferred. The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit with an attractive final classification and prizes in each category. Course through dunes and bulb fields, registration via the website, start and finish at Sportpark De Boekhorst.

name: Rondje Strand TIEN Cross
price_range: 7 euro voor korte en lange cross, 3 euro voor jeugdcross

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kosten – korte en lange cross 7 euro

description: The Rondje Strand TIEN Cross is the final race of the AV Oss ’78 Cross Competition 2025-2026, held on Sunday, February 28, 2027. The race offers a challenging course with a short cross of approximately 5 km, a long cross of approximately 10 km, and various youth cross distances. The location is Strand TIEN at Gielekespad 10 in Oss, where runners can enjoy a trail course. The start times are 10:00 AM for the short and long crosses and 11:10 AM for the youth cross. The race is accessible to both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Trail course at Strand TIEN in Oss
Short cross of about 5 km and long cross of about 10 km
Special youth cross with various shorter distances
additional: Registration is possible until a maximum of 30 minutes before the race via the registration link. The youth cross starts at 11:10 AM. The race is part of a cross competition with multiple races in Oss and the surrounding area. There is an overall classification for participants who take part in at least four races. Location at Gielekespad 10 in Oss, registration until 30 minutes before the race, course of approximately 5 km and 10 km.

name: Berden Voorjaarsloop
description: The Berden Spring Run in Venlo is a sporting event taking place on Sunday, February 28, 2027. The race offers a wide range of distances, from 500 meters for the very young to 15 kilometers for experienced runners. A special feature is that participants in the 7.5 km and 15 km races run on the professional 400-meter athletics track of Scopias, adding a unique experience. The event is suitable for all ages and levels and provides a fresh and energetic start to spring.
course_highlights: The 7.5 km and 15 km races run on the professional 400-meter athletics track of Scopias
Safe and clear routes along College Den Hulster and Hagerhofweg
Routes through green environments such as the children's farm and Vrijenbroek sports park
additional: Start times vary from 10:40 to 14:05 depending on the distance. There is ample bike parking at College Den Hulster and parking facilities at Fontys. Parents are allowed to run with the youngest participants. There are refreshment stations and a medal for all finishers. Distances range from 500 meters to 15 km, including youth runs and a run on a professional athletics track; registration via inschrijven.nl; event in Venlo.

name: 3bergenLOOP
description: The 3bergenLOOP is a festive running race in Driebergen featuring three challenging courses: 6 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. The routes pass over unpaved forest paths, bike paths, and riding trails through the beautiful estates of Bornia, Heidestein, and Hoog Moersbergen. The race is known for its scenic, tough courses and its focus on sustainability, encouraging participants to use their own reusable cups. The start and finish are at RCN Het Grote Bos, with refreshments along the way and at the finish line. The organization ensures a well-managed event with chip timing and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes over unpaved forest paths, bike paths, and riding trails
Half marathon through estates Bornia, Heidestein, and Hoog Moersbergen
Refreshment stations with water and sports drinks along the route and at the finish
additional: Race bibs will be sent to the provided home address. Start and finish at RCN Het Grote Bos. Refreshments at 9 km, 15 km, and after the finish for the half marathon; at 4 km and after the finish for 10 km; after the finish for 6 km. No medals are awarded. Chip timing by Racetimer is included. Bib exchange is possible via the registration website. Sustainability is promoted through the use of personal reusable cups. Routes have been adjusted due to area restrictions; registration opens early December 2026; options for bib exchange and volunteering are available; environmentally friendly approach with reusable cups and no medals; chip timing included.

name: ACO van Elderen Crossloop
description: The ACO Van Elderen Crossloop is a challenging cross-country race organized by athletics club ACO Van Elderen in Ommen. The race is part of the Prins Sport-Vechtdalcross competition and takes place in the natural area around Ommen. The start is on the athletics track, after which the course mostly runs on unpaved paths through the forest. There are three distances: 1.75 km, 5 km, and 10 km, with participants running one or more laps through the forest. The cross-country race is known for its natural environment and varied course.
course_highlights: Start on the athletics track
Course mostly unpaved through the forest
Three distances with different laps (blue and red)
additional: Registration is only possible online until March 4, 2027; late registration is not possible. During the race, a lead cyclist precedes the runners. For the 5 km and 10 km distances, there are daily prizes for the first three women and men, offered by sponsors. For the youth distance (1.75 km), prizes are awarded to the first three per category. Course runs through forest, unpaved terrain, online registration until 04-03-2027, prizes for top three finishers and course record.

name: Halve Marathon van Haren
description: The RunX Half Marathon of Haren is a spring classic held for the 42nd time on Saturday, March 6, 2027, in Haren, Groningen. The event offers a sporty and friendly day with distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km for recreational runners. The half marathon starts at 11:00 AM and the recreational runs at 11:20 AM. By participating, you support the Youth Fund for Sports & Culture Groningen, which helps children from less privileged families to join sports or cultural clubs.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sporthal Scharlakenhof in Haren
Route through the Felland South industrial area, 1000 meters from the finish
Strict time limit of 2.5 hours for the half marathon
additional: Race numbers will be sent by mail at the end of February 2026. Changes in distance or participant can be submitted online until March 6, 2026, 10:00 PM for a fee of €2.50. Medals are optional and cost an additional €2.50. There is a time limit of 150 minutes for the half marathon. The Road Traffic Act is in effect on the course. Registration opens from October 24, 2026, with various routes for different levels. The event supports the Youth Fund for Sports & Culture Groningen.

name: Rondje Zwolle Marathon
description: Rondje Zwolle 2027 is the second edition of a small-scale marathon around the beautiful city of Zwolle, organized by the Zwolselopers. The marathon emphasizes camaraderie, running together, and enjoyment, without focusing on fast times or personal records. Participants can run the entire marathon or register together and share the distance. Preparatory long runs are organized on weekends for group training. Physiotherapy De Dobbe supports participants to arrive at the start fit and ready.
course_highlights: Marathon around the city of Zwolle
Small-scale and cozy atmosphere
Opportunity to share and alternate the distance together
additional: The marathon is intentionally small-scale with a limited number of starting entries. There are friendly long runs on weekends for preparation. Physiotherapy De Dobbe is a sponsor and offers support for injuries. The start is at Wijthmenerplas. The marathon is characterized by an informal atmosphere and the shared training and running with other participants.

name: 65 van Walcheren
description: The 65 of Walcheren is a challenging ultramarathon of 65 kilometers taking place in Westkapelle. This race, made possible by De Zeeuwse Verzekeringen, is known as the most beautiful and toughest ultramarathon in the region. The route takes participants past the most beautiful spots of Walcheren and is intended for both runners and walkers. The event is organized by dedicated volunteers and supports Stichting Roparun, which funds projects for people with cancer.
course_highlights: 65 kilometer ultramarathon through the most beautiful parts of Walcheren
Running and walking are both possible
Organized with attention to the region and participants
additional: The event is organized for the charitable cause Stichting Roparun. De Zeeuwse Verzekeringen is the title sponsor. Registration is linked to a crowdfunding platform where participants can raise money. There is a special shirt design for 2027. The race is intended for both runners and walkers. The event takes place on March 7, 2027, and attracts participants from the region and beyond. Results from previous years are also available on the website.

name: Fysio 0512 Run Drachten

tiers.description: De kosten zijn € 10,00 euro voor de 10 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De kosten zijn € 9,00 voor de 5 km

tiers.description: De inschrijving voor de bedrijvenloop kost € 75,00 per team

description: The Fysio 0512 Run Drachten is a running event taking place in Drachten, starting and finishing on the athletics track of AV Impala. The 10 km race is the official Open Frisian Championship and is held on a unique, certified course through the beautiful countryside of Drachten. There are also distances of 5 km and a kids run of 1.5 km, making the event suitable for runners of all levels and ages. The race combines sporting challenge with a friendly atmosphere and offers prizes for the best runners and club champions.
course_highlights: 10 km is the official Open Frisian Championship
Certified and fast course through the countryside of Drachten
Start and finish on the athletics track of AV Impala
additional: Number pickup on March 8 from 9:30 AM at the clubhouse of AV Impala. No on-site registration is possible, only online registration until 1 hour before the start. Limited changing and shower facilities are available. Free parking in the immediate vicinity of Sportlaan. Prizes for the best men and women at the Open Frisian Championship 10 km and club champions at 10 km and 5 km (with Impala race shirt). All participants in the 1.5 km kids run receive a reward. There is a running clinic prior to the event for 5 km and 10 km runners, with five training sessions guided by coaches. The course is certified, open to recreational and competitive runners, pre-registration required, no on-site registration.

name: Halve van Oostvoorne
location: Oostvoorne, Voorne aan Zee, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Half of Oostvoorne is a charming running race taking place on Sunday, March 7, 2027, in the lively village center and the picturesque dune area of Oostvoorne. Participants can choose from a half marathon of 21.1 km, a fast 8 km, or youth races of 1 and 2 km. The course is paved and offers a beautiful combination of nature and village surroundings, with excellent facilities such as changing rooms, showers, and parking close to the start. Organized by football club OVV and Voorne Atletiek, it ensures a safe and well-organized day full of sporting fun.
course_highlights: Paved course through the picturesque dune area and village center
Music and activities for spectators create a festive atmosphere
Excellent facilities such as changing rooms, showers, and parking near the start
additional: Youth race 1 km starts at 11:00 AM (up to 11 years old), 2 km starts at 11:15 AM (up to 14 years old). 8 km and half marathon start at 12:00 PM. All participants receive a medal. Minimum age 14 for 8 km and 16 for half marathon. Facilities include unguarded changing rooms, showers, parking, a canteen with drinks, sandwiches, and snacks. Course records for the half marathon: men 01:06:36, women 01:17:41. Parking spaces near the start location with multiple parking options within walking distance. Paved course, facilities such as changing rooms, showers, parking, and open registration.

name: Loopfestein Stein
description: The Stein Running Festival is an annual running race held in Stein, Netherlands. On Sunday, March 7, 2027, the 32nd edition will take place with various distances, including a 5 km and 10 km run, as well as a youth run. The race is supported by local sponsors and offers an athletic and friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages. The routes pass through the beautiful Stein and are suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Routes through the town of Stein with varied terrains
Youth runs with different distances and start times
Night run Woodhenge with atmospheric lighting (separate event)
additional: The youth run starts at 10:00 with different distances depending on birth year. The Woodhenge Night Run is a separate event taking place in June. The organization is supported by various local sponsors. There is a monument My Past in Stein that receives attention during the event. Registration for the 32nd edition is open; terrain and exact registration information are not specifically mentioned.

name: Rondje Goutum
distance_verbose: 30 km, 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km
price_range: Jeugd t/m 15 jaar: € 5,00; 16 Jaar en ouder: € 7,50; 30 km: € 8,50
description: Round Goutum is a running event in Leeuwarden that takes you to the south side of the city. It offers a wide range of distances, from a 1 km Kidsrun to a challenging 30 km, making it an ideal preparation for other races. The distances are precisely measured and all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate after the race. The start and finish are at Atletiekbaan Nijlân, where all distances include a lap around the track upon return.
course_highlights: Precisely measured distances from 1 km to 30 km
Start and finish at Atletiekbaan Nijlân with a lap around the track
Refreshment stations and first aid available, including at the 10 km mark
additional: Start times per distance: 30 km at 10:30, 1 km Kidsrun at 11:00, 16 km at 11:15, 10 km at 11:25, 5 km at 11:35, 2 km at 11:40. Registration only via internet until just before the start, no on-site registration. Routes are available via afstandmeten.nl with GPX, KML, and TCX downloads. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. Participants can only register online. The event takes place at Atletiekbaan Nijlân / Lionitas Middelzeelaan 20 in Leeuwarden.

name: Noordduinloop
description: The Duinloopcircuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast with varied courses combining challenging dune paths and fast beach sections. The races offer a great atmosphere for both avid runners and recreational participants who want to enjoy running outdoors. The Noordduinloop, part of this circuit, takes place on March 13, 2027, and is part of a series of events organized throughout the year.
course_highlights: Varied courses with dune paths and beach sections
Unique running series along the Dutch coast
Suitable for all levels and ages
additional: Classifications are kept for all distances, separately for girls/women and boys/men. The classification is based on the best four results of the circuit. Distances range from 500m to 10 km, including kids runs and classifications based on the four best results.

name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition that has been organized by MPM in Hengelo for over 45 years. The competition consists of four races held throughout the first months of the year, with distances of 1.4 km, 5.1 km, 10 km, and 15 km. The course runs through the countryside of Hengelo, starting and finishing at the same location in Woolderes. The races are accessible to different categories and offer prizes in cash and vouchers. The organization provides electronic timing and there is an opportunity to pick up race numbers in advance or on race day.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside of Hengelo
Start and finish at the same location in Woolderes
Distances of 1.4 km, 5.1 km, 10 km, and 15 km
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 9:00 AM at IKC De Wooldermarke, Semmelweisstraat 46, 7555 NT Hengelo. The race number includes a timing chip and must be worn on the chest. Running shirts and medals are optionally available with pre-registration. Shower and changing facilities are available at Gymzaal Woolderesweg, closing at 1:15 PM. Race numbers can be picked up on Saturday beforehand or on the race day itself. Participants run with the same race number for all four races. The classification is based on at least 3 of the 4 races. Bringing animals, strollers, and using earplugs/headphones is discouraged or not allowed. Registration begins at 9:00 AM, and the courses lead through the countryside of Hengelo. Results from previous years are available, and the event has been organized for over 45 years.

name: Alfa Laval Stevensloop
description: The Alfa Laval Stevensloop is the city run of Nijmegen taking place on March 20, 2027. The start is in the iconic Kronenburgerpark and the finish is in the center of the oldest city in the Netherlands. The various courses offer a varied route through the city center, along the city island, the Nijmegen skyline, and the nature of the Ooijpolder. The race is organized by Stichting Zevenheuvelenloop, which aims to get as many people moving as possible and to provide a great running experience.
course_highlights: Start in Kronenburgerpark and finish at Grote Markt
Climb of Voerweg with the Alfa Laval Cheering Zone
Varied routes through city, nature, and past iconic points such as Stevenskerk and Ooijpolder
additional: There is a supervised cloakroom for small bags at the start in Kronenburgerpark. The Voerweg is a challenging climb at the end of the 5 km and half marathon, with a special Alfa Laval Cheering Zone where spectators and music provide extra encouragement. The Alfa Laval Hill Challenge rewards the fastest climb time on the Voerweg with a €100 gift card at Runnersworld. Registration opens on October 1, 2026, bibs can be collected in March 2027, and the event takes place on March 20 and 21, 2027.

name: Molenloop Vrouwenparochie

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De online verkoop van startkaarten kan tot en met vrijdag 26 december 2025.

description: The Midseumer Molnkoier is a unique evening walk that invites hikers to enjoy nature and culture in and around Vrouwenparochie. This walk is made possible by many volunteers and sponsors, with proceeds going to a good cause. The route passes the old grain mill and through the beautiful Frisian landscape, offering a special experience for lovers of walking and cultural history.
course_highlights: Evening walk along the old grain mill De Vrouwbuurtstermolen
Natural and cultural environment of Vrouwenparochie
Unique atmosphere due to midwinter time and atmospheric route
additional: Start tickets can also be purchased at the start/checkout. The walk is organized at the old grain mill De Vrouwbuurtstermolen in Vrouwenparochie. Registration is possible for multiple distances, and participants can enjoy a course through the beautiful countryside and mill environments.

name: Monnikenloop
description: The Monnikenloop is an annual running race held on the beautiful island of Schiermonnikoog. The event offers various distances, including a kids run, 5 km, 10 km, and 10 English Miles, attracting both recreational and enthusiastic runners. The event combines sportiness with conviviality and invites participants to experience the unique island and its nature. The start and finish are centrally located, and there is ample focus on a festive weekend with accommodation options on the island.
course_highlights: Routes over the island of Schiermonnikoog with nature and dunes
Distances ranging from 1 km kids run to 10 English Miles (16.1 km)
Start and finish in the village with a cozy environment
additional: Start times for kids runs from 11:20 AM, 5 km starts at 12:40 PM, 10 km at 12:50 PM, and 10 English Miles at 12:30 PM. The start package includes a bib with chip and a bus ticket for transportation on the island. Ferry tickets must be reserved separately. There is an option to order a running shirt. Changes to registration are possible for a fee until the end of March. The start and finish are in the village, with facilities for changing and showering. Multiple distances, registration opens from October 1, 2026, accommodation options on the island, event in March.

name: Oldemeijercross
location: Recreatieplas De Oldemeijer, Hardenberg, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Oldemeijercross is one of the oldest running races in the region and is organized annually by AV Spurt'88. The race takes place around recreational lake De Oldemeijer in Hardenberg and offers a challenging course with steep climbs, sand, and mud. The event is a running spectacle for young and old, with start and finish on the event hill near De Oldemeijer. There are multiple spots for spectators to cheer on the runners, contributing to the lively and sporty atmosphere.
course_highlights: Steep climbs in the course
Route around recreational lake De Oldemeijer
Surface with sand and mud
additional: Same-day registration is possible on the day of the race. Start and finish are on the event hill near De Oldemeijer. The course is suitable for all ages and there are multiple points for spectators to cheer on the runners. Course of 3 km around De Oldemeijer, challenging with climbs, sand, and mud; start and finish at the event hill; registration via inschrijven.nl; no showers available.

name: Reeuwijkse Plassenloop
description: The Vosplan Reeuwijkse Plassenloop is one of the oldest running events in the Netherlands and has been organized for over 70 years. The event attracts runners from the region and beyond who enjoy a sporty and friendly day. The course is completely flat and traffic-free, running through Reeuwijkse Hout and along the characteristic Reeuwijkse Plassen, making it an attractive and fast course. There are distances for young and old, from kids runs to 15 kilometers, including guided youth distances.
course_highlights: Fully flat and traffic-free course
Running through Reeuwijkse Hout and along the Reeuwijkse Plassen
Clear kilometer markers and one lap per distance (5, 10, 15 km)
additional: Use of MYLAPS BibTag for time registration, chip attached to the back of the start number and not to be returned. Late registration possible on race day from 10:30 AM until half an hour before the start. Start and finish area at Reeuwijkse Houtwal in the Reeuwijkse Hout recreation area. Ample parking and toilets available. No changing or shower facilities. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal. Cash prizes for 5, 10, and 15 km for men and women, plus an extra prize for course record. Registration opens on January 1, 2027, via Inschrijven.nl. The event offers prizes and souvenirs for the winners, and training sessions are available for preparation. Participants can register for different distances and age groups.

name: Marathon Alblasserwaard 750
description: The Alblasserwaard 750 Marathon is a unique and one-time marathon taking place on March 20, 2027, celebrating 750 years of history of the Alblasserwaard. The 42.195-kilometer route runs from the UNESCO World Heritage site Kinderdijk through characteristic polders, windmills, historic waterways, and villages to the finish at AV Typhoon in Gorinchem. The marathon offers runners a special experience through the open peat meadow landscape and past iconic windmills and duck decoys, with the landscape and history as central themes.
course_highlights: Start at the 19 windmills of Kinderdijk, UNESCO World Heritage
Route over dedicated bike paths and roads with limited traffic
Along historic waterways, polder windmills, and characteristic villages
additional: Shuttle buses are provided between Gorinchem and Kinderdijk for participants. Parking at the start is not available and is discouraged. Bicycle parking is available at the start and finish. The organization aims for sustainability with biodegradable cups and cleaning of the course after the event. Sweep vehicles are available for dropouts. The minimum age for participation is 18 years. The marathon is a unique, one-time event celebrating the history and beauty of the region, with a maximum participant limit of 2,500 runners.

name: Dark Sky Trail Lauwersmeer
location: Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, Lauwersoog, Municipality Noardeast-Fryslân, Friesland, Netherlands
description: The Dark Sky Trail Lauwersmeer is a unique night running and walking event held in the official Dark Sky Park Lauwersmeer, one of the darkest areas in Europe. The race offers three categories: canicross, trail run, and a walking tour, all approximately 10 km long. Participants run in the dark with headlamps only allowed in emergencies, creating a special experience. The registration raises awareness about light pollution with a donation per participant.
course_highlights: Night route in the official Dark Sky Park Lauwersmeer
Approximately 10 km distance for canicross, trail run, and walking tour
Headlamps only allowed in emergencies
additional: Start location and gathering point is Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, De Rug 1, 9976VT Lauwersoog. A drink is available at the finish. The estimated duration is about 1 hour 45 minutes for trail runners and canicrossers, and about 2 hours 45 minutes for walkers. night run, canicross, walking tour, 10 km, start location: Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, Lauwersoog

name: De VoorschotenLoop
description: The VoorschotenLoop is a running race organized by Voorschoten '97 Atletiek, taking place in the beautiful village of Voorschoten. The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit and is accessible to everyone and all levels. The course is fast and passes through the most beautiful spots of the village, with various distances for youth and adults. The longest distance goes through the scenic countryside, including Park Rosenburgh and Landgoed Duivenvoorde. There is also a special Voorschoten Championship for the fastest residents of Voorschoten.
course_highlights: Fast course through the most beautiful spots of Voorschoten
5 km and GeZZinsloop in cozy neighborhoods
10 km and 10 miles through the countryside with Park Rosenburgh and Landgoed Duivenvoorde
additional: The GeZZinsloop is free and starts at 10:15 AM for ages 6-9 and at 10:35 AM for ages 10-12. Start and finish are at Sportpark Adegeest, Weddeloop 6, 2253ST Voorschoten. To participate in the Voorschoten Championship, you must reside in Voorschoten and wear a green dot on your bib, which can be collected beforehand at the clubhouse. Late registration is not possible. Distances range from 1.25 km to 10 miles; registration is possible on March 21; prizes for top participants; championship for residents of Voorschoten; preparation through a beginner's course organized by Voorschoten '97.

name: Moore DRV Halve Westland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De kosten voor deelname aan de halve marathon zijn € 15. Dit is exclusief de aanschaf van de SAW tijdregistratiechip.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De kosten voor deelname aan de 10 km zijn € 12,50. Dit is exclusief de aanschaf van de SAW tijdregistratiechip.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De kosten voor deelname aan de 5 km zijn € 10. Dit is exclusief de aanschaf van de SAW tijdregistratiechip.

description: The Moore DRV Half Westland is a popular half marathon in the Westland, Haaglanden, and Rotterdam region, taking place in Naaldwijk. The race is a nice conclusion to the Olympus '70 Running Project and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The route passes through the polders and along greenhouses, with refreshment stations along the way and a lively start and finish location at the Olympus '70 athletics facility. The half marathon is part of the aaff Summer Run Circuit and offers a varied, fast, and traffic-free course.
course_highlights: Route through polders and along greenhouses in Westland
Refreshment stations at 6.3, 12.7, and 17.5 km with water and sports drinks
Start and finish at Olympus '70 athletics facility with changing rooms and showers
additional: Use of reusable SAW timing chips is mandatory; chips can be ordered for €4.50 upon registration. Bibs can be collected on race day at the Van Dijk Flora indoor hall of Olympus '70. The facility offers spacious changing rooms and showers. First aid is available at 17 km and at the finish. Awards ceremony for various categories. The half marathon is part of the aaff Summer Runcircuit. Registrations for the half marathon are fully booked; the event also includes 10 km, 5 km, and a youth walk.

name: Drents Friese Woldmarathon
description: The Drents Friese Wold Marathon is a challenging marathon held in the beautiful National Park Drents-Friese Wold near Diever. The course consists of loops of over 10 km over paved and semi-paved bike paths and small roads, mostly through forested areas. The marathon has a rich history with fast course records and attracts many runners each year who enjoy the natural surroundings. The start and finish are in Diever, and the organization provides professional chip timing. The marathon is suitable for runners aged 18 and over, with a shorter distance available for youth from 14 years old.
course_highlights: Loops of over 10 km over paved and semi-paved bike paths and small roads
Mostly through the forested environment of National Park Drents-Friese Wold
Start and finish in Diever
additional: Race bib pickup on March 27 from 10:00 to 11:45 at the start location. Registration is also possible on the day itself within the same time frame. Timing is chip-based and attached to the race bib; it is strongly advised to return the bib after finishing. Age restrictions: 18 years for all distances except 10.1 km; 14 years for 10.1 km. Cancellations before March 24 will be refunded the registration fee minus 1 euro administrative fee. Registration is open until March 24; start times vary per distance; age limits according to KNAU guidelines; event promotes sports and nature experience.

name: dun Alve van Ulst

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De kidsrun is van 6 tm 12 jaar (deelname gratis)

description: The Ulst Alve Run is a running race organized by athletics club RKHAV in Hulst. The event offers a half marathon, a quarter marathon, and a kids' run for children aged 6 to 12 years. The kids' run is free and starts around 11:15 AM on the athletics track. The start of the half and quarter marathons is at 11:00 AM. Race numbers can be collected at the RKHAV clubhouse at Willem Alexanderstraat 6 in Hulst.
course_highlights: Half and quarter marathon distances
Kids' run of 1000 meters for children aged 6 to 12 years
Start and finish at athletics club RKHAV in Hulst
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the RKHAV clubhouse at Willem Alexanderstraat 6 in Hulst. The kids' run starts around 11:15 AM on the athletics track and is 1000 meters long. Same-day registration is possible between 09:00 and 10:00 AM at the late registration fee. Registration is open, with details about deadlines and start times; location at Willem Alexanderstraat 6, Hulst.

name: Emmy Run
location: Cafetaria Lunchroom Emmy, Slagharen, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Emmy Run in Slagharen is a fun and accessible running event for young and old, with distances ranging from 1 to 10 kilometers. The race takes place around Cafetaria Lunchroom Emmy and offers something for everyone, from the Kidsrun to a corporate and club run. The event focuses on fun and exercising together, without prize money but with nice tokens for all participants. Afterwards, there is a modest afterparty in the special Emmy tent on the church square.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Cafetaria Lunchroom Emmy
Distances of 1, 2.5, 5, and 10 kilometers
Route through Slagharen with enthusiastic spectators
additional: There is a guarded baggage deposit available at Haarslag, the museum building behind ’t Oale Meestershuus. There are no showers, but toilet facilities are available next to the Emmy tent. Registration opens soon and the number of participants is limited to 500. There is official time registration and all participants receive a token. There is a special Emmy Award and an afterparty in the Emmy tent on the church square. The event is characterized by a friendly atmosphere, with various running categories and a broad audience. The first edition was successful and the organization aims for an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Hollen door de Bollen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De inschrijfkosten bedragen € 14,- per persoon (minimaal 5 personen per team).

description: Hollen door de Bollen is an annual running and walking event in the beautiful Bollenstreek around Lisse, organized by Stichting Team Bollenstreek in collaboration with AV De Spartaan. The proceeds of the event go entirely to Stichting Roparun, which supports palliative care for cancer patients. The routes vary from short children's runs to 30 km walks, with music and entertainment along the way and a festive finish. The event emphasizes participation for the good cause over competition, without official timing.
course_highlights: Walking routes of 6.5 km, 10 km, 21 km, and 30 km through the Bollenstreek
Running distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 10 miles
Music and entertainment along the route and a celebratory finish
additional: Start location is AV De Spartaan, Spekkelaan 8 in Lisse. There are various start times for walking and running distances, starting from 07:30 AM. Participation is personal with a personal start number, no refunds in case of cancellation. Safety vests are recommended on parts of the walking routes over public roads. There is a special Shirt Action where participants can earn a free anniversary shirt by recruiting sponsors. Routes range from 4.6 km to over 30 km, with pre-registration, option to pick up start number and shirt, volunteers and sponsors are welcome.

name: Culemborg City Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis inschrijving voor scholen tot 31 oktober

description: The Culemborg City Run is an annual running event in Culemborg featuring various distances for individual runners as well as schools and companies. The race offers a diverse course with distances of 400 meters, 1, 3, 5, and 10 kilometers, suitable for all ages and levels. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the involvement of the local community. The City Run encourages sportsmanship and camaraderie in a beautiful urban environment.
course_highlights: Course through the center of Culemborg
Distances ranging from 400 meters to 10 kilometers
Specific routes for schools and companies
additional: There are separate categories for schools and companies. The Roll Run is a special 400-meter race. The event features a varied program with different start times for each distance. Attention is given to accessibility and facilities for participants. The event also includes school runs and corporate runs, with historical results and sponsors. It is an annual event that brings the community together.

name: De Wielenloop
location: De Groote Wielen, Rosmalen, North Brabant, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld € 5,- betaal je contant of met pin.

description: The Wielenloop is an annual running event held on Easter Monday in De Groote Wielen, Rosmalen. The event is suitable for young and old with various distances, including a kids run, 5 km, and 10 km. The routes feature varied terrain and are accessible for both beginner and experienced runners. The atmosphere is friendly, and there is space for family and supporters along the route.
course_highlights: 10 km route consists of two laps of the 5 km route
Varied terrain suitable for experienced runners
Kids run for the youngest runners, participation is free
additional: Registration is possible until the day of the run, on Monday morning at the start. The kids run is free. The 5 km and 10 km start at 10:30 AM. There is a warm-up beforehand, and family members can run along with the kids run. On-site registration is possible; the start time is around 10:30 AM; the routes will be announced soon.

name: Drie Molenloop Aarlanderveen
description: The Drie Molenloop Aarlanderveen is a traditional race and performance run held for the 60th time on Easter Monday, March 29, 2027. The race offers various distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Participants run through the beautiful polder areas around Aarlanderveen and receive a medal at the finish. A portion of the proceeds goes to a local charity, this year the playground.
course_highlights: All distances take place on paved roads around and through the Aarlanderveen polder
Water stations halfway through the course and at the finish
Kilometer points are marked on the course and there is a continuous clock
additional: Start numbers are not sent in advance but can be collected on March 29 at the Dorpshuis during late registration. Time registration is done with MYLAPS BibTag on the start numbers. Parking and changing and shower facilities are available at the sports hall on Aarlanderveenseweg. Parking space is limited; cycling is recommended. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 15 km; children's run; proceeds go to a charity (playground); location in Aarlanderveen; organized by AAV'36.

name: Klap tot Klaploop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijfgelden voorinschrijving Deelname 5 km en 10 km (vanaf 18 jaar): € 15,-

description: The Klap tot Klaploop is a unique running race without laps, where you are transported by bus to the start in Musselkanaal and run back in one go to the center of Stadskanaal. The flat and fast course is ideal for setting a personal record, while the enthusiastic crowd and lively atmosphere along the route create a special experience. On Easter Monday, March 29, 2027, the 35th edition takes place, a day full of sportiness, challenge, and fun for everyone.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course from Musselkanaal to Stadskanaal
No laps, but a real route
Crowd and atmosphere along the route create a unique experience
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the Saturday before Easter from 10:00 to 14:00 at De Jonge Sport in Stadskanaal or on the day itself until 11:30 at the organizer’s tent. Free bus transportation is available from Europalaan in Stadskanaal to the start locations in Musselkanaal for 5 km and 10 km runners. Wheelchair users and handbikers are responsible for their own transportation. There are clothing wagons and mobile toilets at the start locations. No shower facilities are available. Start in Musselkanaal, finish in Stadskanaal, no transportation from Stadskanaal to start locations, event supported by local businesses and has a long history with the 32nd edition in 2027.

name: Paaspolderloop
description: The Paaspolderloop in Nieuwe Niedorp is a charming running event taking place on Easter Monday. The race passes through the beautiful polder with various distances for young and old, including a 250-meter run for the very young, and challenging 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km routes. The 10 km is accessible for participants aged 16 and older and features a varied course with fields, bridges, and a nostalgic section through the Village Street. The organization ensures a friendly atmosphere with a large prize pool and a quick award ceremony afterwards.
course_highlights: Beautiful green fields and sheep paths
Various bridges on the course
Nostalgic Village Street of Nieuwe Niedorp
additional: Start numbers can be collected at Dorpshuis De Prins Maurits. Parking is available at the Nieuwe Niedorp Shopping Center, within a 900-meter walk. There are no changing rooms or showers available, but toilets are available at the Village Hall. First aid is present at the start/finish. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The event starts at 9:30 AM on Easter Monday, with registration from January and parking at Winkelhart. In addition to the run, there are also fun activities for children.

name: 10 Mijl van Zwolle-Zuid
description: The 10 Miles of Zwolle-Zuid is an annual running event with three distances: Kidsrun, 5 Miles, and 10 Miles. The routes pass through the residential area Zwolle-Zuid and the beautiful countryside near the IJssel, with start and finish at Wijkcentrum SIO. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization, attracting both recreational and enthusiastic runners. The 10 Miles of Zwolle-Zuid is a great challenge for runners who want to enjoy a varied course in a green environment.
course_highlights: Course through residential area Zwolle-Zuid and countryside near the IJssel
5 Miles route of 8047 meters starting at 17:00
10 Miles route of 16093 meters, passing Harculo
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Lopers Company, Gasthuisplein 2 from Wednesday, April 9 to Friday, April 11 during opening hours, and on Saturday, April 12 from 12:00 to 16:30 at Wijkcentrum SIO on Thorbeckelaan 2. The 10 Miles of Zwolle-Zuid is not an official race organized by the Atletiek Unie. Minimum age is 14 years for 5 Miles and 17 years for 10 Miles. Race number must be visibly worn. The course is not suitable for wheelchair users or wheeler. Distances: Kidsrun, 5 Miles, 10 Miles; registration from January; support for good causes; location in Zwolle-Zuid.

name: 2Bruggenloop
description: The Ned Air 2Bruggenloop in Kampen is a charming running event with start and finish in the heart of the city. The routes cross two iconic bridges, the Stadsbrug and the Molenbrug, offering beautiful views of the historic city front and the water-rich nature along the IJssel. The half marathon and 10 kilometers are certified and challenging, including a climb on the Molenbrug. There is a special Kidsrun through the city center for children. After finishing, participants can relax in the lively Kampen city center during the Night of Kampen.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the atmospheric Oudestraat in the heart of Kampen
Crossing the impressive Stadsbrug with golden wheels and the 600-meter-long Molenbrug with a height of 21 meters
Beautiful views of the iconic city front and water-rich river nature along the IJssel
additional: Start groups are divided based on expected running time (Red, Purple, Yellow) to ensure smooth flow. The start and finish area is on Van Heutszplein. Race numbers can be collected on Friday evening before the race. Lockers are available to securely store belongings. Merchandise such as hoodies, socks, and shirts is available for purchase. The Kidsrun has separate start times: 13:00 for ages 4-9 and 13:15 for ages 10-12. After the race, there is an opportunity to relax in the city center during the Night of Kampen (band evening). The event also offers a Kidsrun and Businessrun, and has a strong local reputation as one of the most enjoyable running events in Kampen and the surrounding area.

name: Rondje Zegveld
description: Rondje Zegveld is a running event in the heart of Zegveld, where participants can choose from a Kidsrun of 1.5 km, a 5 km or a 10 km route through the beautiful polder of the Green Heart. The time is electronically measured and results are available online afterwards. The event is accessible to all ages and offers a friendly and sporty atmosphere. There is also the possibility of late registration on the day itself until half an hour before the start of the race.
course_highlights: Run through the polder of the Green Heart
Kidsrun of 1.5 km through the village center of Zegveld
Water station after approximately 5 km on the 10 km route
additional: Late registration is possible on the day itself until 30 minutes before the start of the race, subject to availability. The award ceremony is expected around 15:15 - 15:30 hours. Traffic measures and temporary road closures will be in place in and around the village during the event. First aiders are present along the route and at the finish. Photos and videos will be taken for promotional purposes. The event on April 3, 2027, offers a great opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners to explore the surroundings and participate in a local running event.

name: Woest Lochemsebergloop
description: The WOEST Lochemsebergloop is a fun running race in Barchem, with distances for both children and adults. The kids run is specifically for children up to 16 years old with a distance of 1000 meters, while adults can choose from 5 km running or power walking and 10 km running. The race takes place in a beautiful natural environment with attention to preserving nature. There is a refreshment station and waste zone along the route, and parking is well arranged at Bon Aparte. The organization is ready to answer questions via email and ensures a sporty and accessible atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances for children (1000m) and adults (5 km and 10 km)
Refreshment station and waste zone along the route to keep nature clean
Start and finish near parking lot Bon Aparte in Barchem
additional: Parking and bike storage at parking lot Bon Aparte. Toilets available at Bon Aparte. No changing or shower facilities at start/finish. Refreshment station and waste zone along the route. Start times per distance: kids run at 13:00 and 13:01, 5 km at 13:30, 10 km at 14:30. Trail run with various distances, location in Barchem, parking at Bon Aparte, no changing rooms or showers available.

name: Drutenloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Drutenloop is a sporting event taking place in the atmospheric center and on the beautiful dikes of Druten. The event offers various categories for young and old, including youth runs, short distances, a 10-kilometer run, and a half marathon. Since 2026, there are also new categories such as the Crossfit fitness race and the Bendefit nature walk. The Drutenloop is known for its connecting character and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Beautiful route over the Waalbandijk and through the center of Druten
Various distances from 500 meters youth run to half marathon (21.1 km)
New since 2026: Crossfit fitness race and Bendefit nature walk
additional: Start numbers are mandatory and include a BIB-tag for timing registration. Pick up your start number on Saturday, April 11 from 15:00-18:00 at the clubhouse and on Sunday, April 12 until half an hour before the race at the information point on the Market. There is a first aid post at the start/finish and first aid personnel ride along on bicycles. The top three boys and girls per age category are awarded. All 500m and 1 km runners receive a medal at the finish. The event is actively promoted via social media, with updates and results on Facebook and Instagram.

name: Gemert City Run
location: Het centrum van Gemert, Noord-Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Gemert City Run is a lively running event in the historic center of Gemert, where runners of all levels come together for a day full of energy and fun. With distances ranging from Kids Runs to 15 km and a relay race, there is a suitable challenge for everyone. The route passes iconic locations such as the castle and the Ridderplein, with start and finish in the vibrant center. After the finish, participants toast to their achievements, giving the day a festive character.
course_highlights: Route through the historic center of Gemert
Along the Castle of Gemert and St. Janskerk
Start and finish at the lively Ridderplein
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 09:30 in the Town Hall. Late registration is possible until 30 minutes before the start of the race, with payment in cash or by PIN. There is a Business Run and a relay race (4x 700m laps). The program includes multiple start times for different distances and a festive ceremony afterwards. Participants can choose from various distances, with special Kids Runs for children. The event promotes sport, fun, and community involvement.

name: Halve van Den Helder
description: The Half of Den Helder is a unique event where you can experience the city of Den Helder in a special way, both on foot and by running. The course passes along the coast, forts, the iconic lighthouse De Lange Jaap, the Marsdiep, and the Helderse Zeedijk, with surprising locations that are normally closed to the public. This event combines sport with cultural history and nature, providing participants with a versatile experience. The walking event takes place on Saturday, April 3, 2027, and the running races on Sunday, April 4, 2027.
course_highlights: Along the coast and the Marsdiep
Past forts and lighthouse De Lange Jaap
Visit to normally closed, surprising locations
additional: Walking takes place on Saturday, April 3, 2027, running on Sunday, April 4, 2027. There are various distances for running: 21 km, 10 km, and 4 km. There is also a corporate run and kids run. Registration for edition 15 in 2027 is currently closed and will reopen in September. Distances: 21 km, 10 km, 4 km; course along coast, forts, lighthouse, and cultural-historical locations; event on April 3 and 4, 2027.

name: Marathon Amersfoort
description: Marathon Amersfoort is a sporty and festive running event taking place in the city of Amersfoort. The event offers various distances for all levels, including a marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, mini marathons, and walking distances. The marathon is held in early spring to ensure favorable weather conditions. Along the course, there is a varied music program to support and encourage runners and spectators.
course_highlights: Diverse distances from 1.1 km mini marathon to 42.2 km marathon
Music along the course with 20 DJs, brass bands, and samba bands
Start and finish in the center of Amersfoort with festive support
additional: On Saturday, there is a training marathon of 42.2 km starting at 8:30 AM. On Sunday, there are runs of 5, 10, and 21 km, various walking distances, and mini marathons for primary school children. The organizers ask participants and spectators to come as much as possible by bike or on foot. Parking is available in the Eemplein and Oppidium parking garages. From Amersfoort Central Station, it is about a 10-minute walk to the event. Participants can register from November 1; the event also includes walking routes and a training run on May 30; the race is organized in cooperation with the municipality of Amersfoort and features different course options.

name: Stoomtramloop
description: The Steam Tram Run is a unique and recreational running experience where participants travel from Medemblik to Opperdoes or Twisk by a historic steam tram. Participants then run back to Medemblik over a distance of 5 or 10 kilometers, with the event primarily focused on fun and experience. Due to the different start and finish locations, exact timing is not possible, and every participant is considered a winner. The run takes place on the first Sunday of April and offers a special combination of sport and history.
course_highlights: 5 km route from Opperdoes station to Medemblik
10 km route from Twisk station via Opperdoes to Medemblik
Transport by historic steam tram from Medemblik to start locations
additional: Maximum of 500 participants, evenly divided between the 5 km and 10 km distances. Registration includes transportation by steam tram and a unique running shirt. Time limit of 45 minutes for 5 km and 90 minutes for 10 km. There is a water station at Opperdoes station. Traffic controllers are present at intersections. Small chance of waiting at level crossings. Included in the participation are a running shirt and steam tram transport. The event is limited to 500 participants and is characterized by a friendly, non-competitive atmosphere.

name: Reakt-Brijderloop
location: Atletiekvereniging Hylas, Alkmaar, North Holland, Netherlands
price_range: Prestatieloop 5/10 km: € 10,00; Kidsrun: € 5,00; op de dag zelf: Prestatieloop € 15,00; Kidsrun € 10,00
description: The Reakt-Brijderloop is a recreational race in Alkmaar, specially organized for people with a history of addiction, psychological vulnerabilities, and anyone who enjoys running. The race consists of a competitive run of 5 or 10 kilometers and a kids' run with three distances. The start and finish are at Atletiekvereniging Hylas. The race supports recovery through movement and has a long tradition of 26 years.
course_highlights: Competitive run of 5 and 10 kilometers
Kids' run in three categories: 400m, 800m, and 1200m
Start and finish at AV Hylas in Alkmaar
additional: Pre-registration includes a start number with your own name. The race is inclusive of participants with physical disabilities and G-sporters. Same-day registration is possible at a higher price. Participants can register until March 15; the kids' runs range from 400m to 1200m; the event promotes recovery and self-confidence among participants.

name: 4 Mijl van AvK
description: The 4 Miles of AvK is a running event over a distance of 6.4 kilometers taking place in the unique peat colony area of Annerveenschekanaal. The route passes along and through this special landscape, giving the run a characteristic and atmospheric character. The event attracts runners who enjoy a challenging and beautiful running environment.
course_highlights: 6.4 km running route
Along and through the peat colony area
Unique nature and landscape
additional: The event is popular among local runners and offers a nice opportunity to run in a special environment. No specific information about registration costs is available.

name: Halve van Nijkerk
description: The Bouw Logistics Half Marathon of Nijkerk is a sporting event taking place in the center of Nijkerk. Participants can choose from various distances, including the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, KidsRun, and walking routes of 10, 15, and 20 km. The course runs through and around the city with a legendary finish at ’t Plein. The atmosphere is fantastic with many spectators along the route and a festive ambiance for all ages and levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the center of Nijkerk, at Molenplein and ’t Plein
Walking routes of 10, 15, and 20 km through and around Nijkerk
Legendary finish at ’t Plein with many spectators
additional: Start times: 3:00 PM for walking (10, 15, 20 km), 4:30 PM KidsRun, 4:45 PM half marathon, 5:00 PM 5 km, 6:45 PM 10 km. Start and finish are approximately 300 meters apart. There are changing rooms at the start area (Molenplein) which close at 8:15 PM. Every finisher receives a unique medal. Registration is possible until the day itself, unless sold out. BusinessRun for teams of companies with 5 participants per team on 5 km, 10 km, or half marathon. The event involves a half marathon and attracts runners from the region and beyond.

name: Cruyff Legacy 14K
description: The Cruyff Legacy 14K is an annual running and walking event held at the Johan Cruyff ArenA in Amsterdam. The event brings together thousands of participants to support the Johan Cruyff Foundation, which creates sports opportunities for children with disabilities. The 2026 edition was a great success with over 8,000 participants and an impressive amount raised. The next edition will take place on Sunday, April 11, 2027, a special day focused on sports and social involvement.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Johan Cruyff ArenA in Amsterdam
Running and walking through the city
Event with a social mission for children with disabilities
additional: The Cruyff Legacy 14K is an event that raises awareness for sports for children with disabilities. It is supported by main sponsors such as AFC Ajax, OTTO Work Force, PWC, and Basic-Fit. The 2026 edition raised €851,639. The organization invites participants to join this social sports day. Race in Amsterdam, scheduled for 11 April 2027; supports sports for children with disabilities; participants can choose between running and walking.

name: De Oude Weideloop
description: The Old Weideloop is a running event in Wagenberg suitable for young and old. There are four distances: a family run of 1 and 2 km, and the 5 km and 10 km, with the 10 km consisting of two laps of the 5 km course. The start and finish are at Van Elsenplein, and the course runs through various streets of Wagenberg. During the event, there is musical support and time registration, and prizes are awarded to the best men and women in all categories.
course_highlights: Family run of 1 and 2 km, suitable for all ages
5 km course through various streets of Wagenberg
10 km consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Start/finish at Van Elsenplein in Wagenberg. Changing rooms and a caregiver at sports fields. First aid stations along the route. Information point opens at 11:00 AM for bib and T-shirt pickup. Grandfathers, grandmothers, or parents can run for free with their (grand)children during the family run. Time registration via Startnummerexpress. Musical support during the run. Prizes for the top three men and women in all categories. Registration is through the official website, and the event is aimed at residents of the municipality of Drimmelen.

name: Enschede Marathon
