distance_verbose: Marathon, Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Enschede Marathon, the oldest marathon in the Netherlands and Western Europe, takes place on April 11, 2027, in Enschede. The event offers a fast course with optimal care, lots of music, and tens of thousands of enthusiastic supporters. In addition to the full marathon, there is also a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and various kids runs. The marathon supports KWF Kankerbestrijding with the 'Run Against Cancer' campaign, encouraging participants to collect donations.
course_highlights: Fast course in Enschede with start and finish on Boulevard 1945
Optimal care and lots of music along the course
Tens of thousands of supporters create a lively atmosphere
additional: Race numbers can be collected on Saturday, April 10 from 10:00 to 16:00 and on Sunday, April 11 from 07:30 at the registration desk Connect-U in Enschede. There is an option to have the race number sent by mail within the Netherlands for an additional fee of €5. The marathon features a Club Challenge where clubs can compete for prizes. There are various categories for men and women, and a special 'Run Against Cancer' action where participants can receive a free start number by collecting at least €500 in donations. Multiple distances including marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and kids run; registration discounts; charity support; electronic timing; race since 1947.

name: Halve van Helmond
description: The Half of Helmond is a lively running and walking event held annually in Helmond and Stiphout. The main distance is the half marathon, which consists of two laps of 10.55 km over a fully paved course with start and finish in the center of Brandevoort. Additionally, there are shorter running distances of 10 km and 5 km, a corporate run, a kids run, and a unique 2.5 km run, ensuring there is a suitable distance for everyone. The event is known for its festive organization, beautiful routes along sports parks, and an athletic experience for both competitive runners and recreational participants.
course_highlights: Half marathon consists of 2 laps of 10.55 km over a fully paved course
Start and finish in the shopping center of Brandevoort
Refreshment stations every 2.5 km and passage along sports parks of local athletics clubs
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day at wijkhuis ’t BrandPunt in Helmond (Brandevoort). There is a guarded cloakroom and changing rooms available. For the running events, a limited number of starting permits are available for late registration, full = full. The half marathon has a maximum time limit of 3 hours; participants who need to start the second lap after 1 hour and 30 minutes will be disqualified. Running shirts can be ordered free of charge upon registration while supplies last. Pickup of race numbers on April 11 and 12, route information and times will be shared online, event in Helmond and Stiphout.

name: IJsselloop
price_range: € 35,00 voor het loopshirt, andere prijzen niet vermeld
description: The IJsselloop in Deventer is the largest running event in the city and takes place annually on the second Sunday of April. With over 9,000 participants and a unique atmosphere along the IJssel, the race offers suitable distances for everyone, from recreational runners to competitive athletes. The course runs past iconic bridges and the river, finishing at the beautiful Brink square. The organization, supported by many volunteers and AV Daventria 1906, encourages participation for young and old, where taking part is more important than winning.
course_highlights: Unique course along the IJssel with views of the river
Passage over the Wilhelminabrug and railway bridge in Deventer
Finish at the most beautiful square in the Netherlands, the Brink
additional: Ample time limits per distance: 5 km and kidsrun without limit, 10 km within 1.5 hours, 15 km within 2 hours. Late registration possible for G-loop and kidsrun on the day itself. Prize giving for 5 km at 15:30, and for 10 km at 14:45 in the kazernetuin (Boreel, Houtmarkt). Bib with time registration and refreshments along the route and at the finish. Clinics and training opportunities via AV Daventria 1906. Distances range from kidsrun to 15 km, registration from October 25, 2025, to March 21, 2026, with limits for some distances. Start and finish in Deventer, with options for clinics to prepare.

name: Middelseeloop
price_range: Kidsrun gratis, 2,5 km € 3,50, 5 km € 5,00, 10 km € 7,50, medaille toeslag € 3,00
description: The Middelseeloop is a fun running race in Leeuwarden taking place in the Middelsee and De Zuidlanden neighborhoods. The race offers five different distances, including a kids' run of 1 kilometer, and routes of 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 12.5 km for walkers. The event is suitable for anyone who loves running or wants to get to know the neighborhood better. Around the start and finish locations, there are activities for children all day long, and after the race, all participants are offered an ice cream.
course_highlights: Routes through the neighborhoods Middelsee and De Zuidlanden
Five distances: 1 km kids' run, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 12.5 km walking
Start and finish at IKC Middelsee, Felling 2, 8912 CG Leeuwarden
additional: Register before March 16 to have your name printed on the race bib. There are all-day activities for children at the start-finish location, such as a climbing wall, football dartboard, stilt walkers, and Circus Saranti. There is a surprise for walkers along the route. After the race, all participants receive an ice cream from Diana’s Ices Palace, made possible by Zwanenburg. Distances are available for children, adults, and walkers; registration is open until April 11, 2027; start and finish at IKC Middelsee; participants can enjoy an ice cream after the race.

name: Singelloop Leiden
description: The Singelloop Leiden is a festive running event that takes place annually in the center of Leiden. The race starts and finishes at Lammermarkt, near Molen de Valk, and takes participants along a challenging course past the Leiden canals. With a distance of approximately 6.5 kilometers, it is an accessible run for both recreational and competitive runners. The organization is managed by the Stichting Singelloop Leiden, which continues a long tradition of sport and community in the city.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lammermarkt, next to Molen de Valk
Course of about 6.5 km along the Leiden canals and historic bridges
Run counterclockwise via Valkbrug, Rijnsburgersingel, Morspoort, and Witte Singel
additional: Race numbers are available for purchase at various pre-sale locations from March 20 to April 15 for 7.50 euros. On race day (April 16), the race number costs 8.50 euros and can be obtained at petit-restaurant De Valk. Participants receive a medal after the race upon showing their race number. The race is held over a course of approximately 6.5 to 7 km, with registration possible via the website. The 2027 edition is scheduled for April 16 at 19:30.

name: Amerongse Koploop
distance_verbose: 25 km, 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1500 meter, 0.75 km
description: The Amerongse Koploop is a fun and challenging trail run through the forests of National Park Utrechtse Heuvelrug between Amerongen and Leersum. The event offers various distances for both youth and adults, including kids runs, trail runs, and hikes. A portion of the registration fee goes to nature conservation, and participants receive a token for local refreshments. After the race, all participants receive a sustainable medal, and there is a lively square at the start and finish to relax and enjoy.
course_highlights: Trail through the forests of National Park Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Distances ranging from 750 meters for children to 25 km trail run
Lively square with local specialties and included refreshment token
additional: Pre-registration closes on Thursday, April 16. Same-day registration is possible with additional administrative costs at the registration desk. Bib numbers can be collected on Friday evening in advance. Electronic timing is used, so there is no rush at the start. Trail and walk distances vary; registration is available both beforehand and on the day; location at Nuytgroep, Amerongen; local amenities such as beer, coffee, and fries; medal and electronic timing.

name: Cascaderun
description: The Hoogeveense Cascaderun is an annual running race in the center of Hoogeveen, known as the biggest and most fun run in Drenthe. The race offers a flat and fast course over 5 and 10 miles, ideal for both fast times and first-time runners. With thousands of enthusiastic participants, lots of spectators, live music along the route, and an iconic finish in the Hoofdstraat, it is a lively event for all levels. Additionally, there are special events such as the DuoRun, UNICEF Children's Run, and the Giga-G for athletes with disabilities.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course through the center of Hoogeveen
Officially measured 5 and 10 miles with lots of spectators
Iconic finish in the Hoofdstraat with live music and refreshments
additional: Race bib and shirt pickup can be done on Saturday, April 10, 2027 from 09:00 to 16:00 at Het Klooster and on Sunday, April 18, 2027 from 10:00 to 12:30 at De Tamboer. There is official chip timing, refreshments along the route and after the finish, and professional finish photos are available for free download. The Cascaderun awards a medal every 5 years, next time in 2028. Starting groups are on the Raadhuisplein and are indicated with letters on the race bib. There are separate counters for the 5-mile, 10-mile, and UNICEF Children's Run. Water stations are available en route (5 miles: 5 stations, 10 miles: 7 stations) and toilets are located at the start and along the route. The first kilometers can be crowded; runners are advised to keep to the right and overtake on the left. Registration opens in November 2026, with starting groups on Raadhuisplein, water points and refreshments along the route, official chip timing, and a festive afterparty.

name: PCC Maalwater Run
description: The PCC Maalwater Run and Walk in Heiloo offers a varied running and walking program with distances for young and old. The start and finish are located at the PCC and Trias grounds, where a bouncy castle is also available for children. By participating, you support the Sport@School project of the Sport Council Heiloo, which makes sports lessons at primary schools possible. The event is accessible to both recreational walkers and runners with various distance options.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the PCC and Trias grounds
Distances range from 1 km to 16 km for walking and running
Bouncy castle for children on the central area of the athletics track
additional: Children can play under supervision on a bouncy castle during the event. Participants support the Sport@School project of the Sport Council Heiloo, which enables sports lessons at primary schools. Start and finish at the PCC and Trias grounds in Heiloo, with activities for the whole family.

name: Wetter- en Wille Run
location: Wetter- en Willepark, Burgum, Friesland, Netherlands
description: The Wetter- en Willerun is a performance run through and around the beautiful Wetter- en Willepark in Burgum, with distances of 5 km and 10.5 km (quarter marathon). The run attracts enthusiastic runners and supports a local charity, with proceeds contributing to the community and promoting a healthy lifestyle. In addition to the performance runs, there is also an ‘Elf Cities’ sponsorship walk and a new 25 km route. The event is known for its scenic course and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful Wetter- en Willepark in Burgum
Distances of 5 km, 10.5 km (quarter marathon), and a new 25 km course
Includes ‘Elf Cities’ sponsorship walk prior to the performance run
additional: The proceeds from the run go to a local charity. A new 25 km distance has been added. The run is an annual event with a large group of enthusiastic participants and has sold out in previous years. Routes of 5 km and 10.5 km, ‘Elf Cities’ sponsorship walk, proceeds go to local charities, held in Wetter- en Willepark.

name: Ride & Roast
location: Fort aan de Klop, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: Run & Roast Utrecht is a cozy running event taking place at Fort aan de Klop. Participants can choose between a 5 or 10 kilometer route, which is flat and fast with a finish at a beautiful location. After the race, there is a friendly social gathering with music, drinks, and a delicious plant-based burger from Beyond Meat, ideal for quick recovery. There is also a kids' run of 1 kilometer for the youngest runners. The event combines sport with a summery, relaxed atmosphere.
course_highlights: Flat and fast loop with finish at Fort aan de Klop
Beautiful location on an island in north Utrecht
Kids' run of about 1 kilometer for children up to 12 years old
additional: Start numbers can be collected from 13:15 on race day or in advance between April 13 and 16 at All4running Store Utrecht. There is no guarded cloakroom; bikes can be parked in a temporary storage. Timing is done with a chip on the start number, which can be recycled after use. Prizes are awarded for the kids' run and main distances. After the race, a Beyond Meat Burger (plant-based) and drinks are available. Partners include All4running, Karhu, Virtuoos supplements, Shokz headphones, and Runbites sports nutrition. Flat course, registration in advance and on race day, post-race food and drinks, kids' run, prizes for winners, discount offers for participants.

name: Mûzelloop Jirnsum
description: The Mûzelloop Jirnsum is a friendly running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the small river Mûzel in Jirnsum. The routes pass by historic and natural sights such as the old lower course of the river Boarn and the Sneker Oudvaart. The race features various distances, including a kids run and distances of 5, 8.3, and 10 km, with refreshment stations along the way. The event is organized by a foundation with the help of volunteers and sponsors and has a warm local atmosphere with prizes for the best participants and special cups for the best Jirnsummers.
course_highlights: Routes along the small river Mûzel and the old lower course of river Boarn
Refreshment stations at 8.3 and 10 km, finish line refreshments for 5 km
Historic environment including the Jirnsummersyl lock and connection to the Sneker Oudvaart
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 6:00 PM in the large hall of the 2 Gemeenten. There are no shower facilities available. Parking is ample nearby at the 2 Gemeenten opposite the broadcasting mast on Rijksweg. The routes are marked with arrows and chalk signs, and traffic controllers are present at bottlenecks. All children receive a nice souvenir. Prizes are awarded to the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place in each distance, and special cups are given to the best Jirnsummers. There is a limit of 300 participants, and only online pre-registration is possible. The event takes place in April 2027, with distances for kids and adults, offering a beautiful natural environment for runners.

name: Rondje Vrachelen
location: Atletiekbaan ATV Scorpio, Vrachelen, Oosterhout, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Vrachelen Round is a fun and sporty evening run in the nature of Oosterhout, starting and finishing at the athletics track of ATV Scorpio. Participants run on a varied course with both paved and unpaved paths through the beautiful surroundings of Vrachelen. The run is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners, with two distances of 6 km and 10 km. Facilities such as changing rooms, showers, and first aid are available, and there is ample parking nearby.
course_highlights: Varied course with paved and unpaved paths
Start and finish at the athletics track of ATV Scorpio
Running through the nature of Vrachelen in Oosterhout
additional: Registration is possible from December 1, 2026, until half an hour before the start of the race, only online. There is sufficient parking at Zwembad de Warande and football club TSC. Shower facilities are available after the race. An AED is present for emergencies. Participation is at your own risk. Registration opens on December 1, 2026, with a start time at 19:30, and the event is held in the vicinity of Wilhelminakanaal Zuid 78, Oosterhout.

name: Night Run Wageningen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld van € 85 is inclusief 11 groepstrainingen, loopshirt, startbewijs voor deze wedstrijd en een herinnering bij de finish

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Natuurlijk is het ook mogelijk om zonder Start to run cursus deel te nemen aan deze wedstrijd

description: The Night Run Wageningen is a atmospheric running event taking place in the center of Wageningen, with start and finish at the Market Square. Participants run in the dark under atmospheric lighting and conquer the challenging Wageningen Hill via Holleweg. There are various distances, including a kids run, a 5 km run, and an adventurous 10 km run. For beginners, there is a Start to Run course culminating in participation in the 5 km. The event is accessible for all ages and levels and offers a cozy and sporty evening in Wageningen.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Market Square in the center of Wageningen
Climbing the Wageningen Hill via Holleweg
Atmospheric lighting during the run in the dark
additional: Kids run start times: 500m at 19:15 (ages 3-7), 1000m at 19:30 (up to 12 years). 5K starts at 20:00, 10K starts at 21:00. On-the-day registration is limited and possible at the Grote Kerk on the Market Square without a personalized start number. Prize giving after all distances. Registration usually opens around December for the following year, with options for early registration and late registration on-site at the Grote Kerk.

name: Koningsloop Beilen
price_range: Minirun, Kidsrun en Jeugdloop gratis; 5 km en 10 km € 12,50 voorinschrijving, € 15,00 op de dag

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijfgeld Minirun, 700 m en 1350 m: gratis (zowel bij voorinschrijving als bij na-inschrijving)

description: The Koningsloop Beilen is a friendly running race organized by Loopgroep Beilen, suitable for all ages with distances ranging from a Minirun for the very young to 5 km and 10 km for adults. The race takes place in Beilen and offers a sporty and festive atmosphere with medals for the younger participants and cups and prize packages for the top runners. Timing is done automatically with a chip attached to the bib number, and facilities such as changing rooms and showers are available at Vitesse. Parking is available near the start location, and registration is possible up to 15 minutes before the start of each distance.
course_highlights: Distances from 200 m Minirun to 10 km for adults
Timing with chip on the bib number
Start and facilities near Drenthehal and Sportpark Vitesse
additional: Registration is possible up to 15 minutes before the start of the respective distance. Participants in the Minirun, Kidsrun, and Youth Run receive a commemorative medal. The top three men and women in the 5 km and 10 km races receive a cup and prize package. Bib numbers are equipped with a chip and do not need to be returned. Safety pins are available at registration. Shower and changing facilities are available at Vitesse. Parking can be found at Drenthehal and Sportpark Noord-West. The organization accepts no liability for lost clothing. Terrain: city course with start and finish in Beilen; registration until April 25, 2025; timing by RaceResult; parking at Drenthehal and Sportpark Noord-West.

name: Koningsloop Hasselt
description: The Koningsloop Hasselt is an annual running event held in the center of Hasselt. The race offers various distances, including 5 km and 10 km for adults and juniors, a Bambino-run for the very young, a Kidsrun, and a Heroes run. The course runs through the picturesque center of Hasselt with beautiful views, including past the mill and over the Stenendijk. The Koningsloop is known as a sporty orange celebration where young and old come together for a fun and challenging running experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the center of Hasselt
Course along the mill and over the Stenendijk with beautiful views
Fast 10 km with a second lap over the same course
additional: The adults and juniors run the same course and start at the same time. All participants receive a souvenir, and a trophy is awarded for the Heroes run. There are changing rooms and baggage drop-off available. The finish is at Burgemeester Royerplein via the Justitie Bastion. Youth training takes place on Thursday evenings, adults on Wednesday evenings. Photos of the event are available and can be deleted upon request via email. Registration is via inschrijven.nl; the course start and finish are in Hasselt city center; parking is available at Gemeentehuis Zwartewaterland.

name: Hunebedloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijfgeld is € 13,00 voor 7,5 kilometer en de 7.5 kilometer Canicross

description: The AH Abe Hunebed Run is a atmospheric running race organized by AV de Sprinter, taking place in the beautiful surroundings of Havelte. The course mostly runs over paved paths and passes notable sights such as the Hunebedden, burial mounds, and the sheepfold. The start and finish are at the Holtingerveld Entrance Gate, where facilities such as changing rooms and toilets are available. The race features various distances and categories, suitable for different ages and levels.
course_highlights: Mostly paved paths through the Havelte nature reserve
Along the Hunebedden and burial mounds
Start and finish at the sheepfold (Holtingerveld Entrance Gate)
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 10:00 AM at the start/finish. After the race, water and fruit are provided. Changing can be done in the Lammerenkooi of the sheepfold. Registration is possible until one hour before the start or until a maximum of 750 participants is reached. Late registration opens on January 11, 2027, with a surcharge of € 2.00. Registration via inschrijven.nl, start and finish at the Holtingerveld Entrance Gate, maximum 750 participants, part of the Univéloopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe.

name: Slag om Woensdrecht Run
description: The Battle of Woensdrecht Run is a sporting running event in Hoogerheide that brings together young and old for a fun and active day. With distances of 2.5 km for children, 5 km for fast runners, and 10 km for the real challenge, there is a suitable distance for everyone. The course starts and finishes on Scheldeweg and offers beautiful elevation gains and a festive atmosphere with enthusiastic supporters along the route. The organization, under the banner of Stichting Vrienden van de koers, ensures a sporting celebration where fun and exercising together are central.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Scheldeweg in Hoogerheide
Beautiful elevation gains for challenging Strava statistics
Unforgettable encouragement from the crowd along the course
additional: Start times: Kidsrun 2.5 km at 17:15; 10 km at 18:00; 5 km at 18:02. The organization is managed by the cycling committees of Hoogerheide and Huijbergen under Stichting Vrienden van de koers. The run is part of a larger sporting event that also includes cycling races, offering an accessible and enjoyable experience for participants and supporters.

name: 6. Pallas 67 Ultrameerdaagse
price_range: tot 450 euro voor 5 dagen, 35 euro voor eerste dag, 15 euro voor volgende dagen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Vooruitbetaling 35 euro voor de eerste dag

description: The Pallas '67 Ultrameerdaagse celebrates its first anniversary with a challenging multi-day ultramarathon around Wageningen and Bennekom. The edition consists of five days with four routes of approximately 55 km and one route of over 70 km. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas such as the Veluwe, Betuwe, Utrechtse Heuvelrug, and the mystical Prattenburg Forest. The base is at the grounds of Castle Hoekelum, where luxurious overnight accommodations are available. The start is on Wednesday morning, May 13, at the clubhouse of Pallas '67 in Wageningen, with the remaining starts at the castle grounds in Bennekom.
course_highlights: Routes of about 55 km and one route of over 70 km
Natural areas Veluwe, Betuwe, Utrechtse Heuvelrug, and Prattenburg Forest
Start at Pallas '67 clubhouse and castle Hoekelum as base
additional: The base is at Castle Hoekelum with luxury accommodation 'de Schuur' for 4 nights. Participants can also join for one or more days. People from Wageningen can stay overnight at home. The total cost for 5 days including 4 overnight stays is expected not to exceed 450 euros. Routes through Veluwe, Betuwe, Utrechtse Heuvelrug, Prattenburg Forest; start in Wageningen and Bennekom; 4 routes of approximately 55 km and 1 of over 70 km; 4 overnight stays at Castle Hoekelum.

name: Putten Power Run
description: The Putten Power Run is the annual running event that makes the vibrant heart of Putten beat. On the Friday after Ascension Day, the city center transforms into a sporting arena with a festive course through the town and the Putterbos. Participants can choose from various distances, from kids runs to challenging 10 km, and enjoy a fun day with music, food stalls, and activities for the whole family. The event stands for sportsmanship, camaraderie, and supports good causes in the region.
course_highlights: Atmospheric course through the city center and the Putterbos
Start and finish at the lively square in the heart of Putten
Refreshment stations with water along the route and at the finish
additional: Race numbers are available from 15:00 at the race secretariat on Kerkplein. The IPICO tag for time registration must be attached to the shoelace and returned after the finish; otherwise, a fee of €7.50 will be charged. Free parking is available at the parking lot on Brinkstraat. There are changing rooms with toilets, but no showers. Medical support is present on the course and at the finish. There is a lively atmosphere with a DJ, food stalls, business square, and children's activities. The event includes water stations, medical support, and parking facilities. No shower service is available at the changing area. Registration is possible on the day at Kerkplein.

name: KaaienLoop
location: Stadspark en centrum van Oosterhout, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Kaaienloop is a festive running event in Oosterhout with start and finish at the Heuvel. The 24th edition will take place on Saturday, May 8, 2027, and offers various distances for the whole family, from the Bambino Loop of 550 meters to the challenging 10 kilometers through the city park and the city center. The routes are varied and are musically supported by bands along the course, creating a festive atmosphere. The Kaaienloop is accessible for all ages and levels, with chip timing and a strong focus on conviviality and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: Course through the city park and the festive center of Oosterhout
Musical support along the course by various bands
Different distances, including a special course for the Bambino Loop in the city park
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day itself from 15:30 until 15 minutes before the start at the booth in front of Heuvel 7. The Bambino Loop is 550 meters through the city park and can be run under the supervision of a parent. The 5 km consists of 2 laps of 2.5 km, the 10 km of 4 laps of 2.5 km. Timing is done via chip in the start number and start- and finish mats. Results are published via uitslagen.nl. Participants can register for different distances, and the event also includes youth and corporate runs. Photos and results from previous editions are available online.

name: Meidoornloop
description: The Meidoornloop in Nisse is a charming running race held in the beautiful Zak van Zuid-Beveland. The route takes you over the flower dikes and offers a unique combination of nature and sportiness. With distances ranging from 1050 meters to 15 kilometers, there is a suitable challenge for every runner. The race has a long tradition and attracts many participants each year who enjoy the beautiful landscape and the friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Running over the flower dikes in the Zak van Zuid-Beveland
Varied course with rural and floral surroundings
Availability of multiple distances from 1050m to 15 km
additional: The race is held in Nisse and attracts runners from the region who want to enjoy a beautiful and varied course in a rural setting.

name: Run van Gieten
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2.05 km, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.3 km

price_tiers.distance: Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe wedstrijdloop 10 kilometer
Magnesium halve marathon Run van Gieten

description: The Gieten Run is a running and walking event taking place on the Hondsrug in Drenthe. The 19th edition will be held on Saturday, May 8, 2027, and offers a wide range of distances, from 250 meters for the youngest participants to a half marathon. The event includes various races such as the Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe 10-kilometer race, the Magnesium half marathon, and the Magnesium race walk of 5.3 kilometers. Additionally, there are youth and wheelchair runs, walking tours, and special runs for children. The organization warmly welcomes everyone to participate in this sporty day full of challenge and fun.
course_highlights: Running and walking event on the Hondsrug in Drenthe
Distances ranging from 250 meters to the half marathon
Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe race walk 10 kilometers with chip registration
additional: Participants in the 10 km race walk can use changing and shower facilities at sport hall De Goorns. Valuables can be handed in at the Impuls office on Brink. There are sufficient parking spaces in the immediate vicinity. All participants run with a chip from the Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe. There are cash prizes for the fastest men and women in various age categories and an extra bonus for breaking the course record. Registration via QR code, including youth and school championships, walks, and special runs.

name: SilvercityRUN
description: The SilvercityRUN is an annual running event in Schoonhoven known for its friendly atmosphere and sporting challenge. The race takes place through the historic streets of the Silver City and attracts both recreational runners and passionate athletes. With distances of 5 and 10 kilometers and a special Kidsrun, there is a suitable race for everyone. The event is characterized by a festive ambiance with music and enthusiastic supporters along the course.
course_highlights: Historic streets of Schoonhoven
Distances of 5 and 10 kilometers
Friendly and festive atmosphere with music
additional: The SilvercityRUN 2026 was sold out with 1000 participants. There is a special training group and a running shirt available. Each year, funds are raised for the charity 'Het Huis van Noord'. Annual race with a jubilee edition in 2026, including various distances such as 5 km, 10 km, and kids run, with many volunteers and a lively atmosphere.

name: Dikke Tien Runn

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: inschrijfkosten voor 10 km is twaalf euro

description: The Dikke Tien Run is a running race taking place in the beautiful nature reserve of Middag Humsterland, with start and finish at the sports park on Valgeweg in Feerwerd. This run is a spin-off of the Sportpark De Dikke Tien, an initiative by local residents to make exercise fun, social, and healthy. There are three routes: 10 kilometers, 5 kilometers, and a special kids' run of 1 kilometer. The organization collaborates with Univé Insurance and donates part of the registration fees to the UMCG Beatrix Children's Hospital.
course_highlights: Running through the nature reserve Middag Humsterland
Start and finish at Sportpark De Dikke Tien on Valgeweg
Three routes: 10 km, 5 km, and 1 km kids' run
additional: For each ticket sold, 2.50 euros go to the UMCG Beatrix Children's Hospital. The run is an initiative of local village associations and residents from Feerwerd and surrounding villages. The organization works together with Univé Insurance. Routes of 1 km, 5 km, and 10 km; start and finish at Sportpark Valgeweg; support for UMCG Beatrix Children's Hospital.

name: Leiden Marathon
description: The Leiden Marathon is a lively running event taking place in the historic city center of Leiden and its surroundings. The course passes along beautiful canals, the busy crowds, and the green polder landscapes and villages around the city. The start is on Koninginnelaan and the finish under the iconic finish arch on Vismarkt. The marathon weekend offers various distances, including 42 km, 21 km, 10 km, and a 5 km Nightrun, providing an experience for both runners and walkers.
course_highlights: Start on Koninginnelaan
Finish under the finish arch on Vismarkt
Course through historic city center, canals, and green polders
additional: Walking distances of 10 km, 21 km, and 42 km start on Saturday. The 5 km Nightrun takes place on Saturday evening. Running distances of 10 km, 21 km, and 42 km start on Sunday. Race numbers can be collected on Saturday and Sunday at the Johnson & Johnson Park (Garenmarktplein). There is a secured baggage storage and a tent village with a helpdesk. The finish is a festive place with many spectators along the course. Registration opens on October 1, 2023; the event includes multiple distances and activities, with start and finish at Garenmarktplein and Johnson & Johnson Park.

name: Rondehoeploop
location: Ouderkerk aan de Amstel, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Rondehoeploop is a lively and popular running race in Ouderkerk aan de Amstel, celebrating its 40th anniversary in 2027. The race offers challenging courses of 17.2 km, 5 km, and a youth run of 2 km, with a festive start and finish at sports hall De Bindelwijk. The event attracts many participants and spectators each year, thanks in part to enthusiastic volunteers and the crowd along the route. Each participant receives a medal, and there are various prizes for different age categories.
course_highlights: 17.2 km Rondehoeploop course with challenging wind influences
Youth run of 2 km with a special training schedule available
Start and finish at sports hall De Bindelwijk in Ouderkerk aan de Amstel
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day itself from 9:30 to 11:00 in sports hall De Bindelwijk. There is no same-day registration possible for the running distances, only for walking and the youth run. Timing is done with the MYLAPS Bibtag system, with the chip integrated in the start number. The net time is recorded. The youth run starts at 11:42. All participants receive a medal, and there are various prizes and trophies for different age categories. The fastest Ouderkerkers will receive a dinner/lunch voucher and a trophy for three consecutive wins. Event with a jubilee edition, pre-registration required, including route description and refreshment stations along the course.

name: Schagen City Run
location: Het centrum van Schagen, Schagen, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Schagen City Run is an annual running event in the center of Schagen with start and finish at the Markt. The event offers various distances, including 5 km, 10 km, a Business Run, and a Kids Run, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels. The City Run is inclusive and accessible for athletes with handbikes or blades. Participants can pick up their race number in advance at Sport2000 Sportshop Bouwes or on the day at Hotel Marktstad.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Markt in the center of Schagen
Various distances: 5 km, 10 km, Business Run, and Kids Run
Inclusive of athletes with handbikes and blades
additional: Race numbers can be collected in the week prior to the race at Sport2000 Sportshop Bouwes in Schagen. On race day, numbers can also be picked up at Hotel Marktstad. There is an option to participate with handbikes and blades. A voluntary donation is requested for Stichting ALS, the charity of the event. The race takes place on May 9, 2027, in the center of Schagen. In addition to the main distances, there are other activities and a good atmosphere focused on inclusivity and sportsmanship.

name: Luilakpolderloop
location: Jisp, Wormer- en Jisperveld, North Holland, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Luilakpolderloop is a charming running race held annually in the beautiful polder landscape of the Wormer and Jisperveld. With distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 16.1 km (10 miles), there is a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. There is also a free youth run of 1.1 km for children. The start and finish are at Football Club VV Jisp, with a cozy atmosphere, medals for children, cups for the winners, and a tombola afterwards.
course_highlights: Beautiful course through the Wormer and Jisperveld
Distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 16.1 km (10 miles)
Free youth run of 1.1 km for children
additional: Race numbers for the youth run can be collected on May 13, 2027, from 14:00 to 14:30 at OBS De Harpoen or on May 14, 2027, at 18:00 at Restaurant De Lepelaar. The youth run starts at 18:30 at Restaurant De Lepelaar, with the finish at VV Jisp. Race numbers for adults are available from 18:30 at VV Jisp, with the adult fun runs starting at 19:30. There are 4 changing rooms with showers at VV Jisp, baggage storage at your own risk. Parking is limited, and a traffic controller will be present. Live results during the race. Afterward, a tombola and award ceremony around 21:15. Registration for 2027 opens in early March, with 350 starting numbers available. The event supports charitable causes and offers digital timing with live results. Medals and cups are awarded to participants, and registration is mandatory. No refunds are possible in case of cancellation.

name: ZLM-Don Stadsloop
price_range: 8-30 euro afhankelijk van inschrijfdatum en categorie

description: The ZLM-Don City Run is a lively running race through the city center of Middelburg, starting and finishing at the Market Square. The race consists of 3 laps of 2.5 km each, totaling 7.5 km, and features both an individual classification and a team classification for teams of 4 people. There are separate age categories and prizes for the best runners. For youth, there is the Qui-Vive Spectacle Run beforehand, a fun performance run of about 2 km with obstacles. The organization ensures a festive and sporty evening with refreshments, first aid, and a lottery afterwards.
course_highlights: City center Middelburg with start and finish at the Market Square
3 laps of 2.5 km, total 7.5 km
Qui-Vive Spectacle Run with 5 bouncy castle obstacles for youth
additional: Race numbers can be collected on May 19, 20, and 21 at Koole Sport and on race day, May 22, between 18:30 and 19:30 at the booth on the Market Square. Late registration is only possible for the individual race from May 18 onwards digitally and on race day. There is a lottery linked to the start number with prizes and a grand prize. After finishing, participants receive a bottle of water and a keepsake. First aiders are present, also on bicycles. Teams consist of 4 people; mixed teams count towards the men's team classification. A course record bonus of 100 euros for improvement. Prizes for top 3 and participants, lottery with start numbers, first aid available, changing rooms in Molenwater gymnasium.

name: Rundje um ut Hundje
description: Run around ut Hundje is an annual running event in Horst aan de Maas that celebrates its 11th edition in 2027. The event offers a wide range of distances for young and old, from the Parent/Child run to the 10 km race. The routes pass through the center of Horst and provide a sporty and friendly atmosphere, made possible by the local community and sponsors. The organization aims for a well-organized and accessible event for all participants.
course_highlights: Routes ranging from 350 meters to 10 kilometers through the center of Horst
Start and finish at Lambertusplein, near the statue of ’t Hundje van Hôrs
Various youth and adult runs with age-specific distances
additional: Free parking around Lambertusplein. Public transport: bus stop 'Horst Centrum' within a 2-minute walk. There are prize ceremonies at Wilhelminaplein after the youth and adult runs. Shirts can be optionally ordered for an additional cost. Multiple race categories including kids, urban, 5 km, 10 km; location at Lambertusplein; anniversary year with special festivities

name: Nobel Run
description: The Nobel Run is a fun and accessible running event taking place in the beautiful Almere Hout. The various routes pass through the green and sustainable nature of this area, providing a unique experience. The event aims to make a sustainable and sporty contribution to Almere Hout and is intended as a festive occasion for participants, spectators, and residents of Nobelhorst. The Nobel Run encourages social cohesion and offers a sporting boost to the city of Almere.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful nature of Almere Hout
Green and sustainable character of the course
Distances ranging from Kidsrun to 15 km running
additional: Start number with built-in MyLaps chip for timing registration. First name on start number when registering before May 1, 2027. Race bib and shirts can be picked up on Saturday, May 15, 2027, between 10:00 and 14:00 at the neighborhood hall of Nobelhorst. Possibility to hand in one bag with label number. Entertainment, massage after the run, refreshment posts along the route and at the finish, official results, and personal photos included. Optional purchase of the official Nobel Run shirt, limited socks, and BibBits magnets during registration. The event includes merchandise and registration options, emphasizing an environmentally conscious and community-oriented approach.

name: Lelieloop
location: Het Turfschip, Etten-Leur, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Lelieloop is organized annually by Road Runners Etten-Leur on the second Pentecost Monday as part of the De Leurse Havenfeesten. The fast course runs through the streets of Etten-Leur North and passes, among other things, through mill 'De Lelie'. There are various distances for different ages, including a children's run, junior run, 5 km, and 10 km. Start and finish are at Het Turfschip, which also has facilities for changing and showering. The Lelieloop is an accessible event for young and old, with a friendly atmosphere and a beautiful route through the neighborhood and past local sights.
course_highlights: Course passes through mill 'De Lelie'
Routes run through the Schoenmakershoek neighborhood and along the Leurse Dijk
10 km and 5 km courses are accurately measured, with a mix of paved and unpaved sections
additional: Start and finish at Het Turfschip with changing and shower facilities. Kangoo-jumpers and racerunners are welcome, but the course is not suitable for wheelers. If temperatures exceed 30 degrees Celsius, the Lelieloop will be canceled according to Athletics Union rules. All children receive a pancake from mill De Lelie after the children's run. The course is not officially measured and may vary; pre-registration is recommended; if temperatures exceed 30°C, the run will be canceled.

name: Potmarge Run
description: The Potmarge Run is an evening run over 5 and 10 kilometers that has been part of the running series organized by Lionitas in Leeuwarden since 2012. The routes are precisely measured and offer a unique running experience along the Van Harinxmakanaal and the Potmarge River, where you can enjoy special nature within the city. The start is at the MICA/Mediahuis building on Sixmastraat 15. Participation is at your own risk and responsibility, and there is an option to order a medal.
course_highlights: 10 km route along the Van Harinxmakanaal
Run along the Potmarge River
Precisely measured 5 and 10 km routes
additional: Online registration available until just before the start, no late registration. Medal can optionally be ordered for € 3.50. Start location is MICA/Mediahuis (Leeuwarder Courant building) Sixmastraat 15, Leeuwarden. Routes are measured, online registration until just before the start, no late registration, free parking after 18:00.

name: Verkerkloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De inschrijving is geopend vanaf 1 februari 2027 tot en met 13 mei 2027. Restitutie is niet mogelijk.

description: The Verkerk Run is an annual competitive run through Zwijndrecht, starting and finishing at Verkerk on Molenvliet. The race consists of a fast city course with distances of 5 and 10 kilometers for individual runners, a school run for children of various age groups, and a corporate run for teams. The route passes through the Molenvliet industrial area and surrounding streets, with a turnaround point halfway. The Verkerk Run is a sporting event that contributes to a healthy and close-knit community and attracts thousands of participants each year.
course_highlights: Fast city course through Zwijndrecht with start and finish at Verkerk on Molenvliet
5 km distance consists of one lap, 10 km distance of two laps
Route passes through Molenvliet, Munnikensteeg, Klarinetsingel, Beethovenlaan, and Develsingel
additional: Start and finish at Verkerk on Molenvliet 1 on the Molenvliet industrial area in Zwijndrecht. School run for children from 6 years old with distances from 600 to 1200 meters. Corporate run teams consist of 4 or 5 runners, with finish times of the top 4 runners summed. Each participant receives a commemorative medal. Bib numbers can be transferred via a resale platform. A maximum of 3500 participants allowed. Registration begins on February 1, 2027. The event is held at Verkerk on Molenvliet and also includes youth and corporate activities.

name: Liberation Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De deelnamekosten zijn voor iedereen gelijk, ongeacht volledige of halve etappes

description: The Liberation Trail is a three-day trail running adventure along the historic D-Day beaches in Normandy. This unique experience combines sporting challenge with a tribute to freedom and history. Participants cover a total of 113 kilometers across important locations of liberation, including Utah Beach, Omaha Beach, and other landing sites. The event focuses on perseverance and respect, emphasizing the significance of the route rather than competition.
course_highlights: Route along the iconic D-Day beaches and historic monuments
Night passages at the cliffs of Pointe du Hoc
Start in Sainte-Mère-Église, known for the famous parachutist John Steele
additional: The trail is flexible: participants can choose the full route of 115 km or a selection of half stages of 70 km. The basecamp is Camping Ferme Hay Day, where participants can relax and share experiences. There is no time pressure; the focus is on personal challenge and respect for history. The event includes multiple days of trail running with options for full or half routes, historical tours, and camping facilities. A bus transfer from the Netherlands and Belgium is also available. The race takes place from May 21 to 23, 2027.

name: Gerard Tebroke Memorialloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijven voor de GUV Businessrun : €125 per deelnemend team.

description: The Gerard Tebroke Memorial Run is an annual running event in Aalten offering various distances and categories, including kids runs, school runs, business runs, and 5 and 10 kilometer races. The event takes place on Saturday, May 22, 2027, and provides a sporty and friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages and levels. The start times are spread throughout the afternoon and evening, allowing participants and spectators to enjoy a diverse program.
course_highlights: Multiple race categories for all ages and levels
Location in the center of Aalten
Memorial run in honor of Gerard Tebroke
additional: Registration for the 5 and 10 kilometer races is possible at the registration desk at Markt 7, Aalten. The start times are: 16:30 for The North Kids Runs, 17:00 for GUV School Run, 18:00 for Sorba 5 Kilometer Run and GUV Business Run 5KM, 18:45 for Ducona 10 Kilometer Run. The event is held every two years and has a strong local and sporting significance.

name: Freedom Run Wageningen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld bedraagt € 15 en is hetzelfde voor alle afstanden.

description: The Freedom Run Wageningen is a running event that celebrates freedom and unity in the city of liberation. Organized by Lions Club Wageningen, participants run for Stichting Kind en Kans, which supports children from families with limited means. The run offers four distances and takes place through beautiful natural areas and the city, with routes mainly over paved bike paths. Everyone is welcome to participate and contribute to a future where no child is on the sidelines.
course_highlights: Routes start at Visum Mundi in the Vrijheidskwartier
15 km and half marathon run through natural areas with approximately 90 meters of elevation gain
Ends with a scenic descent towards the finish at Visum Mundi
additional: Timing registration with Race Result bibtag at start/finish; additional live intermediate registration at 6 km for 15k and 21k. Medal available for €5. T-shirt can be ordered during registration. The organization promotes sustainable transportation and uses sustainable materials, such as medals made from potato starch or reclaimed wood and rPET cups at refreshment stations. Terrain: city run, registration via bibtag, start/finish at Visum Mundi, parking near start/finish, registration only via pre-registration.
