description: The Liemerse Landloop is an annual running event held on the fourth Sunday of May in Oud-Zevenaar and Ooy. The course takes participants through picturesque villages and along the Liemerse dikes, with official certification for the 5 km and 10 km distances. There are distances of 3 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a free Kidsrun for children up to 12 years old. The atmosphere is warm and festive, with strong volunteer involvement and a memorable experience for every participant.
course_highlights: Officially calibrated and certified course of 5 km and 10 km
Route through the countryside of Oud-Zevenaar and Ooy via Liemerse dikes
Start and finish at Koffiehuis Uniek, Kerkweg 10 in Oud-Zevenaar
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Saturday, May 30 from 15:00 to 16:30 and on race day from 08:45 at Koffiehuis Uniek. Parking is available at Dijkweg and near the station with shuttle buses from 10:00. Awards ceremonies take place after each distance at the terrace near the start/finish location. The Kidsrun is divided into age groups with distances of 500 and 1000 meters. Teams of 3 to 5 persons can participate in the 5 km race. Registration is possible online and on-site; the event features volunteers and various race categories.

name: LOOP Leeuwarden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bestel je startnummer uiterlijk op 21 april, dan wordt het gepersonaliseerd

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bestel je startnummer uiterlijk op 21 april, dan wordt het gepersonaliseerd

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bestel je startnummer uiterlijk op 21 april, dan wordt het gepersonaliseerd

description: LOOP Leeuwarden is the largest running and walking event in Friesland, attracting thousands of participants annually. The routes pass through the atmospheric center of Leeuwarden and surrounding natural areas, with start and finish at the iconic Oldehove. The half marathon is the longest distance and offers a challenging mix of city and landscape runs. With a wide range of distances, there is a suitable challenge for every runner, from 5 km to 21.1 km.
course_highlights: Route through the center of Leeuwarden with start and finish at the Oldehove
Varied course along water, forest, and open Frisian landscape
Safe and closed course with official time registration
additional: Start and finish are at Wilhelminaplein and at the foot of the Oldehove. Bib numbers can be personalized and ordered until April 21, with home delivery available until April 5. There is official time registration, refreshment stations with water, sports drinks, fruit, and toilets along the route. The course is safe and closed. There are different waves with color codes for the start groups. The event also includes volunteer opportunities and provides information about registration and start times; held in Leeuwarden, Friesland.

name: Maastricht Marathon
description: The DSM-Firmenich Maastricht Marathon is a unique running event that is part of the DSM-Firmenich Long Course Weekend Netherlands. The race offers a flat and scenic course through the historic and picturesque landscape of Maastricht and its surroundings. With distances of 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, and a full marathon, there is a suitable challenge for every runner, suitable for both recreational and serious athletes. Crossing the finish line on the red carpet provides a festive and unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Flat and scenic course through historic Maastricht
Start and finish in the vibrant heart of the city with cheering crowds
Along iconic sights and local street festivals
additional: Pacers are available for the marathon and half marathon with multiple time slots from 1:30 to 5:00 hours. The pacers are recognizable by their T-shirts and flags and help runners achieve their desired finish time. The event is part of a three-day multisport festival including swimming, cycling, and running. Part of a 3-day multisport event including swimming and cycling; suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Amsterdam UMC Run
description: The Amsterdam UMC Run is a unique running event that takes participants through the Amsterdam UMC hospital and the green surroundings of Amsterdam Zuidoost. Participants can choose from the Family Run of 1.2 km, 5 km, 10 km, or the challenging hat trick where all distances are run separately. Besides the sporting aspect, the event aims to raise money for research and improvement of patient care within Amsterdam UMC. The event offers a fun day with music, food trucks, entertainment, and a kids corner, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: Routes go through the Amsterdam UMC hospital
Starting zones for 5 km and 10 km ensure enough space on the course
Refreshment stations with water and fruit along the route
additional: Starting zones at 5 km (Green and Blue) and 10 km with groups of about 300 participants every 10 minutes. Race bibs are available at the event site, not sent by post. Staff and visitors can pick up their bibs earlier at the AMC location. A unique running shirt can be ordered, with part of the proceeds going to research. Refreshment stations with water and fruit along the route. First aid available. The course is traffic-free. Registration via online registration; support for various medical research projects such as cancer research and dementia research; event is car-free and suitable for all ages.

name: Halve Marathon Veghel
location: Prins Willem Alexander Sportpark, Veghel, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Veghel Half Marathon is an annual running event held in the last weekend of May in Veghel. The course consists of a 7.09-kilometer loop that is run three times, with start and finish at Fit Functional. This event is intended for both recreational runners who want to complete their first half marathon and experienced runners aiming for a fast time. Safety and care are central, with first aid facilities and refreshment posts along the route. The organization, Fit Functional, is committed to providing a professional and well-organized event and promotes sports and health in the region.
course_highlights: Course of 7.09 km that is run three times up to 21.1 km
Start and finish at Fit Functional with refreshment post and intermediate timing
Route over foot and bike paths in the outskirts of Veghel
additional: First aid facilities available at start and finish. Participants must adhere to traffic rules and instructions from the organization. Refreshment stations with drinks at Fit Functional. The event is scheduled at Prins Willem Alexander Sports Park, registration opens from February 1, 2026, permit application for 2027 has been submitted.

name: Meppel City Run
distance_verbose: 12.9 km, 6.4 km, 3000 meter, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.2 km
description: The Meppel City Run is a running race through the historic city center of Meppel, with options for 4 or 8 miles. The fully paved and traffic-free route passes by beautiful spots such as Wilhelminapark and various cozy streets. In addition to the main distances, there is also a Kidsrun, G-Run, and Frame-Run, making the event suitable for recreational runners, experienced athletes, and special athletes. The start and finish are in the city center, creating a festive and sporty day for everyone.
course_highlights: Fully paved and traffic-free route over cobblestones
Start at Grote Oever and finish at Kromme Elleboog
Run through the historic city center and past Wilhelminapark
additional: The 8 miles consists of two times the 4-mile course, which is extra fun for supporters. All parts start at Grote Oever, with finish for Kidsrun, Frame-Run, and G-Run also there. There is a warm-up for the G-Run and Kidsrun. After the race, all children receive a medal. There is a Business Run with teams of 3 to 5 participants. The course is certified by the Atletiek Unie. The event also includes activities such as warm-up sessions and an award ceremony, and offers registration via email. The organization targets a broad audience, from young runners to experienced athletes.

name: Quintusloop
description: The Quintusloop is a running event in Hengelo where participants can choose between distances of 10 and 21 kilometers. The goal of the run is to raise money for research into multiple sclerosis (MS), with a personal motivation to offer hope to people living with this disease. The run is organized as a campaign for Stichting MS Research and emphasizes the importance of running together for a future with better treatments and more research.
course_highlights: Distances of 10 and 21 kilometers
Running for the good cause of MS research
Organized in Hengelo
additional: The Quintusloop is an initiative where participants run together to raise funds for MS research, motivated personally by a friend diagnosed with MS. A newsletter is available to stay informed about activities. The website highlights the importance of research and hope for people with MS. The race supports MS research and awareness, with a route that includes both paved and unpaved roads.

name: Rotte Dam Loop
description: The Rotte Dam Loop is a social running and walking race in Rotterdam, where participants enjoy the beautiful surroundings along the Rotte River. There are four distances: 1 km kids run, 5 km through the Hoge Bergse Bos, and 10 km and 21 km along the Rotte from the dam to Outdoor Valley. The race is non-timed, allowing everyone to enjoy the movement and atmosphere at their own pace. The event is known for its friendly and accessible character for runners and walkers of all levels.
course_highlights: 1 km kids run and 5 km through the Hoge Bergse Bos
10 km and 21 km along the Rotte River
Start at the dam and finish at Outdoor Valley
additional: The race is non-timed, both running and walking are possible. There is a Rotte Dam Loop Festival at the finish. For 2026, the event was sold out and had a waiting list. The event emphasizes fun and camaraderie, with a focus on accessibility for everyone. The anniversary edition in 2026 was a great success and the organization continues to focus on a friendly and social experience for all participants.

name: The Royal Ten

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: MUNT Hypotheken Business Run €270 per team (ex. btw)

description: The Royal Ten is the most gezellig running event in The Hague, organized annually by The Hague Road Runners. The event offers various distances and races, including an official 10-kilometer race that runs through the Haagse Bos and past Paleis Huis ten Bosch. The course is completely traffic-free and fast, with clear kilometer markings and a water station at 5 km. The organization is committed to providing a safe and enjoyable running experience for all participants.
course_highlights: 10 km course officially measured and certified by the Atletiekunie
Course runs through Beatrixkwartier, Haagse Bos, and past Paleis Huis ten Bosch
Fully traffic-free course with clear kilometer markings and water stations
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day or on Saturday, May 30. There is a baggage drop-off at the NH Hotel, but no changing facilities. A free first aid station is available in the start/finish area. Water stations are present at 5 km, with additional stations in hot weather. Minimum age is 12 years for the 5 km and 14 years for the 10 km. The organization accepts no liability and refunds are not possible in case of cancellation. The event takes place on May 30, 2027, and offers various categories for runners of all levels.

name: Sasloop
description: The Sasloop is a traditional time trial organized by AV'56 for its own members. The race takes place on Tuesday evening and starts at 7:15 PM at the sports park ’t Schenge in Goes. The course is approximately 7.8 kilometers long and runs back and forth to the Goese Sas. Participants start individually every 30 seconds, with the fastest runner starting last. Timing is done electronically with chip start numbers, and results are published after the race on the AV'56 website.
course_highlights: Course of about 7.8 km back and forth to the Goese Sas
Start and finish on the bike path in front of the entrance to Sportpark ’t Schenge
Individual starts every 30 seconds
additional: Participation is free and exclusive to members of AV'56. Chip start numbers are issued between 6:30 PM and 7:00 PM in the canteen. The start number must not be attached with magnets, folded, and must be clearly worn at the front. The course is not traffic-free, so be careful when crossing and with oncoming cyclists. Results are announced afterwards in the canteen and later published online. The race is held on a non-traffic-free course and registration must be done in advance via the website. The race offers a great opportunity for members to test their speed and participate in an organized time trial.

name: Hollen in Heesch
description: Hollen in Heesch is a running event for young and old, from beginners to advanced, taking place in the heart of Heesch. Participants can choose from different distances and enjoy a beautiful course through the village, with start and finish on the atmospheric courtyard of the Eijnderic. The event concludes with a cozy afterparty at the same location, making it a sporty and festive highlight for everyone. The run is accessible to individuals, groups, friends, and colleagues, and offers a warm and enthusiastic atmosphere.
course_highlights: Beautiful course of 2.5 km through the heart of Heesch
Depending on the distance, run 2 or 4 laps through the streets of Heesch
Start and finish on the atmospheric courtyard of the Eijnderic

name: KLM Aruba Marathon
location: Hilton Aruba Caribbean Resort, Oranjestad, Aruba
description: The KLM Aruba Marathon is an officially certified marathon by World Athletics and AIMS, taking place on the beautiful island of Aruba. The race offers a tropical running experience along the coast of Aruba, starting and finishing at the Hilton Aruba Caribbean Resort. The marathon includes multiple distances, such as the full marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km, and is characterized by a festive atmosphere with a beach party afterwards. The race is a unique combination of sport, culture, and vacation, ideal for both competitive runners and recreational participants.
course_highlights: Tropical route along the coast of Aruba, including Eagle Beach and the famous lighthouse
Full marathon consists of two laps of the half marathon, starting in the dark and ending in daylight
14 water stations on the marathon route, with Powerade and bananas at selected points
additional: Race packet pickup is at the Grand Ballroom of Hilton Aruba Caribbean Resort on June 4th (08:00-17:00) and June 5th (08:00-12:30). The race features a Track & Trace app for live tracking. The full marathon has a 6-hour time limit with a sweeper vehicle enforcing cutoffs. Post-race celebrations include awards ceremonies and beach parties on both race days. Participants receive a personalized start number, timing chip, finisher medal, and a complimentary UV-protective dry fit running shirt. The course includes beaches and city roads; registration requires ID and age verification; race day activities include prize ceremonies and festive beach parties.

name: Eiberrun
description: The Eiberrun is a fun and sporty running event in Eibergen, taking place on Sunday, June 6, 2027. Participants can choose from various distances, including 5 km, 10 km, a corporate run, kids runs, and a spectacular Urban Fun Run for youth. The event starts and finishes at the lively sports square De Brink, which is transformed into a vibrant location especially for this day. The routes pass through the village and the Mallumse countryside, with challenging and enjoyable courses for all ages and levels.
course_highlights: 10 km distance runs twice the 5 km loop through the village and Mallumse countryside
Start and finish at the lively sports square De Brink
Urban Fun Run with a route through shops and over obstacles in the village
additional: Race numbers with timing chips are ready at the registration desk at De Brink. Pickup can be on Saturday, June 5 (time to be determined), and Sunday, June 6 from 09:00 until half an hour before the start. If you register before May 31 at 12:00 PM, your name will be on the race number. Late registration is possible on race day from 09:00 at a higher fee. The award ceremony takes place around 12:00 and 13:00. The Eiberrun also offers clinics and training sessions via ASV Eibergen for preparation. Registration for the June 6, 2027 edition is open, with clinics and volunteer opportunities available. The event starts and ends at sports square De Brink, where the lively atmosphere can also be experienced.

name: Gaperloop
description: The Gaperloop is a fast and flat running event that takes place annually in Gapinge. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, and attracts both recreational and competitive runners. Starting at 7:30 PM in the evening, it is an ideal run for those who enjoy a quick, lively race. The Gaperloop is organized by Loopgroep Gonzalez and has a long tradition with now eight editions.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Start time at 7:30 PM
additional: Registration for the Gaperloop begins in March 2026. There are categories for men and women, both open and 40+. The race is fully booked for 2026. The organization is Loopgroep Gonzalez. The race will be held on June 11, 2027, at 7:30 PM, with categories for different age groups and prizes for top finishers. Participation is at your own risk, and all finishers will receive a pair of running gaper socks.

name: Loop door Houten
description: Houten Running is a atmospheric running event held annually in the center of Houten. The race offers various distances, from the Kidsrun and Youth Run for elementary school children to 5 and 10 kilometers, the SAMSAMLOOP for pairs, and a team run for teams of four runners. The course takes you through Old Village and Castellum, finishing at Het Plein, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and enthusiastic participants. Volunteers play an important role in the success of the event, which is also a celebration of running together and celebrating.
course_highlights: Kidsrun and Youth Run through Old Village with multiple crossings over Het Plein
5 and 10 km course with water stations in Castellum and crossing at Het Plein
Team run where four runners finish together after exchanges at different points
additional: Race numbers can be picked up on the day of the run from 16:00 to 19:15 in the hall of de Roskam on Old Village. Late registration is possible digitally until 18:00 on the day of the race, provided the maximum number of participants has not been reached. Pre-registration opens on March 15. There is a warm-up for the Kidsrun/Youth Run and walking at 17:45, with walks starting at 18:00, Kidsrun at 18:10, Youth Run at 18:25, SAMSAMLOOP at 19:10, and 5, 10 km, and Team Run at 19:40. An award ceremony for various categories takes place afterwards. Training opportunities and course explorations are offered prior to the event. The organization asks participants to prepare well, including tips for running in high temperatures. Distances range from Kidsrun (1 km) to 10 km, including Youth Run and SAMSAMLOOP; registration and volunteers are sought; the event takes place in Houten.

name: Omloop van Empel
description: The Empel Circuit is a popular running race held annually in Empel. The anniversary edition attracts approximately 1,000 participants each year and is known for its sporty and friendly atmosphere. The organizers work hard to make it a wonderful day filled with socializing and sportsmanship. Participants and spectators are invited to enjoy this special running experience together.
course_highlights: Various distances for all levels
Friendly atmosphere with music and drinks
Includes children's runs and family activities
additional: Registration for the 10th edition is closed and all start numbers have been allocated. Approximately 1,000 participants are expected. The organization encourages spectators to come cheer on the participants and experience the event's atmosphere. Running and walking event, registration via inschrijven.nl, start location: Asmunt 3, Empel

name: Grachtenloop
description: The Zorgspecialist Grachtenloop is a festive evening run through the beautiful old center of Haarlem, where participants run along the canals and moats. The course passes various cultural and tourist attractions and is supported by an enthusiastic crowd, bands, and DJs. The 10 km distance consists of two laps of the 5 km circuit. There is also a Hero KidsRun for children from 4 years old and a BusinessRun with extra facilities. The run offers a unique combination of sportiness and conviviality in a historic city environment.
course_highlights: Course through the old center of Haarlem along canals and moats
Past various cultural and tourist attractions
Musical support from bands and DJs along the route
additional: Registration includes the first name on the start number, official results on the website, a safe and closed course, refreshment posts along the route and at the finish, medical care, a personal finish video, a unique medal, entertainment, timing by ChronoRace, and home delivery of the start number via PostNL for registrations before June 1. There is a BusinessRun with VIP location, food, drinks, and massage. Group registration with separate invoicing and start number dispatch is also available. The event provides start numbers, course, refreshment posts, medal, entertainment, timing, and medical support. Start numbers are home-delivered for Dutch participants.

name: Heuvelrugloop
description: The Heuvelrug Run is a popular forest run in Maarn, known as the most beautiful forest run in the Netherlands. The race is part of the Heuvelrug Run Challenge, allowing participants to also take part in the Uilentoren Loop Leersum and the Koploop in Amerongen for a combined ranking and discount. The run offers challenging courses through the wooded area of the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and attracts approximately 1,000 runners annually. There is also a running clinic available to prepare for the 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: Wooded environment on the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Distances of 4.2 km, 10 km, and half marathon
Participants experience a challenging and varied course
additional: The Heuvelrug Run is part of the Heuvelrug Run Challenge with extra attention and discounts when participating in multiple events. A running clinic is available via RunXperience to prepare for the 5 km and 10 km. The race attracts about 1,000 participants annually and offers a challenging course through a forested environment. Terrain: forest, registration: not specified, part of a challenge with multiple runs, preparation via RunXperience.nl

name: De Ronde van Nieuwveen
location: W.P. Speelmanweg, Nieuwveen, South Holland, Netherlands
price_range: 7 euro voorinschrijving, 8 euro tijdens de wedstrijd
description: The Nieuwveen Round is a running race held in and around the village of Nieuwveen, part of the Municipality of Nieuwkoop Circuit. The race takes place on the longest evening of the year and offers various distances for both youth and adults. For children up to 13 years old, there are free children's runs of 400 m, 800 m, and 1.7 km, while adults can participate in 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km routes. The race is characterized by a varied course through the neighborhood and the village, with special attention to a good distribution of runners along the route.
course_highlights: Course through and around Nieuwveen with start and finish at W.P. Speelmanweg
Children's runs of 400 m, 800 m, and 1.7 km through the neighborhood and the village
5 km, 10 km, and 15 km routes that run through and around Nieuwveen
additional: Start and finish at W.P. Speelmanweg with changing facilities, showers, and guarded baggage drop-off. There is a special G-loop for participants with an intellectual or physical disability, who can run together with guides. Parking is available at the municipality building, Teylersplein 1, and De Hogendijk next to the football fields. Participation is free for children, but pre-registration is requested for a smooth process. Course through and around Nieuwveen, various distances for youth and adults, free participation for youth and G-Loop, changing facilities, and guarded baggage drop-off.

name: Havendagen Run
description: The Harbour Days Run Terneuzen is a sporting race held in the city center of Terneuzen. The second edition of this run offers a unique route through the city with distances of 1, 3, and 5 nautical miles (1.85 km, 5.55 km, and 9.25 km). Start and finish are at the Veerplein, near the pontoon. The Kidsrun for children up to 12 years old is 1 km and starts slightly earlier. The run is suitable for young and old and offers a sporting challenge with an improved course compared to last year.
course_highlights: Unique route through the city center of Terneuzen
Start and finish at the Veerplein, near the pontoon
Run past the City Hall Square and the Market
additional: There is a Kidsrun of 1 km for children up to and including 12 years old, starting at 18:15. The Harbour Days Run takes place on Friday, June 26, 2026. The route has been improved compared to last year for a better running experience. Registration via inschrijven.nl, part of the Harbour Days with various festivities in Terneuzen.

name: Lingewaalloop
price_range: Jeugdlopen en jongeren t/m 15 jaar gratis; 5 km €10 voorinschrijving, €13 op de dag; 10 km €12 voorinschrijving, €15 op de dag
description: The Lingewaalloop is a friendly running race organized by Stichting Lingewaalloop Herwijnen, aimed at residents of Herwijnen and the surrounding area. The race offers various distances, including youth runs and 5 and 10 kilometers, with a course starting and finishing at Vervoornlaan and passing via Waaldijk. The youth run takes place on and around Vervoornlaan, while the 5 and 10 km runners complete a loop over the dike and Achterweg. The organization provides facilities such as changing rooms, showers, and an award ceremony afterwards.
course_highlights: Youth run on and around Vervoornlaan
5 km loop via Achterweg, Waaldijk, and Katerdam
10 km consists of two identical 5 km loops
additional: Registration and pickup of start numbers for youth from 09:30 in the football clubhouse De Kol. Changing rooms and showers available at Sportpark De Kol. Award ceremony for youth at the finish, and for 5 and 10 km after the race in the clubhouse. Parking along Parallelweg, not at nearby shops. Ten age categories for men and women, regardless of race license. The race is held on and around Vervoornlaan, with pre-registration and same-day registration, and facilities at Sportpark De Kol. The 2027 edition has been canceled due to extreme temperatures.

name: Kadeloop
description: The Moore DRV-Kadeloop in Schipluiden is a traditional running race that has been held annually since 1978 on the first Saturday of July. The main distance is 12 km through the green Midden-Delfland and over the Vlaardingsekade back to Schipluiden. Additionally, there is a 5 km run and a youth race of 1 and 2 km. The race is known for its beautiful nature and friendly atmosphere and is part of the Summer Run Circuit.
course_highlights: 12 km route through the green Midden-Delfland
Run over the Vlaardingsekade back to Schipluiden
Youth race of 1 and 2 km especially for children
additional: Race numbers for children can be collected from 10:00-11:00 hours, other distances from 11:00-13:00 hours at the VV Schipluiden canteen. Parking available at VV Schipluiden. Digital chip timing for 5 km and 12 km. Water stations along the route and at the finish. Award ceremony immediately after the children's race, around 15:00 for the 5 km, and around 15:30 for the 12 km at the VV Schipluiden canteen. Late registration is not possible; registration only online until July 2, 2027, 23:59. Bib transfer possible until July 2, 21:00 via the registration site. Distances: 12 km, 5 km, youth run (1 and 2 km); activities such as Nordic walking and walking; location: Schipluiden, Midden-Delfland.

name: Stratenloop Zoutelande
description: The Zoutelande Street Run is a charming running race held in the picturesque village of Zoutelande. Organized by Dynamica Sport, this race attracts both competitive runners and casual joggers and offers a challenging course through the village streets. The event has a long-standing tradition and is known for its friendly and sportive atmosphere. Participants can register via an online platform and enjoy a well-organized day.
course_highlights: Course through the charming streets of Zoutelande
Suitable for both competitive runners and casual joggers
Organized by the local athletics club Dynamica Sport
additional: Members of Dynamica receive a 50% discount on the registration fee when registering in advance. Registration can be done via inschrijven.nl. The race is open to both official race athletes and casual joggers. Registration for the race on July 7, 2027, is open through an online form. The race distance is not explicitly mentioned, but the 2025 edition was 9.9 km. The event attracts runners from the region and beyond.

name: Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn
distance_verbose: Marathon, 28 km, Halve marathon, 14 km, 7.5 km
description: The Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn is a unique running race held on a summer evening through the shady forests of the Veluwe around Apeldoorn. The race offers five distances, ranging from 7.5 km to the full marathon of 42.195 km, with start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos. The routes mostly run along wide Veluwe paths and forest trails with varied terrain and approximately 300 meters of elevation, making it a challenging and atmospheric experience. The start times are scheduled so that participants can enjoy the evening and reach the finish well before sunset, giving the race a special summer ambiance.
course_highlights: Running through shady forests of the Veluwe
Varied terrain with about 300 meters of elevation and a quarter unpaved
Start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos, finish in daylight
additional: All five distances start later in the day to enjoy the summer evening. The marathon has a time limit of 5 hours and participants are allowed to bring a personal supporter who can assist along the course. Parking is free and within walking distance of the start location. A finisher medal and a Midzomer shirt are included with registration. Changing your bib to a shorter distance on the day of the race is free at the registration desk. The event relies partly on volunteers who assist with various tasks. The five distances are 7.5 km, 14 km, half marathon, 28 km, and marathon; supporter bikes are possible for the half and full marathon; facilities include water and fruit stations, free parking, and public transport connections.

name: Amsterdam Pride Run
description: The Amsterdam Pride Run is a colorful and inclusive running event held during the Pride Amsterdam festivities. The event is organized by Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam and Pride and Sports and offers a sporty celebration of diversity and equality. The run takes place in the city of Amsterdam and attracts a broad audience of runners and supporters who come together to support the LGBTQ+ community. The atmosphere is festive and unifying, with a focus on sportsmanship and inclusivity.
course_highlights: Running route through the center of Amsterdam
Inclusive and festive atmosphere during Pride Amsterdam
Organized by Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam and Pride and Sports
additional: The Amsterdam Pride Run takes place in the afternoon during Pride Amsterdam, with an entry fee ranging from €8 to €18. The event is part of a broader program of queer sports activities organized by Pride and Sports. There is a festive and safe atmosphere with attention to inclusivity and sportsmanship. Route through Flevopark and along the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal, multiple race options including walk and business run, colorful and inclusive event during World Pride.

name: Turfveld Zomercross, Texel

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: inschrijfgeld voor de jeugd tot en met 12 jaar € 2,-

description: The Turfveld Summer Cross in Den Burg, Texel, is a charming running race held on Sunday mornings in July and August. The route takes you through the varied landscape of Texel, featuring a sheltered course in the forest, a challenging climb, and beautiful trails. There are different distances for various ages, including a special loop for youth. The start is at 10:30 AM, with registration from 9:45 AM at Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld.
course_highlights: Varied forest landscape with sheltered paths
Challenging climb in the course
Beautiful natural trails
additional: Registration is possible from 9:45 AM at Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld, Nattevlakweg 2, 1791 PB Den Burg. There are separate distances for children up to 12 years (1 km), youth 13 to 15 years (2 km), and from 15 years old (4 and 8 km). The race is held weekly on Sundays in July and August. Running race with different distances, location in a forested environment, registration from 9:45 AM, start at 10:30 AM.

name: Moore DRV Run Maasdijk

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijfgeld 10 Km  € 13,- Dit is exclusief SAW chip.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijfgeld 5 Km  € 12,- Dit is exclusief SAW chip.

description: The Moore DRV Run Maasdijk is a fun running race in Westland, held during the Summer Spectacle in Maasdijk. The main distance is 10 kilometers over a traffic-free, fast asphalt course through the polder and along iconic dikes. In addition, there is a 5 km performance run, the 5 of DAEL, and a youth run for children up to 12 years old. After the finish, participants receive an original running shirt and excellent care on the festive finish field.
course_highlights: Traffic-free course through the polder and along dikes
Entirely paved and fast asphalt with water stations
Iconic finish location in the village of Maasdijk
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day from 10:30 AM at the clubhouse of korfball club Dijkvogels, Lange Kruisweg 44F in Maasdijk. The 5 km starts at 2:00 PM, followed by the 10 km at 2:10 PM. There are changing and shower facilities at the korfball club. Results are processed with a SAW chip, which costs €4.50 once and is not included in the registration fee. The youth run is run without a chip. The race takes place during the Summer Spectacle in Maasdijk and offers a cozy atmosphere for all ages, including youth activities and special memories for participants.

name: 39e Kooyman Polderloop
description: The Kooyman Polderloop is an annual running race in the Kwakel, organized by Atletiek Vereniging Aalsmeer. This popular race takes place during a beautiful summer of sports and attracts many participants, including many members of AVA. The race offers a lively and sporty evening with a challenging course through the polder landscape. The event is a staple in the region and is known for its friendly and accessible character.
course_highlights: Running through the characteristic polder landscape
Evening race with a sporty and friendly atmosphere
Organized by the local athletics club AVA Aalsmeer
additional: The starting location is usually at AVA, Sportlaan 43 in Aalsmeer. There is a cozy after-party with coffee or tea in the club building. The club also organizes walking groups and running courses, which strengthen the sporting community. Registration is via Inschrijven.nl; the event is part of the Polderfeest with activities such as food festivals, performances, and family activities over several days.

name: De Mijl van Mares Catch-up Run
Kustloop Vrouwenpolder

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld voor de halve marathon is € 21,50.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld voor de 12 km en de 6 km is € 15,00.

description: The Kustloop Vrouwenpolder is a challenging half marathon known as 'Walcher's most beautiful'. The route of approximately 21.1 kilometers runs along the Veerse Meer and over the North Sea beach, offering stunning views and natural areas around Vrouwenpolder. In addition to the half marathon, runners can also participate in shorter distances of 12 km and 6 km. The start is at Dorpsdijk near the Pelgrimskerk, and there are refreshment stations approximately every 5 kilometers. The registration includes a T-shirt for walkers or a singlet for runners.
course_highlights: Approximately 9 km along the Veerse Meer
Route over the North Sea beach
Beautiful natural areas around Vrouwenpolder
additional: Walkers start at 10:30 AM, runners at 11:30 AM. There is an award ceremony immediately after completing the race on a podium. Changing rooms are available in the gymnasium within walking distance of the start. Race numbers can be transferred or sold via the personal dashboard until August 26, 2026. Refreshment stations are located approximately every 5 kilometers. The course runs along Veerse Meer and North Sea beach, registration includes a T-shirt/singlet, and changing rooms are available.

name: Rondje Oude IJsselstreek

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De kosten per team bedragen € 60,00. Inschrijven kan t/m vrijdag 3 september 2027.

description: The Rondje Oude IJsselstreek is an annual relay race organized by athletics club Atletico’73, where teams of seven runners cover distances between 4 and 7 kilometers. The start and finish are at the athletics track of Atletico'73 in Gendringen. The route passes through a beautiful green environment along various villages in the municipality of Oude IJsselstreek. Participants experience the event as a fun and sporty activity to enjoy together with teammates.
course_highlights: 7 stages between 4 and 7 kilometers through green surroundings
Routes along the villages Ulft, Silvolde, Westendorp, Sinderen, and Voorst
Variety of paved and unpaved roads and paths, sometimes with loose sand
additional: Teams consist of 7 persons with at least 1 woman and 1 man. The race starts in two waves, with the slower wave starting first. Bonus and penalty minutes are awarded based on team gender composition and speed. Prizes are given for the fastest team, the last team, and teams finishing in specific places. Cycling routes are available to reach the exchange points without crossing the running routes. Inexperienced runners and participants under 14 years old are advised not to participate. 7 distances between 4 and 7 km, course over paved and unpaved roads, start and finish at the athletics track of Atletico’73 Gendringen.

name: Iedema Building Run 2026
description: The Iedema Building Run 2026 in Harderwijk is a sporting event focused on movement, meeting, and entrepreneurship, with a special emphasis on supporting the Princess Beatrix Muscle Fund. Participants can walk, run, and commit to raising money for research into muscle diseases. The event encourages personal and team actions to make a positive impact for people with muscle diseases. It is an accessible and meaningful run for everyone who wants to contribute to a future without muscle diseases.
course_highlights: Support for muscle disease research
Community-oriented charity run
Organized by Sportcentrum Iedema
additional: The event supports the Princess Beatrix Muscle Fund and encourages participants to start personal sponsorship campaigns, contribute as a team, and raise funds for muscle disease research. Participants are encouraged to fundraise and actively participate in an event that promotes movement and community spirit.
